Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based near Abdi Wayeel Cinema (Heliwa District) in the evening of 17/06.  Reports indicate that the device hit the perimeter wall of a nearby building. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw two hand grenades at a police checkpoint at Al-Baraka Junction in Hodan District in the evening of 17/06. The police reacted by firing in the direction of the attackers. Three were injured in the explosion.  The attackers managed to escape.

Four mortar rounds are fired at Villa Somalia, the presidential palace, in the overnight hours. One security guard reportedly injured. Police arrest "hundreds" (Sabahi/All Africa Global Media) in the days following the attack.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Al Shabaab forces abandon their positions in Tuulo-Barwaaqo as anti-al Shabaab forces (not identified) advanced toward the village. Following the withdrawal, many al Shabaab fighters returned to their positions when government allied militia stopped short of entering the city.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government security forces in the livestock market in Hawl-Wadaag neighbourhood in Beled Weyne in the morning of 17/06.  There were no casualties. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted Somali security forces at Bar Ismail in Afgooye in the morning of 17/06. An AMISOM military convoy was passing the area when the device went off. It remains unclear whether the RCIED was targeted at the Somali forces in the area or the AMISOM convoy. Two Somali soldiers were injured in the attack. The perpetrators escaped.

Al Shabaab launched an attack against the position of an unnamed opposition force at Ceel Barde in the night of 18/06. The two sides exchanged gunfire briefly after which the al Shabaab withdrew. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali military forces manning a security checkpoint at Hawl-Wadaag Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 18/06. The soldiers reacted by firing in the direction of the attackers. Casualties could not be established.  The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Taleex neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 18/06. Following the incident a security sweep was conducted, but no arrests were made.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on security patrol in Heraryale neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 18/06. The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot two soldiers on board a motorcycle at Fagax Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 18/06. Reports indicate that one of the soldiers died on the spot, while the other suffered injuries.  A number of suspects were arrested following the attack.
A RCIED targeted a Darwish forces near Sugure Village (33km S of Bosasso) on 18/06. Three soldiers were injured in the explosion.
Unidentified gunmen shot and seriously injured a senior Raskamboni commander near the port of Kismaayo in the morning of 18/06. The victim hails from Marehan clan and was the deputy of Ahmed Madobe.
Unidentified gunmen shot and seriously injured a senior Raskamboni commander near the port of Kismaayo in the morning of 18/06. The victim hails from Marehan clan and was the deputy of Ahmed Madobe.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at an AMISOM convoy in the Saraha area of Marka in the morning of 18/06. The device missed its target and landed on the road side. A female bystander was injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 19/06. The soldiers reacted by firing in the direction of the attackers. Casualties could not be established.  The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified armed men with pistols shot and killed a civilian woman in Radar neighbourhood in Dayniile District in the evening of 20/06. The motive of the killing is unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces' regular position at Hoosh neighbourhood  (Dharkeynley District)in the evening of 20/06. The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the residence of a military forces' officer  in Garasbaley neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 20/06. No casualties reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on patrol near Abdi Wayeel Cinema (Heliwa District)in the evening of 21/06. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces manning Yaaqshiid police station (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 21/06. The hand grenade landed in an open area near the police station. The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.
Al Shabaab attacks a Raskamboni position situated at the University of Kismayo. Witness claim the clash resulted in deaths and injuries although the number of casualties remains unknown.

attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces' outpost in Odweyne area, Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 22/02. The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces' position in Somali Company compound area (Heliwa District)in the evening of 22/02. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified man armed with a pistol and riding on a motorcycle shot dead a security forces' officer at Maka Al-mukarama road in Waberi District on 22/06. His security guards chased the perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces' outpost in Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 22/06. The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. Casualties could not be established. The attackers escaped.
Anti-al Shabaab (unnamed) forces clashed with unidentified clan militias in the khat market in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 22/06. The motive is unclear. No casualties were reported.
A minibus drove over an IED planted in the road, though it failed to detonate properly. It is not clear if civilians were the perpetrator's target.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces manning a regular security checkpoint located near NBC Building (Hodan District) in the evening of 23/06.  Unconfirmed reports indicate that the hand grenade hit the perimeter wall of the NBC Building causing no casualties. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces' regular position at Black Sea Junction (Hodan District) in the in the evening of 23/06.  The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. One civilian bystander was reportedly killed while another was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

Three unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Ceel Qalow neighbourhood (Medina District) in the evening of 23/06. The motive is unknown, though the victim used to work for Somali government parliament as a clerk. Reports indicate the perpetrators attacked him as he was about to enter his house. The perpetrators escaped.
ASWJ/anti-al Shabaab (unnamed) forces took over Buura Diriye Village (20km SW of Garbahaarey) without resistance from al Shabaab who withdrew from the village.

Al Shabaab launched a hit and run attack against anti-al Shabaab (unnamed) fighters' position in Ceel-Cadde Village in the evening of 23/06. The two sides exchanged heavy gunfire for about 30 minutes after which al Shabaab forces withdrew. Casualties could not be established.
An IED planted near a AMISOM water distribution facility is discovered by security forces and dismantled before it was allowed to detonate.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at soldiers on patrol near the residence of the Afgooye deputy district commissioner in Hawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the evening of 23/06. A civilian bystander was killed and another injured. A group of soldiers conducted a security operation in the area after the blast and managed to arrest a man they suspected of being behind the attack.
Unidentified armed men with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Ceelasha Biyaha (Afgooye District) in the evening of 23/06. The perpetrators escaped.

A landmine targeting a public transport vehicle in the city's SOS area in Heliwa detonates causing two injuries. No group has claimed responsibility for the blast, though al Shabaab has claimed responsibility for similar explosions in the area.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces' manning a checkpoint at Black Sea Junction (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 24/06. One soldier was reportedly killed while two others were injured in the blast. The attackers managed to escape.

An IED exploded near the former milk factory in Hodan District in the morning of 24/06. The target of the device remains unclear since no one was in the area by the time of the blast. The shrapnel from the device injured a child sleeping in a nearby house.
An IED attached to a military truck in Medina is discovered and disabled before it was allowed to detonate. Police later arrested two men they believed to be behind the planned attack.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Marka police station located in Beytu Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the evening of 24/06. Police reacted by firing in the direction of the attackers. One officer was seriously injured in the blast. The attackers managed to escape.

Al Shabaab forces launch a hit and run attack against pro-Somali, anti-al Shabaab forces' positions (militia not named) in the outskirts of Ceel Barde in the evening of 25/06. The two sides exchanged gunfire for about six minutes after which al Shabaab withdrew. No casualties were reported.

Al Shabaab forces launched a hit-and-run style attack against a anti-al Shabaab fighters' (group not named) position in the outskirts of Afmadow in the evening of 25/06. The two sides exchanged gunfire briefly after which al Shabaab withdrew. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces manning a security checkpoint near Bar Jowhar (Heliwa District) in the evening of 26/06. No casualties were reported. The soldiers conducted a security operation after the blast and arrested a number of people they suspected of being behind the attack.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government forces' base in Tolmadda area (Hodan District) in the evening of 26/06. The soldiers reacted by opening fire in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled two simultaneous hand grenades at police at Bakaara Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 26/06. A police officer and two civilian bystanders were killed and three other people were injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at security forces on foot patrol at Aden Adde Junction (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 26/06. One soldier was reportedly injured in the explosion. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at security forces 'security outpost in Xamar Jadiid neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 26/06. The soldiers reacted by opening heavy gunfire in all directions. Casualties could not be established. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a security forces' base in Irid Amin area (Beled Weyne) in the evening of 26/06. The bomb landed near the base. No casualties were reported. The soldiers conducted quick security operation but made no arrest. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Raskamboni allied and al Shabaab's Godane faction clashed with Barre-Hirale forces causing the death of seven, three of which were civilians.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based at ADC stores in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar District) in the evening of 26/06. The soldiers reacted to the attack by firing their weapons indiscriminately. Three civilian bystanders were injured in the explosion.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against a police outpost in Bakaara Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 27/06. Three policemen were reportedly wounded in the attack. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Jaamacadaha neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the night of 27/06. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Ras Kaambooni (RKB) forces attacked anti-al Shabaab (not identified) forces based at the meat factory in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 27/06. The two sides briefly exchanged gunfire after which AMISOM forces intervened and separated them. The motive of the attack is unknown.

Ras Kaambooni (RKB) forces attacked anti-al Shabaab (not identified) forces based at the meat factory in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 27/06. The two sides briefly exchanged gunfire after which AMISOM forces intervened and separated them. The motive of the attack is unknown.

Following a failed peace brokering on the part of AMISOM, Marehan and Ogaden militias renew fighting in the Argada area of the city, causing the deaths of six Marehan and three Ogaden militiamen. In reaction to the fighting, present Raskamboni forces opened fire on the group, killing one Marehan fighter.

An IED targeted a AMISOM convoy at Xaaji Jamac Junction in Fanole neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 27/06. Following the blast the targeted soldiers began firing indiscriminately. Causalities could not be established.

An IED targeted a AMISOM convoy at Maryan Khamiis area of Shaqalaha neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 27/06. The convoy was rushing to Fanole neighbourhood where a second AMISOM convoy was targeted with an IED earlier. Causalities unknown.
AMISOM sustained several causalities when their convoy was struck by a roadside bomb. Specific numbers not provided.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against a SNG position in KPP junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 28/06. The soldiers fired back after the blast. Two civilian bystanders were reportedly injured.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against a police outpost in Al-Baraka junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 28/06. The policemen fired back after the blast. No casualties were reported.

Anti-al Shabaab forces captured a suspected al Shabaab fighter planting an IED in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the night of 28/06. Two other suspected al Shabaab operatives were also reportedly captured in connection with the incident. It is not entirely clear what the perpetrators intended target was.

Raskamboni/Madobe, or "Jubaland" forces clash with Barre-Hirale militia in an area power struggle. Ahmed Madobe had appointed himself ruler of the area last month and had deemed the Barre-Hirale militia illegal. Five civilian bystanders were reportedly killing in the fighting. Radio Shabeelle reports six deaths due to the fighting.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a government tax collector in Marka in the morning of 28/06. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Pro-Somali forces (not named) raided a house in Shimbiro Village (35km SW of Ceel Barde) on 29/07 where the residents were believed to be aiding al Shabaab. One man was killed, another wounded and three others arrested.
Anti-al Shabaab (unnamed) forces launched an attack against al Shabaab militias in Gani-Weyne village in the evening of 29/07. Three al Shabaab fighters were reportedly killed.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Al-Baraka neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 29/06. The victim was heading to his home. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a NSA soldier in Geed Jeceyl neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 29/06. The victim was sitting near a small teashop when he was attacked. The perpetrators managed to escape.

An AMISOM patrol was targeted by a RCIED in proximity of Afar Irdood junction in the centre of Baidoa in the morning of 29/06. Two AMISOM soldiers and four civilians were reportedly injured (one civilian later succumbed to his injuries).

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the Marka police station in the night of 29/06. Police officers fired back after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a defensive base located in Hosh neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 30/06. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in the Livestock Market neighbourhood (Heliwa District)in the evening of 30/06. Two civilian bystanders reportedly sustained minor injuries in the attack. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against Somali forces' position near Abdi Wayeel Cinema (Heliwa District)in the evening of 30/06. The soldiers reacted by opening fire in the direction of the attackers. One soldier was injured in the attack. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the residence of NSA officer in Jamhuuriya neighbourhood (Karaan District) in the evening of 30/06. Reports indicate that the device hit the perimeter wall of the building. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Al Shabaab ambushed an anti-al Shabaab (not named) military convoy near Faafaxdhun Village in Baardheere District in the afternoon of 30/06. The two sides exchanged gunfire for about an hour. Casualties could not be established.

An IED targeted AMISOM forces in Rushia neighbourhood in Marka in the afternoon of 30/06. Unconfirmed reports indicated that two AMISOM soldiers and civilian bystander were injured. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based at Bakaara Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 01/07. The soldiers reacted by opening fire in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces chewing khat in front of a teashop in Biyo Degaanka neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the evening of 01/07. The device reportedly missed its target. No casualties were reported. The soldiers conducted a security operation after the blast but made no arrest. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled two hand grenades at police manning a security outpost located in KPP Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 01/07. The soldiers reacted by opening fire in the direction of the attackers. Two female bystanders were injured in the blast. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot in Godey neighbourhood (Karaan District) in the evening 01/07. The hand grenade reportedly missed its target. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Resident of Bulo Xawo on 01/07 staged a demonstration in protest against KDF involvement in the armed clashes between Ras Kaambooni forces (RKB) and those loyal to Barre Hirale in Kismaayo on 29/06. A man affiliated with Raskamboni opened fire in the crowd, injuring one of the demonstrators.

Unidentified attackers hurled hand grenade at the residence of a businessman in Hawl-Wadaag neighbourhood (Beled Weyne) in the evening of 01/07. Reports indicate that the businessman supplies goods to Ethiopian forces in Beled Weyne. Other reports indicate that the grenade was targeted at Somali forces passing near the house. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
An IED targeted AMISOM forces convoy in an area between Awdheegle town and Bariire villages in Afgooye District in the morning of 02/07. Causalities could not be established.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces on patrol in Biyo Degaanka neighbourhood (Heliwa District)in the evening of 03/07.  Casualties could not be established. The perpetrator(s) escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces on foot patrol in Bar Jowhar area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 03/07. Two soldiers were injured in the blast. The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police on patrol in Daryeel mini-market in the Livestock Market neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the morning of 03/07. One police officer and two bystanders were wounded. The perpetrator(s) escaped.
An IED targeted a military convoy in Biyo Degaanka neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the evening of 03/07.  The soldiers reacted by opening fire after the blast. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces based near the former milk factory (Hodan District) in the evening of 03/07.  The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police manning a security checkpoint at Bakaara Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 03/07. The soldiers responded by firing in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

A IED targeted a security forces' vehicle near General Daud School (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 03/07. Reports indicate that the vehicle was badly damaged. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a private residence in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the evening of 03/07.  One person (a female) was reportedly injured in the blast. The motive of the attack remains unknown.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: A special unit of Somali forces arrested a woman wearing an explosive belt near Wardhiigley police station (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 04/07. The soldiers surrounded the woman as she walked near the police station and managed to arrest her.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: A shop owner discovered a suspicious device planted in her tea-shop at the meat market in Berdale neighbourhood of Baidoa in the morning of 04/07 and reported to police. The police identified the device as an IED and disabled it safely.
Unidentified armed men attacked a Puntland police convoy killing two officers and two civilian bystanders. Fifteen others were wounded. The attack comes after a Horseed Party political rally.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a prominent business man in Beytu Raas neighbourhood in Marka in the morning of 04/07. The motive of the killing is unclear. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a prominent traditional leader in Sheekh Abrone neighbourhood in Marka in the afternoon of 04/07. The deceased was the sultan of Jiide clan. The motive of the killing is currently unknown.
Government allied militia (not identified) conducted a security operation in Kayaane Village (26km SW of Tayeeglow) and killed three members of al Shabaab in the village on 05/07.

Government allied militia (not identified) conducted a security in Orogley Village (22km SW of Xudur) and killed two al Shabaab fighters in the village. The militia is presumably the same militia active in Kayaane earlier in the day.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District)in the evening of 05/07. The soldiers fired back in the suspected direction. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: A business owner discovered an IED planted inside her store. Security forces were bale to disable the device before it detonated.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a Somali forces' regular position in Wajer neighbourhood (Karaan District) in the evening of 05/07. The soldiers fired back in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

An IED exploded prematurely in area near Carafat neighbourhood (Yaqshiid District) in the evening of 05/07. Three bystanders were reportedly injured in the blast. The target is unclear but Somali soldiers frequent the area.

An IED attached to the car of Jubaland regional court chairman went off in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 05/07. The chairman escaped unhurt but his son was slightly injured. Three people were arrested in connection with the incident.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military forces' regular position at Al-Baraka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 06/07. The soldiers fired back in the suspected direction.  No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Jamacadaha area (Hodan District) on 06/07. The motive is unclear. The victim was standing near a small shop when he was attacked. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali military forces on foot patrol at Ali Kamiin Junction (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 06/07. The soldiers fired back in the suspected direction. Two civilian bystanders were reportedly injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Raskamboni (RKB) forces launched a security operation in pursuit of the remaining Marehan militias loyal to Barre Hirale in Goob Weyn Village (14 km NE of Kismaayo) in the morning of 06/07. The two sides clashed briefly. One RKB and a Marehan militia man were killed in the clash.

An RCIED targeting a Somali forces' truck went off just after the vehicle passed in the livestock market located in Hawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the morning of 06/07. A female bystander was killed and at least two others were injured. The perpetrators escaped.

Two armed and masked men stormed the home of the headmaster of the local primary school in Cabdil Qadir Village (80km NE of Borama) in the night of 07/07. The motive of the attack is unclear, though it may be linked to clan revenge.  The headmaster, who was able to escape unharmed, hails from Isse clan.

Three unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed military officer in Banaadir Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 07/07. The deceased was the SNA commander in Dharkeynley District. The perpetrators stole his pistol and escaped.

Three armed men riding on a motor cycle shot and killed a police officer at Fagax Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 07/07. Soldiers in the vicinity reacted by opening fire at the perpetrators, killing one on the spot and arresting the other two. Conflicting reports indicate that the slain police officer was attached to Heliwa police station.
The commander of the Bosasso central police station survives an assassination attempt by unknown gunmen.
A journalist is shot and killed in Galkacyo for unknown reasons. It is not clear if the attack occurred in Northern or Southern portion of the city.

Unidentified militiamen from Galkacyo North shot and killed a herder hailing from the Habar Gidir/Sa'ad sub-clan in Buurcad Village (7km E of Galkacyo) in the evening of 07/07. The motive of the killing is unclear but it is believed to be related to clan revenge attack. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified men assassinate a senior government intelligence official, Abdirahman Ato. The attack occurred at Banaadir intersection.

Unidentified men assassinate a government intelligence official at Fagax intersection in Yaaqshiid District. It is not clear if the perpetrators are the same as those who assassinated another official at Banaadir intersection earlier in the afternoon.

Puntland police clashed with group of militiamen loyal to opposition politicians in Qardho on 08/07. The fighting broke out after police fired in the air to stop a group of demonstrators who wanted to storm a venue where the Transitional Puntland Electoral Commission (TPEC) had been training university students on election process. Causalities unknown.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar)in the evening of 08/07. Two soldiers were reportedly injured in the attack. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police car near Ali Dheere building in the main Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the morning of 09/07. Three police officers were reportedly injured in the attack. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified armed men shot and killed a businessman in the livestock market (Heliwa District) in the morning of 09/07. The motive remains unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian woman in the livestock market (Heliwa District) in the morning of 09/07. The victim used to run a teashop frequented by Somali forces. The motive of the killing is unknown since there were no soldiers in the premise during the attack.  The perpetrators escaped.

An IED attached on the roof of a restaurant in Awdiinle Village (Baidoa District) detonated in the morning of 09/07.  The restaurant was frequented by Somali military forces, though it is unclear if they were the target of the blast. No casualties were reported.
Unidentified men armed with AK-47 rifles shot and killed a khat seller in Zona K area (Hodan District) in the evening of 10/07. The motive is unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

A IED targeted an AMISOM convoy near Coca-Cola factory in Yaaqshiid District in the evening of 10/07. The explosion damaged one of the AMISOM water bowsers. AMISOM forces blocked the road for about 30 minutes and later continued with their trip.

Unidentified armed men in Puntland military uniforms opened fire at a local municipal police in a car in Gaaca area (Bosasso) in the evening of 10/07. One municipal policeman was killed and another injured in the attack. Reports indicate that the attackers had been planning to assassinate the secretary of the municipal council. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier near Afgooye Police Station in Dhagax Tuur neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the evening of 10/07. The perpetrators escaped.
A IED targeted a AMISOM convoy near SOS Junction in Heliwa District in the morning of 11/07.Casualties or damages could not be established.
Al Shabaab launched a hit and run attack against anti-al Shabaab forces' (affiliation unknown) base close to Afmadow airstrip in the evening of 11/07. No casualties were reported.

Al Shabaab reportedly launched a hit-and-run attack against anti-al Shabaab (affiliation unknown) positions located close to the Afmadow water sources and airfield in the night of 11/07. No casualties were reported. Reports indicate this was a separate attack from the one that occurred earlier in the evening at this location.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Mubarak village (9km SW of Aw Dheegle) in the night of 11/07. The victim used to sell khat to soldiers. The motive of the killing is unknown.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at Barwaaqo Hotel near Shaqaalaha junction (Waaberi District) in the evening of 12/07. A large number of people were in the restaurant of the hotel to break their fast at the time of the attack. One person was killed and seven others injured.

An IED targeted AMISOM vehicles in Afgooye town in Bar Ismail area in the evening of 12/07. Reports indicate that the explosion damaged a water tanker. AMISOM closed the area after the explosion. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped from the scene unidentified.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldiers on foot patrol in Radaar neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the night of 13/07. The soldiers fired back after the blast. Casualties could not be established.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two soldiers in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the afternoon of 13/07. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
A hand grenade targeting Somali forces explodes in Bakaara Market, causing three civilian deaths and ten injures.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Heliwa police station in the night of 13/07. Police officers fired back in the suspected direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a NSA officer near Wadajir Police station (Wadajir District) in the evening of 13/07. The victim was reportedly the son of the Custodial Commissioner.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military position in Ceymiska neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 13/07. The soldiers manning the position opened fire immediately after the blast. Casualties could not be established.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police on patrol in Suuq Bacad (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 13/07. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Al Shabaab forces launched a hit-and-run attack against anti-al Shabaab positions in Qooqaani on the Dhoobley-Afmadow road in the night of 13/07. The attack was of a very limited scale. No casualties were reported.

Anti-al Shabaab security forces (affiliation not named) conduct a security operation against al Shabaab. Two Marehan members of the sect are shot and killed. The operation was in response to a clash within al Shabaab the previous day.

A child was shot and killed by Raskamboni militiamen who opened fire at a group of bystanders in Shaqaalaha neighbourhood in Kismaayo in the morning of 13/07. The reason for the shooting is unknown. No arrests were made after the incident.

Unidentified men armed with pistols and AK-47 rifles shot and killed a staff of a local NGO in front of Tawqa Mosque in Israac neighbourhood (Galkacyo North) after the evening prayer on 13/07. Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at a Playstation lounge in Shareeca neighbourhood of Ceelasha in the night of 13/07. Two young boys who were playing video-games were reportedly injured. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a young civilian returning home from mosque in the Livestock Market area (Heliwa District) in the night of 14/07. The motive for the attack is unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

An unknown attacker hurled a hand grenade at a barber shop in the livestock market area in Heliwa district in the afternoon of 14/07. The barber died in the explosion and two of his clients were injured. Unconfirmed reports indicate that one of the clients was a government soldier.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against security forces manning a checkpoint in Bakara Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 14/07. The soldiers fired back in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a NSA officer close to Bakara Junction (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 14/07. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces on patrol at Sana'a Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 14/07. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

An IED exploded under a Raskamboni vehicle in Fanoole neighbourhood of Kismaayo in the morning of 14/07. Raskamboni militias opened indiscriminate fire after the incident, killing two girls. An IED exploded under a Raskamboni vehicle in Fanoole neighbourhood of Kismaayo in the morning of 14/07. Raskamboni militias opened indiscriminate fire after the incident, killing two girls. Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Marka police station (Marka) in the evening of 14/07. Police opened fire immediately after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the residence of a Somali government forces' officer in Macmacanka neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 15/07. The device exploded outside the house. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces manning a checkpoint in Shanta Geed neighbourhood (Hawl-Wadaag District) on 15/07. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two soldiers in Dahablaha Section of Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 15/07. The attackers escaped.  Somali forces arrived at the scene and launched a security operation, and arrested a number of people they suspected of being behind the killings.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces moving near Shaqaalaha Building, (Hodan District) in the evening of 15/07. A civilian bystander was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces at Bakaara Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 15/07. The soldiers responded by firing in the suspected directions. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Two masked men armed with pistols shot and killed a young man in Jamacadaha neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 15/07.  The motive is unclear.  The perpetrators escaped. Police arrived at the scene but made no arrest.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Sheikh Adan Dhere building in Wardhiigley District, where the commander of Somali government forces in Dharkeynley stays. Soldiers responded by firing in the suspected directions. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based at Towfiiq Hotel in Towfiiq neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 15/07.  The soldiers responded by firing in the suspected directions. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based at Afgooye Secondary School in Afgooye in the evening of 15/07. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

The body of a man hailing from Dhulbahante/Reer Hagar sub-clan was found in the outskirts of Buuhoodle on 15/07. The body had knife wounds. The motive and the identity of the perpetrators remain unknown.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police on foot patrol in Radaar neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 16/07. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based in Biyo Degaanka area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 16/07. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped.

A IED targeted an AMISOM convoy passing near Maslah base in the livestock market neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the evening of 16/07. An AMISOM water bowser was reportedly damaged in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police on foot patrol near the former milk factory (Hodan District)in the evening of 16/07. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
An IED targeted security guards at a hospital in Hodan District. Causalities unknown.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based near Marka police station (Marka) in the evening of 16/07. No casualties reported. The attackers escaped.
An IED targeted police based near Madina Hotel (Xamar Jab Jab District) in the evening of 17/07. One police officer was injured. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police based at Xera Ruush (Hodan District) in the evening of 17/07. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police officers on foot patrol close to Towfiiq Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 17/07. A bystander was reportedly injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Three unidentified armed men shot and killed the deputy District Commissioner of Yaaqshiid District near Fagax Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 17/07. Somali forces conducted a security operation in the area and arrested two men they suspected of behind the killing.

Heavy fighting reported between Raskamboni and al Shabaab forces in the Mahelaay Village of Kismayo. The clash occurred late in the evening. Both sides suffered losses, though any specific numbers are unclear.
Raskamboni forces shot and injured two local journalists in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 17/07. The two were shot after they refused to stop at a driver checkpoint.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on patrol in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood in Jowhar town in the night of 17/07. The soldiers opened fire indiscriminately after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Xawa Tako neighbourhood in Afgooye in the night of 17/07. The motive is unclear but local residents say the victim used to interact with the Somali government forces in Afgooye. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers shot and killed a police officer close to the Dayniile bus stand (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the end of the afternoon of 18/07. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Bakara market (Abdalla Shideeye section) in the evening of 18/07. The perpetrators stole the gun of the victim and escaped from the area.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two NSA officers in Bakara market in the end of the afternoon of 18/07. Both victims were wearing civilian clothes when attacked. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified attackers shot and killed a man in Bakara Market (Abdalla Shideeye section) in the evening of 18/07. The victim was leaving a local mosque. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw two hand grenades against Somali forces in Biyo Degaanka area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 18/07. Unconfirmed reports indicate that two soldiers may have been killed. The perpetrators managed to escape. A security operation was conducted after the attack and an unknown number of persons were arrested.

A IED targeted Somali forces on foot patrol in Ali Kamiin neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 18/07. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. An unknown number of soldiers were killed or injured. Several arrests were made after the attack.

Al Shabaab militias ambushed a vehicle transporting local security forces based in Afmadow on the alternative road linking Afmadow and Dhoobley in the morning of 18/07. Four soldiers were killed and three seriously injured.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against Marka police station in the night of 18/07. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Sei-Biano area (Hodan District) in the end of the afternoon of 19/07. The attackers stole the victims AK-47 before escaping.
Clash reported between Raskamboni forces and al Shabaab along the outskirts of Kismayo. "Damages" reported by each side.
A IED targeted an AMISOM convoy travelling along the Mogadishu-Afgooye road near Siinka-Dheer in the evening of 19/07. Causalities could not be established. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified gunmen killed a doctor after he left a mosque in suburban Ceelesha Biyaha. Motive unknown.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a local doctor in Ceelasha Biyaha in the night of 19/07. The victim is reported to be a relative of the former NSA chief Mohamed Moalim Fiqi. The victim was attacked and killed as he was coming back home from mosque. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED targeted Somali forces in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the afternoon of 20/07. Reports indicate that the device was planted in a place frequented by the soldiers. Casualties were confirmed but their number is unknown.

Unidentified attackers threw two hand grenades against Somali forces on foot patrol in the clothe market area (Xamar Weyne District) on 20/07. The soldiers opened fire after the blasts. The attackers managed to escape. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against police officers on foot patrol in Uunlaay neighbourhood (Xamar Weyne District) in the evening of 20/07. The grenade missed its target and did not cause any casualty.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against Somali soldiers manning a fixed position in Black Sea Junction area (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 20/07. Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in front of SOS Hospital (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 20/07. The perpetrators escaped from the scene. Somali and AMISOM forces reached the scene after the killing and conducted a security operation arresting several persons in and around the hospital.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a police officer close to the Heliwa police station in the evening of 20/07.  The victim was heading to Heliwa police station when attacked. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against Somali forces based close to Bakaara Junction (Hodan District) in the end of the afternoon of 20/07. The soldiers fired back after the blast. An unknown number of civilians were wounded as the result of the blast and/or the subsequent shooting. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in New Bossaso on 20/07. The victim was hailing from the Daarood/Dhulmahante clan. The perpetrators escaped from the scene. The motive of the killing is unclear.

Unidentified attackers shot and killed an al Shabaab militiaman in Buulo Baaqey village in the evening of 20/07. The militiaman had reportedly been threatening the local villagers for an unknown reason in the days prior to the incident.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed Moallin Hassan Ilmi Ciyow - the second deputy of the Beled Weyne court and a prominent member of the ASWJ movement in Hiraan - in Kooshin neighbourhood the night of 20/07. Motive is unknown.
A land mine targets AMISOM/Sierra Leone forces near Kismayo hospital. Witnesses claim four civilian deaths. The number of military deaths is unknown.
An unidentified business woman is killed by unidentified assailants. The motive for the killing is not known.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against the NSA base in the Afgooye secondary school in the evening of 20/07. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Government soldiers are targeted in an explosion at Bar Ismail junction. Two soldiers were killed in the attack and an unconfirmed number injured among government troops. Security forces begun to fire indiscriminately soon after the attack.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against Marka police station in the night of 20/07. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Indented attackers threw a hand grenade against the police station in Kaaraan District in the night of 21/07. The blast injured two policemen and one civilian. Somali forces located near the station opened fire and conducted a security operation after the blast. Two injured men were arrested after the attack and later summarily executed.

Unidentified gunmen armed with AK-47 rifles onboard an unregistered vehicle reportedly shot and injured a civilian in Xero Darawiish area near Kapital hotel in Galkacyo North in the night of 21/07. The motive of the shooting is unascertained.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against Marka police station in the night of 21/07. The hand-grenade hit the gate of a residential house opposite to the police station. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Somali security forces exchanged gunfire with an unknown gunman armed with a pistol near Maalin Taajir building in Bakara Market in the afternoon of 22/07. The shooting broke out after the soldiers tried to arrest the man.  The gunman managed to escape from the scene.
Unknown attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier near Bar Ubah Junction in Hawl-Wadaag District  at noon of 22/07. The perpetrators stole the soldier's gun and escaped from the scene.
Unknown gunmen attacked Yaaqshiid Police Station in the night of 22/07. Small arms and RPGs were used during the attack which lasted for about 20 minutes. Casualties are unknown.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle of pro-Somali forces (not identified) in Awdiinle at noon of 22/07. The device exploded few seconds after the vehicle passed its location. No casualties were reported. Pro-Somali forces conducted a security operation after the attack and arrested an unspecific number of people suspected of involvement in it.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle of pro-Somali forces (not identified) in Awdiinle at noon of 22/07. The device exploded few seconds after the vehicle passed its location. No casualties were reported. Pro-Somali forces conducted a security operation after the attack and arrested an unspecific number of people suspected of involvement in it.

Unconfirmed reports indicate that Kenyan warships patrolling Somali coast off Kismaayo shelled Goob Weyn village (13km N of Kismaayo) in the early morning of 22/07. At least two civilians were reportedly severely wounded. Goob Weyne is a base of forces loyal to Barre Hiraale.

Three hand grenades were thrown at Somali forces stationed in Bar Ismail Junction in Afgooye town in the evening of 22/07. The forces fired in the direction of the perpetrators after the attack. The attackers escaped from the scene. Casualties are unknown.

An unknown attacker threw a hand grenade at Somali forces in Hawo Tako neighbourhood of Afgooye town in the evening of 22/07. The forces fired in the direction of perpetrators after the attack. The attackers escaped from the scene. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police on patrol at Al-Baraka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 23/07. A civilian bystander was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

Three unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a NSA officer in KPP neighbourhood (Hodan District) on 23/07. The victim was unarmed and was heading to his home when he was attacked. The perpetrators escaped. Military forces arrived in the area but made no arrest.

Unidentified gunmen opened fire at a truck carrying khat near Laag Village in Bosasso District in the afternoon of 23/07. The motive of the attack is currently unclear.  The vehicle managed to escape.

Galmudug forces clashed with a militia group in Galbarwaaqo Village (86km W of Cadaado) in the afternoon of 23/07. The fighting broke out after the militiamen, who reportedly vandalized water pipes to the village, resisted arrest. One militiaman was killed and another injured. One Galmudug soldier was also injured in the clash. The security forces managed to arrest three other militiamen.

Unidentified man hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on patrol in Irid-Amin area in Koshin neighbourhood (Beled Weyne) in the evening of 23/07. The device landed in an open area. No casualties were reported.

An IED targeted a Raskamboni truck in Farjano neighbourhood in Kismaayo on 23/07. Two RKB soldiers and two bystanders (children) were slightly injured and the vehicle was partially destroyed. An IED targeted a Raskamboni truck in Farjano neighbourhood in Kismaayo on 23/07. Two RKB soldiers and two bystanders (children) were slightly injured and the vehicle was partially destroyed. The RKB forces launched a security operation after the blast and arrested several people they suspected of being involved in the attack.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols men shot and killed a staff of a local NGO, Abdinasir Muhammad Ilmi, in Garsoor neighbourhood in Galkacyo in the evening of 23/07. The motive of the killing is currently unknown.
Unknown men stabbed and killed a young man in Total neighbourhood in Ahmed Dhagax District (Hargeisa) in the evening of 23/07. The motive of the killing is unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Daryeel Market (Heliwa District) in the noon of 24/07. The assailants stole the gun of their victim and escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces based at the former milk factory (Hodan District) in the evening of 24/07. Casualties are unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man near the former Defence Ministry (Hodan District)in the evening of 24/07. The motive is unclear. The victim was attacked as he headed home. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at private residential house for military officers' in Arafaat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 24/07. Unidentified attackers hurled several hand grenades at Yaaqshiid police station (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 24/07. Police manning the station opened fire in the direction of the attackers. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

An RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in Yaaq Biri Weyne (22km W of Wanla Weyne) in the afternoon of 24/07. An AMISOM truck was reportedly damaged in the explosion. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and injured a local businessman hailing from the Darood-Ogaden clan in Midnimo market of south Galkacyo in the evening of 25/07. The motivation for the attack is not known.

Unknown attackers threw a hand grenade against Somali forces based at Xawo Tako neighbourhood in Afgooye in the night of 25/07. The Somali opened gunfire in response to the explosion. No casualties were reported.
Unknown attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Suuqa Xoolaha neighbourhood in Afgooye town in the night of 25/07. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

An RCIED exploded at the entrance of Hawl Wadaag Police Station in the evening of 26/07. A secondary RCIED targeted the policemen helping their colleagues injured in the first blast. Casualties could not be confirmed.
Unknown attackers hurled a hand grenade at SNG foot patrol in livestock market area of Heliwa District in the afternoon of 26/07. One civilian was killed and five others were injured.

Somali forces reportedly exchanged gunfire with two men armed with pistols in Ajabka neighbourhood in Dharkeynley District in the evening of 27/07. The two  men were overpowered in the gunfight and were arrested. It is not clear what sparked the clash.
Unknown gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a member of NSA in Afar-Irdood area of Hamar Weyne in the night of 27/07. The perpetrator escaped from the scene.

Unknown attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in livestock market area of Heliwa District in the evening of 27/07. The perpetrators stole the gun from the soldier and escaped from the scene.

Unknown attackers hurled a hand grenade at Yaaqshiid police station in the evening of 27/07. The grenade exploded outside the station. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED attack targeted a vehicle belonging to the Ministry of Transport at Sana' Junction in the morning of 27/07. It was not immediately clear if the IED was placed inside the vehicle or on the road. A person travelling in the vehicle was killed and several bystanders were injured.

Al Shabaab attacked a local pro-SNG, anti-al Shabaab militia's base (militia not named) in Isha Neighbourhood of Baidoa in the early morning of 27/07. The fighting lasted for about 30 minutes. One militiaman was reportedly injured.
A RCIED attack targeted an AMISOM convoy on the Afgooye - Marka road in Ceel-wareegow on 27/07. The explosion reportedly damaged a water tanker. No other casualties were reported.

Unknown attackers threw a hand grenade at Galbeed police station in Dharkeynley District in the evening of 28/07. The forces based at the location opened fire in the direction of the perpetrators after the attack. No casualties were reported.
Unknown attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based at Abdiwayel cinema in the early morning hours of 28/07. The grenade exploded outside the building. No casualties were reported.

Unknown attackers threw a hand grenade against Somali forces in Ceelgalow neighbourhood in Medina District in the evening of 28/07. The forces opened fire in the direction of the perpetrators after the attack. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed two soldiers on foot patrol in Radaar area along Industrial Road (Dayniile District) in the evening of 31/07. The perpetrators stole the guns of the soldiers after the attack.

A RCIED exploded in Shalaambood (Marka District) in the morning of 01/08. The explosion occurred close to a group of women who were waiting for transport to Marka to sell their vegetables. Three women were killed and two others injured. Somali forces arrested a young man who was recording the incident with a video camera

Two RCIEDs were discovered close to the ex-Milk Factory (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 02/08. One IED reportedly detonated prematurely while a police EOD team managed to disable the other. No casualties were reported. The intended target of the explosives is not known.

A RCIED targeted a Somali military vehicle in Shalaambood in the morning of 02/08. The device exploded after the vehicle passed the location. The soldiers onboard the vehicle stopped and carried out a quick operation after the attack but no arrests were confirmed.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at a military position in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the night of 03/08. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against Somali forces close to the Hawl-Wadaag police station and the Bimalow Mosque in the evening of 03/08. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at a police check-point close to Al-Baraka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 03/08. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier from the SNAF Third Brigade in African Village area in the afternoon of 03/08. The perpetrators stole the gun of the soldier before escaping from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed an unarmed soldier on his way home in Carafat area (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 03/08. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Two groups of ASWJ fighters exchanged gunfire in Dhusamareeb in the night of 03/08. The clash opposed a Sufa group protecting the compound where the self-proclaimed president of Galmudug was staying, and another ASWJ group. It is believed that the clash started after the two groups disputed over the sharing of resources obtained from providing protection to the delegation. No casualties were reported.

ACTOR1: ASWJ-Sufa: Ahlu Sunna Wal Jamaa (Sufa Faction)
NOTES: Two groups of ASWJ fighters exchanged gunfire in Dhusamareeb in the night of 03/08. The clash opposed a Sufa group protecting the compound where the self-proclaimed president of Galmudug was staying, and another ASWJ group. It is believed that the clash started after the two groups disputed over the sharing of resources obtained from providing protection to the delegation. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED accidently detonated while being carried by a man close to Ummada School in Garsoor neighbourhood in Galkacyo in the evening of 03/08. The man carrying the device was killed and two other young men who were with him were injured.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at Somali soldiers on foot patrol in the livestock market area in Afgooye town in the night of 03/08. The soldiers opened fire after the explosion. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped from the scene.
A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy moving between Afgooye and Bariire (11km NE of Aw Dheegle) in the afternoon of 03/08. The explosion damaged one of the AMISOM vehicles. Casualties are unknown.

Unidentified attackers threw two hand-grenades at Somali soldiers based in Beytu-Raas neighbourhood in Marka in the night of 03/04. The soldiers opened fire after the blasts. No casualties were reported.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against a military check-point close to ex-Control Afgooye/K-7 in the evening of 04/08. The soldiers opened fire after the attack. Casualties are unknown.
A RCIED targeted a military vehicle between Badbaado and Xoosh (Dharkeynley District) in the night of 04/08. The device missed its target. No casualties were reported.
Two mortar rounds fell in open places close to the fish market and the District office in Xamar Weyne District in the evening of 04/08. No casualties or damages were reported.
A RCIED targeted a solar lamp pole close to the former milk factory (Hodan District) in the night of 04/08. The pole was destroyed.

A RCIED planted in a pile of garbage exploded prematurely in Bulo-Hubey neighbourhood (Medina District) in the evening of 04/08. No casualties were reported.  It is not clear who are what the target of the attackers was.

A RCIED targeted a military pick-up on patrol between Sei-Biano building and Banadir Hospital (Hodan/Medina District) in the evening of 04/08. Four bystanders were killed. The vehicle escaped un-damaged.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at soldiers on patrol close to Dabka Junction (Waaberi District) in the evening of 04/08. No casualties were reported.
Eight mortar rounds presumably aiming AMISOM/Somali positions fell in the area of the Mogadishu Stadium in the night of 04/08. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED targeted a convoy transporting the District Commissioners of Dayniile and Wardhiigley and the chair-person of the National Women Association close to Ifka Halane Junction on Industrial Road in the morning of 04/08. The convoy narrowly escaped the attack. Two by-sanders were injured. It was later learned the attacks in Mogadishu in 04/08 were coordinated.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against Somali soldiers on patrol in Afarta-Jardino (Yaaqshiid District) in the night of 04/08. No casualties were reported.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali soldiers on patrol in Towfiiq Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the night of 04/08. No casualties were reported.
A journalist is killed during the early morning hours by unidentified assailants. The motive for the killing is not known.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at Somali soldiers on foot patrol in Hawo-Tako neighbourhood in Afgooye in the night of 04/08. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported.

Suspected al Shabaab militias fired two RPG rounds at the generator house connected to the main town borehole on the north side of Garbahaarey town in the night of 05/08. One round hit the building and seriously wounded an anti-al Shabaab militiaman securing the well.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali soldiers manning a check-point in Xawo-Tako neighbourhood of Beled Weyne in the morning of 05/08. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a Somali outpost close to Liiliiqato bridge in Beled Weyne in the evening of 05/08. No casualties were reported. A security operation was conducted in the area after the attack and several persons were arrested.
Two additional hand-grenade attacks were reported in two different locations of Beled Weyne (unspecified) in the evening of 05/08. The perpetrators, their targets are unknown and causalities.
A Raas Kambooni soldier shot and injured a businessman in the centre of Kismaayo after the two got engaged in a dispute over a piece of land. The soldier escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldiers on foot patrol near Suuq Yare (small market, Xamar Jab Jab District) in the evening of 06/08. Once civilian bystander was injured. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at a military outpost in Cinema Abdi Wayeel area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 06/08. The soldiers opened fire after the attack. Casualties are unknown. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at Somali forces manning a check-point near Hodan police station in the evening of 06/08. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Digfer security guards in the vicinity of the Digfer Hospital (Hodan District) in the evening of 06/08. One guard was reportedly injured. The attackers escaped from the scene. The reason for the attack is not known.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Unidentified gunmen stopped and destroyed by fire two commercial trucks transporting food and fuel between Kariin and Yalho (main road from Bosasso to Garowe) in the night of 06/08. The two trucks, one of which was carrying a UN food consignment, were owned by members of the Majerteen/Omar Mohamoud sub-clan and were travelling from Bosasso towards the central regions.

An armed man forcefully entered and opened fire in the Hormuud compound in Berdale neighbourhood in Baidoa in the morning of 06/08. All the glass windows of the building were shattered. No casualties were reported. The shooter escaped from the scene before the arrival of local security forces. The reason for the shooting is unknown.

Al Shabaab militias equipped with six technicals attacked Afmadow town from two directions in the end of the afternoon of 06/08. The al Shabaab militias managed to briefly enter the town. The bodies of 16 al Shabaab militiamen were reportedly found close to the Afmadow police station after al Shabaab militiamen left the town, nine other al Shabaab bodies were found later around the town. Three Raas Kambooni militiamen and three civilians were also reported killed.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a NSA soldier in El-Qalow area (Medina District) in the afternoon of 07/08. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle of the Banadir regional administration on Industrial Road close to Carafat Hospital in the evening of 07/08. The vehicle was reportedly carrying foreign engineers involved in reconstruction works in Mogadishu. Two Indian technicians and one of the Governor's guards were killed.

A group of unidentified men wearing military uniforms onboard a private vehicle reportedly abducted a young woman close to her house in the vicinity of the Wardhiigley district office in the evening of 12/08. The girl reported having been raped after she was found the following morning.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at Puntland forces in Warshadda Galayda section of Garsoor neighbourhood in Galkacyo North in the evening of 08/08. The soldiers opened fire after the attack. One girl bystander was reportedly killed and three others injured. An unspecified number of Puntland soldiers were also reportedly injured. Unconfirmed reports indicate that one of the attackers was injured in the shooting but no arrests were made.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldiers on foot patrol in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the morning of 10/08. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. One soldier was reportedly killed and two others injured.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a young man sitting in a teashop in K13 area (Dharkeynley District) in the afternoon of 10/08. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
A fire destroyed around 20 shelters in Mahad-Alle IDP camp in Galkacyo South in the afternoon of 10/08. Two children were reportedly injured. The cause of the fire is unknown, and arson is suspect.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at ASWJ militiamen associated to Somali forces in Hawo-Tako neighbourhood in Afgooye in the night of 11/08. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade at ASWJ militiamen associated to Somali forces in Hawo-Tako neighbourhood in Afgooye in the night of 11/08. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a businesswoman in Haafad-Ruusiya neighbourhood in Marka in the evening of 10/08. The woman was said to have a good relationship with the Somali government and of selling electronics to AMISOM soldiers. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle belonging to the finance officer of Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood in Jowhar in the morning of 11:00. The driver of the vehicle and one female bystander were injured. The finance officer was not onboard the vehicle at the time of the attack.
A RCIED targeted a AMISOM convoy close to Xarunta Gabdha (Girls' Orphanage College) in Afgooye in the morning of 11/08. One of the trucks was damaged. Casualties are unknown.
Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed two soldiers in the gold section of Bakara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 12/08. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police officers on patrol close to Shaqaalaha building along Maka-al-Mukarama road (Hodan District) in the night of 12/08. A police officer was injured. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Four unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier on foot patrol close to the ex-US embassy compound (Medina District) in the afternoon of 12/08. The perpetrators stole the gun of the victim before escaping from the scene.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Towfiiq neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 12/08. The victim was on his way home when attacked. Security forces conducted a security operation in the area after the incident but no arrests were made.

A group of ASWJ militiamen reportedly clashed with a group of locals close to Xananbuure in the end of the afternoon of 12/08. ASWJ militiamen were reportedly attempting to stop the locals from cutting wood for charcoal production, an activity that has been banned by the ASWJ administration in its area of control. The of the local militia members, who have an association with Habr Gedir/Ayr/Yabar Dhowra Kece sub-sub-clan, were reportedly killed in the clash.

A group of ASWJ militiamen reportedly clashed with a group of locals close to Xananbuure in the end of the afternoon of 12/08. ASWJ militiamen were reportedly attempting to stop the locals from cutting wood for charcoal production, an activity that has been banned by the ASWJ administration in its area of control. The of the local militia members, who have an association with Habr Gedir/Ayr/Yabar Dhowra Kece sub-sub-clan, were reportedly killed in the clash.
Ayr/Yabar Dhowrakece sub-clan clashed with ASWJ/Sufa militiamen in Dabdheer village (Dhusamareeb District) on 12/08. Causalities not reported.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Xawo Tako neighbourhood in Beled Weyne in the evening of 12/08. The victim was previously a ASWJ soldier (from Hawadle clan) based in Guri-Ceel. The perpetrators stole the rifle of the victim before escaping from the scene. Local security forces conducted a security operation which extended up to the following day but no arrests were made.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and injured a prominent businessman in Baytu-Raas neighbourhood in Marka in the evening of 12/08. The victim was sitting in front of a local pharmacy when attacked. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Pro-Somali soldiers (not named) based in Ceel Barde attacked al Shabaab position in Garas-Weyne (50km W of Xudur) in the morning of 13/08. The clash lasted for about one and a half hour. Pro-Somali forces seized control of the village for a few hours before returning to Ceel Barde. Report indicates that four soldiers were killed and at least eight other injured. Al Shabaab casualties are unknown
Unidentified armed men shot and killed a soldier stationed in Baraka Market.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at AMISOM forces based in Jaale Siyaad military academy (Hodan district) in the evening of 13/08. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Clashes reported between an unidentified armed group and Al-Shabab militants at the Yacyac locality.

Armed militiamen hailing from the Ayr/Yabar Dhowrakece sub-clan clashed with ASWJ/Sufa militiamen in Dabdheer village (Dhusamareeb District) in the afternoon of 13/08. The confrontation followed a previous clash that had opposed ASWJ militiamen and members of the Yabar Dhowrakece sub-clan in Xananbuure the day before, when ASWJ militiamen attempted to arrest illegal charcoal producers. One person was killed in the clash.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali soldiers on foot patrol in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood in Jowhar in the night of 13/08. Two soldiers were injured. The attackers escaped from the scene. A security operation was conducted after the attack and an unspecified number of persons were arrested.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in the vicinity of Afgooye bridge in the morning of 13/08. The soldier was on foot going to his work station. Somali forces conducted a security operation in the area after the attack and arrested ten suspects.

Three unidentified men wearing military uniforms onboard a Toyota Carib forcefully abducted two young women walking along the former pasta factory (Heliwa District) in the end of the afternoon of 14/08. The whereabouts of the two women is unknown.

KDF soldiers discovered a RCIED along Via Afmadow in Shaqalaha neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 14/08. The device was safely disabled. Telecommunications in the town were switched off during the operation. No casualties were reported. It is not clear what the intended target was.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces guarding the governors' office in Marka in the evening of 14/08. The grenade missed it is target and landed in an empty area. No casualties were reported. The perpetrator(s) escaped from the scene.
A bomb attached to a vehicle belonging to a prominent businessman, Husein Goley, exploded, causing 5 injuries and at least one death.

Unconfirmed reports indicate that unidentified gunmen shot and killed a man who may have been an employee of a humanitarian organization in Sokeela Village (70km NW of Bu'ale) on 15/08. The victim was killed in his house in the village. The motive is unknown.

An IED targeted an AMISOM military convoy at Bar Jowhar area in Heliwa District in the evening of 16/08. One AMISOM truck was reportedly destroyed in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped. Casualties could not be established.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier walking near Mogadishu soccer stadium in Wardhiigley District in the evening of 16/08. The perpetrators escaped.

. A RCIED targeted the car of a local traditional elder in Farjano neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 16/08. The elder and his driver were killed in the explosion. AMISOM and Ras Kaambooni forces cordoned off the area. It remains unclear whether the security forces made any arrest in connection with the blast.

A well known female resident in Dayniile District identified as Dahabo Ali was shot and killed by armed men at approximately 9 p.m. (local time) last night in Isse Abdi neighbourhood. The reason for the attack is not known.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol at Bulaliyasha section of Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 17/08. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed the chairman of Somali Cinema youth organization in Medina District in the evening of 17/08. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.
A journalist is shot and killed at his home in the Kutuba-Xoor neighbourhood of Shibis.
Al-Shabab fighters attacked Mayow Tesow, former Transitional Federal Government's security chief for Baydhabo, at his home, kidnapping him along with other men.
Armed men have killed a local youth leader in charge of young athletes in southern Wadajir. The reason for the attack is unknown.
A female who is said to have been an employee of the local administration's tax collection department is shot and killed in Afgooye District.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in Beytu-Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 17/08. One soldier was reportedly injured in the explosion. The Somali forces managed to arrest the suspected perpetrator.

An unidentified armed man dressed in military uniform shot and killed a soldier in Afar-Irdood neighbourhood (Xamar-Weyne District) in the evening of 18/08.  Soldiers nearby managed to arrest the suspected perpetrator.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed an armed soldier in Carafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 18/08. The perpetrators also took the gun of the slain soldier and escaped.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a Somali government soldier during the evening hours.

Unidentified armed men shot and killed a young man in the vicinity of Hormud Telecommunication office in Berdale neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 18/08. The motive of the killing is currently unknown. Report indicates that the victim had close contact with forces in Baidoa. The perpetrators escaped.

An unidentified perpetrator stabbed and killed a-12-year-old boy near Galkacyo North prison in the afternoon of 18/08. The motive of the killing is unknown. The perpetrator escaped. Reports indicate that the boy hailed from Isaq clan, though it is not clear if clan played into the perpetrator's motivation.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
