NOTES: Somali forces discovered an IED planted between Marion Gate and Police Academy in Hamar Jab Jab District while travelling on this road in the morning of 19/08.  The Somali EOD team dismantled the device safely. Somali/AMISOM forces closed the area during the exercise.

Unidentified armed men dressed in military uniforms shot and killed a civilian man in Ansalatoti Market (Xamar Jab Jab District) in the morning of 19/08. The victim use to deliver meat to hotels in Mogadishu using his donkey cart. The motive of the killing is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw several hand grenades at a military base in Wardhiigley District in the evening of 19/08. The soldiers responded by firing in the suspected directions. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at soldiers on foot patrol at Shaqalaha Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 20/08. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Armed men shot and injured three civilians in Bulo Xawo in the morning of 20/08. The incident occurred after the victims tried to oppose the installation of electrical poles in the town by a businessman escorted by armed men. Reports indicate that shooting is related to a electric company losing their service monopoly in the town.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the residence of the former Hiraan governor, Abdifatah Hassan Afrah, in Kooshin neighbourhood (Beled Weyne) in the evening of 20/08.  The device exploded in front of the house, causing no casualties. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a mini market in Kooshin neighbourhood (Beled Weyne) in the evening of 20/08.  The incident happened a half an hour after the residence of the former governor of Hiraan was targeted with a hand grenade. No casualties were reported. The perpetrator escaped.
The body of unidentified man with gunshot wounds was reportedly discovered in Garsoor neighbourhood (Galkacyo) in the night of 20/08. Puntland police took the body to hospital for investigations.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a NSA soldier in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the night of 20/08. The motive of the killing is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers assaulted the director of Seylac using sticks as he walked home in the night of 21/08.  The motive of the attack is currently unknown. This is the second time the director was attacked this year. The victim was taken to Djibouti for treatment.

Unidentified armed men in a vehicle opened gunfire at a vehicle driven by a female NSA officer in Taleex neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 21/08. Reports indicate that the perpetrators followed the woman for some time before she suspected them as hostile and started driving fast. The attackers then opened fire at her vehicle which led her car to ram into another vehicle. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Gunmen killed two Somalis and wounded a Swedish female politician (Left Party) in Mogadishu. A security guard and driver were killed in the attack. Details obtained about the incident clearly indicate that the attackers were attempting to kidnap the female Swedish national. There is nothing is known about the perpetrators except that they were wearing military uniforms at the time of the attack.

A RCIED planted in a teashop frequented by Somali security forces exploded in Arjantin neighbourhood (Karaan District) in the evening of 21/08. Reports indicate that one soldier and a civilian bystander were killed and six other people were injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed an Imam of a local Mosque in 77 Settlement area (Dayniile District) in the morning of 22/08. The Imam was killed as he headed to the mosque to lead the dawn prayer. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped. This is the first time that an Imam was targeted in Mogadishu.
The residence of the chairman of Bay regional court is targeted with a hand grenade. No report of injury.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Raskamboni forces expel Kismayo residents from their homes and move them outside the city.
An IED targeted a group of French deminers. Causalities not reported.
Gunmen shot dead Amin Ali Mumin, a clan elder and an author of the country's constitution, in Mogadishu's Dharkiinlay district.
Two unidentified gunmen killed the chairman of the Olympic Committee for Mogadishu's Dharkenley district, Amin Ali Mumin.

A body of an unidentified man was found in the vicinity of Sheerbi Village (60 km North of Qardho) in the morning of 24/12. Available reports indicated that the body had knife wounds. The motive and the identity of the perpetrators remain unknown.

An anti-al Shabaab soldier hailing from Ogaden/Maqaabul sub-clan shot and killed his colleague from Bartire/Jidwaaq sub-clan at a check-point close to Kismaayo airport in the morning of 23/08. Reports indicate that the perpetrator was sentenced and executed the same day.

An anti-al Shabaab soldier hailing from Ogaden/Maqaabul sub-clan shot and killed his colleague from Bartire/Jidwaaq sub-clan at a check-point close to Kismaayo airport in the morning of 23/08. Reports indicate that the perpetrator was sentenced and executed the same day.

A device suspected to be an IED exploded in front of anti-al Shabaab forces' base in Tabta Village (75km SW of Afmadow) in the afternoon of 23/08. One soldier was killed in the explosion. The device is believed to have been planted by al Shabaab.

A suspected RCIED was discovered concealed in a pile of stones by security guards in Garowe in the afternoon of 23/08. The device was found in close proximity of a residence of the President of Puntland, of the residence of the Puntland deputy Minister of Security and of an INGO office. The device was successfully disabled though controlled detonation on 24/08.

Unidentified man armed with pistol shot and killed a man hailing from Shekhal clan near Hargeisa soccer stadium in Ahmed Dhagax District (Hargeisa) on 23/08. The motive of the killing is currently unknown. The deputy police commissioner reportedly said the victim came from Mogadishu and had been in Hargeisa for two months.

Unidentified gunmen ambushed and opened fire at a vehicle carrying khat near Guud Cad Village (30km N of Qardho) on 24/08. The vehicle managed to pass the ambush. No casualties were reported. The vehicle had left Galkacyo and was heading to Bosasso when the incident happened.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the residence of the chairman of Bay regional court in Horseed neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 24/08. One the chairman's guard was injured in the blast. The guards responded by firing at the suspected directions. A civilian bystander was injured in the shooting. SNG forces conducted a security operation and arrested a man found with a hand grenade in the area. The security forces also seized several explosives during the operations in Berdale, Isha and ADC neighbourhoods following a tip off from the members of public.

Unidentified armed men opened fire at a group of herbal medicine hawkers comprising of both Somalis and Kenyan nationals in Garboolow Village (20kms NW of Luuq) in the night of 24/08.The reason behind the attack is currently unknown. Two people were injured, among them the chief of the village. Three of the traders (two Somali women and a man) escaped unhurt and their whereabouts are unknown. The perpetrators also took a vehicle belonging to the traders.

Raskamboni forces loyal to Madobe open fire on protesting civilians and destroy their property. Houses were demolished in Bula Abliko which is situated in the outskirts of Kismaayo. Ten injuries reported.

A RCIED exploded at Laami-yaraha road in Afgooye in the afternoon of 24/08 after a private lorry drove over it. Four people in the truck were injured in the blast. Reports indicate that the road is frequented by AMISOM military convoy and it is believed that AMISOM had been the target. Further reports indicate that AMISOM forces disabled two other RCIEDs planted on the same road after a tip off from the public.
Two men armed with AK-47 shot and slightly injured an INGO project officer in his home in Cabud Waaq in the night of 25/08. The attack was reportedly related to a dispute over vehicle hiring.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Radaarka neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 26/08. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces' based in Wadada Jacaylka along SOS neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the night of 27/08. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based in Xerada Tolmada (Hodan District) in the evening of 27/08. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldiers on foot patrol near Sheikh Ali Sufi Mosque (Hodan District) in the evening of 27/08. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED apparently targeting police soldiers exploded followed by another at an interval of five minutes in Caymiska neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 27/08. Reports indicate that the RCIED was planted inside a police post in the neighbourhood. Two police officers were reportedly killed while four others were injured.  AMISOM forces reportedly disabled an IED planted in the same police post.
A large blast targets Ethiopian forces in Beled Wayne. Two civilians were killed in the blast and destroyed businesses premises in the central downtown area.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the residence of the Hiiraan governor, as well as in a marker area. Causalities not reported. Security forces launched a security operation the following day in response to the attacks.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a police officer armed with an AK-47 in Medicine Section of Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 28/08.  The attackers escaped without taking the gun of their victim.  SNG forces arrived at the scene but made no arrest.

A RCIED targeted the vehicle of the deputy District Commissioner of Karaan District in Karaan on the morning of 28/08. The deputy District Commissioner escaped unhurt. A female doctor bystander - working for the Ministry of Health- was reportedly injured in the blast. It is unclear whether the device was attached to the vehicle or planted on the roadside.
Unidentified gunmen assassinate Mogadishu's Kahda District security chief. The attackers and the security chief's bodyguards engaged in a brief shoot-out.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a young woman in Xamar Jadiid (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 28/08. The motive is unknown. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the victim is the daughter of a businesswoman who runs a restaurant frequented by Somali forces in the neighbourhood. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali soldiers' base at the bridge that divides Hanti-Wadaag and Horseed neighbourhoods (Jowhar) in the morning of 28/08. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Two explosions were heard the evening of 29/08 at the Hiliwaa police station causing a "heavy" battle at SOS intersection. Causalities not known. Perpetrators not identified.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a house frequented by MPs and other Somali officials from Habar Gidir sub-clan in Taleex neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 29/08. The house is located near the Turkish Embassy and the residence of Mohamed Siyad Indha Adde-a SNG army general. The security guards responded by opening fire. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government forces on foot patrol in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood in Jowhar in the evening of 29/09. A female bystander was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.
Government soldiers clash with unidentified gunmen in Heliwa district during the evening hours. Causalities not known.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in the livestock market area (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 30/08. The attackers escaped from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a municipal council police officer in Afgooye in the afternoon of 30/08. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a armored personal carrier transporting the Ministry of Interior and Governor of Lower Shabelle Region in the evening of 30/08. The vehicle was slightly damaged but no injuries were reported.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a young man and injured two others in the cigarettes and matches factory (Dayniile District) in the evening of 31/08. The victims were reportedly sitting in front of a shop when they were attacked. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand-grenade against a Somali position in Ceel Dhere neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the night of 31/08. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. The attackers escaped from the scene. No casualties were reported.

Gunmen from the Ayr/Yabar Dhowrakace sub-clan reportedly opened indiscriminate fire at a group of ASWJ soldiers and civilians sitting in front of Bar Dhegacade restaurant in Dhusamareeb in the evening of 31/08. The attack was reportedly in revenge to a killing of a member of the Yabar Dhowrakace sub-clan by ASWJ/Sufa militiamen implementing a ban on charcoal production. The ASWJ police commander (Ayr/Yabar Dhowrakece) who was sitting in the restaurant was killed. Another ASWJ/Sufa militiamen was killed and three other civilians injured. The perpetrators managed to escape. ASWJ authorities imposed a night curfew in the town after the incident.

Somali immigration official Qasim Hassan Takow is killed in a landmine explosion near his home in Mogadishu's Shibis district. Takow was driving when a remote control bomb detonated in his car. The motive for the attack is not known.
Two police officers are killed by unidentified gunmen wearing government military uniform at 15 May Square near Villa Somalia. The perpetrators were later arrested.
Gunmen kill a ASWJ official in Dhusamareb District.

A Raskamboni militiaman opened fire at a group of civilians in Dhoobley in the morning of 01/09. One woman was reportedly injured. The incident was reportedly related to a land dispute between the militiaman and some other residents. The shooter was arrested.

A security guard protecting a local shop was kidnapped by unidentified militiamen in the main market area of Kismaayo in the night of 31/08-01/09. His body was later found in Calanley neighbourhood. The motive of the killing and identity of the perpetrators are unknown.

An unidentified gunman shot and seriously injured a civilian man in Gacan Libaax district in Hargeisa in the night of 01/09. The victim was rushed to Hargeisa Group Hospital for treatment. The motive of the shooting is unknown. The perpetrator escaped from the scene but was arrested one hour later by the police.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 02/09. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in the livestock market area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 02/09. The soldiers reacted by opening fire. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Gunmen from Majeerten/Osman Mohamud/Bah Yacqub clashed with members of the local community in Xabaal-Reer Village (50Km NE Qardho) on 02/09. Reports indicate that the fighting broke out after the gunmen refused to dismantle an illegal checkpoint in the village as instructed by their elders, prompting the locals to attack them. One gunman was injured and another arrested and handed over to Qardho police, while the rest fled.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a Somali soldier and injured another one in Jariirow village (19km NW of Jowhar) in the morning of 02/09. The men also stole the guns of the soldiers. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the soldier may have moved to Jariirow to establish illegal road-blocks or rob transport vehicles that are obliged to leave the main road that is currently cut by floods around Mahadaay.
An unidentified gunman assassinates a soldier.

Three unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two soldiers walking  in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 03/09. The attackers escaped.  Government forces arrived at the scene and launched a security operation but made no arrest.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government forces on foot patrol at Towfiiq Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 03/09. The soldiers responded by opening fire. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators managed to escape.
A clan elder is shot and killed by unidentified gunmen during the evening hours.

Unidentified men hurled a hand grenade at the office of an international private company contracted by a UN agency in Beled Weyne in the evening of 03/09. The motive of the attack is unknown. No casualties were reported. Somali/AMISOM forces conducted a security operation in the area after the blast but made no arrest.

Unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at a Somali government vehicle in Beytu-Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 03/09. The device missed it is target. A bystander (young man) was injured in the explosion.
Two grenade bombs are thrown at the main action offices in located in Hawa Taka suburbs, causing returned gunfire from security guards. No causalities reported.

A group of angry Ras Kaambooni soldiers erected an illegal checkpoint near the state house in Kismaayo in the morning of 04/09. The soldiers reportedly opened fire and killed a civilian. Reports indicate that the soldiers were arrested by the military police.

A RCIED targeted a government convoy transporting delegations coming back from Marka in Shalaambood (Marka District) in the morning of 04/09. Reports indicate that the delegates were part of the president's convoy and were returning to Mogadishu when the attack happened. Two vehicles were slightly damaged.
Security forces discover and disable an IED in Medina District. A person of interest was arrested soon after.
Jarerweyne youths from Boqol Bush IDP camp clashed with local youths using stones and sticks in Laanta Hawada neighbourhood in Bosasso on 06/09. Police forces dispersed the two groups.
At least one person has been confirmed dead and three others injured after a hand grenade was thrown at a restaurant where civilians gathered to spend the evening in Beled Weyne town.
An attack targeting federal government and Amisom [African Union Mission in Somalia] troops in Mogadishu caused 10 casualties. The attack, a heavy explosion, occurred near Arafat Hospital at noon.
A doctor who has associations with al Shabaab is assassinated for reasons unknown.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Jubaland forces in Marine neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 08/09. One soldier was reportedly killed and two others injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based at Bakaara Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 09/09.  One soldier was reportedly killed and two others injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

An AMISOM soldier in military uniform was found dead along the seaside (about 200m) from the International Camp, inside within the AMISOM protected area in Mogadishu Airport (Medina District) in the morning of 09/09. Although the cause of his death was not identified, reports indicate that the body had bruises.

Heavy fighting between government forces and an unnamed enemy at Kismayo airport. The official figures of the casualties caused by the bombardment have not been released as troops based in the region launched security operations in the early hours of the following morning.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on patrol l in the vicinity of the former prison in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the evening of 09/09. No casualties were reported.
Unidentified attackers shot and killed a Somali soldier in Hawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the afternoon of 09/09. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police officers collecting taxes from business centres in the gold section of Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 10/09/2013. The officers reportedly fired back after the explosion. A female civilian was reported killed and four others persons - including several policemen - were injured. The attackers escaped from the scene.
An explosion hit a mini-bus at Ex-Control Balcad area Heliwa District in the morning of 10/09. The explosion damaged the rear side of the mini-bus. No casualties were reported.
Kenyan AMISOM forces come under attack in Bilis Qooqaani, three reported deaths.

A RCIED, planted at the water point in Billis Qooqaani (48km SW of Afmadow) exploded in the morning after KDF/AMISOM forces reached the area to draw water. One KDF soldier sustained minor injuries while. The blast also destroyed a KDF vehicle.

Heavy confrontations between the Ras Kambooni militia and armed men believed to be Al-Shabab fighters occurred in the Kismaayo airport. The attacks are believed to have caused causalities, but the exact numbers are not known.
Hand grenade attacks against a military base reported in a Marka. Perpetrators not known. Causalities not known.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against a police outpost in Beytu Raas neighbourhood in Marka town in the evening of 10/09/2013. The police officers fired back after the blast. Casualties are unknown. A security operation was conducted in the area after the attack but no arrests were made.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle belonging to the director of the tax department of Dayniile district in Ciise Abdi neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 11/09/2013, Reports indicate the device had been placed in the vehicle of the target and exploded immediately after the official boarded his vehicle. The vehicle was damaged but the official escaped unharmed. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali policemen on foot patrol in Hawl-Wadaag junction area in the afternoon of 11/09/2013. The policemen opened fire and arrested the attacker. Two civilian bystanders were injured.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldiers manning a security outpost close to SOS junction (Heliwa District) in the evening of 11/09/2013, The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Casualties are unknown. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand at Somali police officers walking on Jamahuuriya road (Kaaraan District) in the night of 11/09/2013. The grenade reportedly landed in an empty space causing no casualties. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade attack against Somali forces based in the former Central Bank building in Horseed neighbourhood in Baidoa in the evening of 11/09/2013. The soldiers fired back after the blast. Two civilians bystanders were reportedly injured. The attackers escaped from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a traditional elder at SOS Junction (Heliwa District) in the evening of 12/09. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Marka police station in Saraha neighbourhood (Marka) in the evening of 13/09.  The police opened fire in retaliation. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a civilian man in Ex-control Balcad area (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 14/09. The reason behind the killing is currently unknown. The attackers escaped.

Al Shabaab fighters launched a hit and run attack against anti-al Shabaab fighters (not identified) in Wargaduudo Village near Ceel-Cadde, (50km SW of Garbahaarey) in the evening of 14/09. One anti-al Shabaab soldier was killed in the clash. Al Shabaab casualties could not be established.
Unknown gunmen (possibly Raskamboni forces) killed Jubbaland elder and businessman Noor Olad Gamadid in Kismayo. The motive for the attack is not known.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Hawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the evening of 14/05.  Reports indicate that the victim was heading to his home when he was attacked. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a soldier on foot at Sheikh Abrone neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 14/09. The soldier responded by opening fire. Three civilians were injured in the shooting. Reports indicate one of the injured (a woman) later succumbed to her injuries in the hospital. The perpetrators escaped.

ACTOR1: SSC: Sool, Sanaag and Cayn Militia
NOTES: SSC/Khaatumo militias launched attacked Somaliland forces based in Gambadha Village (29km NE of Laas Caanood) in the night of 14/09. The attackers fired AK-47 and RPGs fire. Somaliland forces responded with anti-aircraft guns and mortars in the clash which lasted for five minutes, after which the attackers withdrew. One Somaliland soldier was injured in the clash.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: CID officers detained the spokesman of ASWJ, at the CID headquarters in Hodan District in the morning of 15/09. Reports indicate that the spokesman was arrested after being summoned by the CID. The reason behind his arrest is unclear. Further reports indicate that he was later released.

Unidentified body of a boy was found near the city's old water tank (Kismaayo) in the morning of 15/09. The identity and motive of the perpetrators are unknown. Local authorities transported the body to the morgue for identification.
An armed man shot at the residence of Puntland's minister of finance in the night of 15/09. The motive is unknown.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police on foot patrol at Baar Ubah Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 16/09. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Two civilian bystanders were reportedly injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified gunmen wearing government military uniform shot and killed a Ayr Clan elder in Mogadishu.
Two groups of pro-SNG militias (not identified) clashed briefly in Buulo-Jaan neighbourhood in Marka in the afternoon of 16/09 after suspecting each other as hostile. No casualties were reported.
Two groups of pro-SNG militias (not identified) clashed briefly in Buulo-Jaan neighbourhood in Marka in the afternoon of 16/09 after suspecting each other as hostile. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a prominent businessman in Taleex neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the morning of 17/09. The motive is unknown. The victim hails from Habar Gidir/Ayanle sub-clan and was a close relative of the NSA commander in the neighbourhood. Reports indicate the victim was involved in negotiations to release Sheikh Hasan Dahir Aweys, a former al Shabaab official detained by Somali forces. The perpetrators escaped.
Unknown armed gunmen killed a local Somali elder in Mogadishu's KM4 intersection. The motive behind the murder is yet to be established.

A young Somali man was shot and killed in Mogadishu while on his way home the evening of 17/09. The victim who does not represent or work for the government or any agency is the brother of a police officer.

Unidentified persons threw a hand grenade at a government military base located at the outskirts of Jowhar, causing a number of causalities. Government soldiers opened heavy gunfire after the explosion occurred.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali/AMISOM base in the livestock market area (Heliwa District) in the night of 19/09. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle of a SNA officer in Waxara Cadde neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the morning of 19/09. Reports indicate that the officer and his body guards entered a residential house in the neighbourhood and the device was detonated while they were inside the house. It is unclear whether the device was attached to the vehicle or planted on the roadside. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Shalaambood Village (9km NW of Marka) in the morning of 19/09. The victim was unarmed when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a SNG military vehicle in Ciise Abdi neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the afternoon of 20/09. The soldiers in the vehicle opened fire after the blast. Casualties could not be established. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based at Shaqaalaha Junction (Waberi District) in the night of 20/09. No casualty was reported. The soldiers arrested a man they suspected of throwing the grenade.
A group of unidentified men killed a woman who was selling khat.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police based at Hawl-Wadaag Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the morning of 21/09. Police opened fire after the blast. Two civilian passersby were reportedly wounded in the explosion.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces inside Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the morning of 21/09. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the targets were foreigners (Yemen and Turkish nationals) shopping in the market. Two soldiers and a civilian woman were confirmed dead and three others injured. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces inside Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the morning of 21/09. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the targets were foreigners (Yemen and Turkish nationals) shopping in the market. Two soldiers and a civilian woman were confirmed dead and three others injured. The attackers escaped.

Suspected al Shabaab fighters shot and killed four militia men loyal to Barre Hiraale at a check-point in outskirts of Gobweyne Village (14km NE of Kismaayo) in the morning of 21/09. The motive is unknown.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a man hailing from Darood/Lelkase sub-clan and injured two other people sitting in a tea shop in Garsoor neighbourhood (Galkacyo North) in the evening of21/09. Reports indicate that the perpetrators had been targeting a prominent pharmacist who is the brother of the victim and was also in the tea shop. Reports say that the pharmacist had received several death threat calls from unidentified callers. The targeted man escaped unharmed. The motive of the attack is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified armed men shot and injured a MP in Buulo Hubey neighbourhood (Medina District) in the evening of 22/09. The MP succumbed to his injuries in a Mogadishu hospital later. Reports indicate the attackers were in a vehicle and managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers shot and killed a soldier in Ceel Jilibey area in Berdale neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the night of 22/09. The perpetrators dumped the body of their victim in water well in the neighbourhood. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the residence of a former MP in Farjano neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 21/09. A woman working in the compound was injured in the blast. The former MP was not in the house by the time of the attack. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an ENDF water bowser fetching water in Qansax Dhere in the morning of 22/09. Unconfirmed reports  indicate  that  one ENDF soldier was killed and four others were injured in the blast. The attackers escaped.

A man shot and killed a Jubaland soldier in Baar Caleen neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 23/09. Reports indicate that the motive was in revenge of a soldier killed on 30/09 over Khat dispute. Military police engaged in a gunfight with the perpetrator who was hiding in a house in the neighbourhood but he managed to escape. Two people were injured in the shootout.

A RCIED targeted a military vehicle in Hawa Tako neighbourhood  (Afgooye) in the morning of 23/09. The soldiers in the vehicle opened fire after the blast. Three soldiers were reportedly injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.
A bomb plated near a police station Afgooye detonates killed two security forces and injures six others.

Unidentified perpetrators hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in Godey neighbourhood (Karaan District) in the evening of 24/09. The soldiers responded by opening fire. Reports indicate that the device hit a perimeter wall of a nearby shop. Casualties are unknown. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali police guarding the District Commissioner's office in Waberi District in the evening of 24/09. Reports indicate that the device landed on an empty space. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at an empty area between Golis Telecommunication Company and Abu Huraryra Mosque in Israac neighbourhood (Galkacyo North) in the evening of 24/09. No casualty was reported. The motive and the target of the attack were not clear. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM military truck in Ceel Jaale Village (7km SW of Marka) in the afternoon of 24/09. The explosion hit the rear side of the truck and reportedly caused a big damage. Casualties could not be established.
Locals in Ruun-Nirgood Village (64km SE of Aadan -Yabaal) clashed with al Shabaab in the afternoon of 25/09. The reason behind the clash is currently unclear. Casualties could not be established.

The body of a Jubaland soldier discovered near the beach in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 25/09. The identity and the motive of the perpetrators are unknown. Reports indicate that the victim had a record of harassing civilians and was behind the previous attack against the body guard of the vice-president of Jubaland.

An unidentified body of a man was discovered in Argo area in Fanoole neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 25/09. The identity and the motive of the perpetrators are unknown. Jubaland forces conducted a search operation and arrested seven Somali soldiers staying in a house near the scene where the body was found.
Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a government soldier in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the afternoon of 26/09. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a base of pro-ASWJ forces in Jaayga Ceeldheere neighbourhood in (Dharkeynley District) in the night of 28/09. The forces responded with gunfire but no casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a base of pro-ASWJ forces in Jaayga Ceeldheere neighbourhood in (Dharkeynley District) in the night of 28/09. The forces responded with gunfire but no casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in the livestock market (Heliwa District) in the morning of 28/09. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. A civilian bystander was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols attempted to assassinate a local journalist near Indian Ocean University in Bulo Huubey neighbourhood (Medina District) in the evening of 28/09.  The journalist reportedly said the gunmen were dressed in government military uniforms and tried to kill him as he walked out of his home. Somali forces arrived after the perpetrators had already escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government forces in Gubta (Dayniile District) in the evening of 29/09. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Two soldiers were injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian woman in Suuq Bacoole neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 29/09. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government forces based in Abdi Wayeel Cinema area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 29/09. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based at SOS Junction (Heliwa District) in the evening of 29/09. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. One soldier was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police on foot patrol in Israac neighbourhood (Xamar Jab Jab District) in the evening of 30/09. Reports indicate that the hand grenade missed the target and landed in an empty area. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in Ex-control Balcad neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the evening of 30/09.  AMISOM forces opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Police shot and injured a man whom they suspected of planning to hurl a hand grenade at Turkish nationals constructing the road in 1st March neighbourhood (Waberi District) in the evening of 30/09. Reports indicate that the police later shot and killed the suspect after they found him with a hand grenade. No other casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali police manning a security outpost in Lafoole settlement (Afgooye District) in the evening of 30/09. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: ASWJ police on 01/10 arrested the self-declared president of Gal-Hiraan and Xarardhere state, in Guri Ceel (Dhusamareeb District). The police also arrested his minister of internal affairs.  The ASWJ administration accused him of trying to destabilize ASWJ-controlled areas after holding a political meeting in Guri Ceel.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed an armed a police officer near the livestock market (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 02/10.  The perpetrators also stole the gun of their victim and escaped.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Taleex neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the morning of 02/09. The victim was the commander of the SNG police protecting the staff of a Turkish company constructing roads in Mogadishu. The attackers also stole the victim's pistol and escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade into the residence of a local district official in Wekio Stadium neighbourhood (Shibis District) in the evening of 02/09. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.

A RCIED planted under a tree in a residential house in Farjano neighbourhood (Kismaayo) exploded in the afternoon of 02/10. The house is frequented by traditional elders and officials from Absame clan.  Reports indicate that the elders had left the scene when the device went off. No casualties were reported. Further reports indicate that another unexploded IED was removed from the house. The identity of the perpetrators remain unclear.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldiers on patrol in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the night of 02/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. One soldier was injured in the blast. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified attackers and police exchanged gunfire briefly in Hawa Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the morning of 02/10. A civilian was killed after he was hit by a stray bullet.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in Bulo-Jaan neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 02/10. The convoy was escorting a water bowser by the time of the attack. Reports indicate that the device missed its target. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

An RCIED targeted a military pick-up patrolling the road between Shalaambood and Buufow Bacaad villages (Marka District) in the afternoon of 02/09. A number of soldiers were killed and others injured. The perpetrators escaped.
A group of four boys stoned a boy to death in Sheedaha area (Koodbuur District) in the evening of 02/10. The motive is unknown.
A landmine blast targets AMISOM soldiers at Makundi locality in Baidoa town. Somali government soldiers responded to the attack and made several arrests. Causalities list not reported.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a soldier collecting tax near the fish market in Aw-baalle neighbourhood in the morning of 03/10. The soldier was injured by the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers shot and injured an Imam sitting in front of a mosque in Macruuf area, Bulo-Hubey neighbourhood (Wadajir District) in the evening of 04/10. Reports indicate that the assailants fired four bullets but the victim managed to run into the mosque with injuries. The perpetrators escaped.

Anti-al Shabaab forces (not named) conducted a security operation outside Kismaayo town and clashed with AS in Goob Weyn Village (14km NE of Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 04/10.  Reports indicate that two anti-al Shabaab soldiers were injured while two al Shabaab fighters were captured during the clash.
Unidentified persons attack a private residence with a hand grenade. The reason for the attack is presumed to be related to be an vengeance.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade into a residence of a local man hailing from Badhiban clan in Garsoor neighbourhood (Galkacyo North) in the evening of 05/10. A boy was killed and five other civilians were reportedly injured in the explosion.
A RCIED targeted an AMISOM military convoy in Bariire Village (27km SW of Afgooye) in the afternoon of 05/10. No casualties were reported.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Dharkeynley Police Station (Dharkeynley District) in the night of 06/10. The device landed in an open area, casing no casualties. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a soldiers' position between Abdi Wayeel Cinema and Livestock Market (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 06/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Reports indicate that the device missed its target. No casualties were reported.

Two anti-al Shabaab soldiers (affiliation not named) exchanged gunfire following dispute believed to be related to extortion money at road-block in Bulo Barwaqo Village near Dhoobley in the morning of 06/10. One soldier died while the other sustained injuries.

Two anti-al Shabaab soldiers (affiliation not named) exchanged gunfire following dispute believed to be related to extortion money at road-block in Bulo Barwaqo Village near Dhoobley in the morning of 06/10. One soldier died while the other sustained injuries.

Unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at a residential house in Farjano neighbourhood in the evening of 06/10. Reports indicate that the house is frequented by Jubaland forces. This is the second time in a week that the house was targeted with hand grenades. A woman was injured in the blast. The perpetrator escaped.

A civilian truck transporting building materials hit a land mine in an area close to Haji Jamac Mosque in Fanoole neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 06/10. Reports indicate that three people were injured in the explosion. There are no details on whether the truck was the actual target or not.

A RCIED targeted anti-al Shabaab soldiers seated in a teashop in Bulo-Xawo in the evening of 07/10. The device was planted in the tea-shop which is frequented by the soldiers. The local police commander and a soldier were killed in the attack while three others, including civilian, were wounded. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted anti-al Shabaab soldiers seated in a teashop in Bulo-Xawo in the evening of 07/10. The device was planted in the tea-shop which is frequented by the soldiers. The local police commander and a soldier were killed in the attack while three others, including civilian, were wounded. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldier in Shalaambood Village (Marka) in the evening of 07/10. The soldier died on the spot. The perpetrators escaped. Somali soldiers arrived at the scene and launched a security operation but made no arrest.

A IED targeted a Somali military vehicle in Shalaambood Village (Marka District) in the afternoon of 07/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported in the explosion as well as the shooting. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Three people were killed and three others injured in an explosion that targeted a small coffee shop near the central police station in Beled Hawo. Among the dead include two police officers and a civilian, others wounded. Other sources claim all victims were members of security forces.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at AMISOM (Djiboutian contingent) on patrol in Xawo Tako neighbourhood (Beled Weyne) in the night of 08/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Two civilian bystanders were injured in the blast and the subsequent shooting. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified armed militias attacked soldiers in Aw Dheegle Village 37km SW of Afgooye) in the morning of 08/10. The fighting lasted for about 20 minutes after which the attackers withdrew. Two soldiers were killed and three injured in the clash.

Unidentified attacker threw a hand grenade at District Commissioner's residential house in Beytu Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 08/10. One soldier on guard was injured in the blast. Other soldiers in the area conducted a security operation and arrested several persons they suspected of being behind the attack. Reports indicate that the soldiers confiscated some properties from the houses they searched. The perpetrators escaped.
A group of youngsters stabbed and seriously injured a girl for unknown reason at liberty garden in Hargeisa in the evening 08/10. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at security forces at the Hawl-Wadaag Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 09/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. A passerby woman was reportedly wounded in the explosion. The perpetrator managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers shot and killed a civilian man in the medicine section of Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 09/10. The motive is unknown.  The victim was a drug store owner. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the residence of a military officer in Jiiro Wacbudhan area (Kaaraan District) in the evening of 09/10. His security guards opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Nine pro-Somali government forces (not identified) attacked al Shabaab fighters based in Adeegow Village (41km NW of Baidoa) in the afternoon of 09/10. Reports indicate that three pro-Somali soldiers and 12 al Shabaab fighters were killed in the clash. One pro-Somali soldier went missing.

Anti-al Shabaab forces launched an attack against al Shabaab fighters in Qansax Oomane Village (Luuq District) in the morning of 09/10. Unconfirmed reports indicate that ENDF took part in the offensive. Casualties from both sides could not be established.

Unidentified attacker threw a hand grenade at District Commissioner's residential house in Beytu Raas neighbourhood (Marka) for the second time in two days. It is not clear if this was the same group of attackers from the previous day.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at General Kahiye Police Station in Xamar Jab Jab District in the evening of 10/10. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A hand grenade was hurled at Sarindi centre (Xamar Jab Jab District) in the evening of 10/10. Sarindi is a centre run by the Somali government to rehabilitate al Shabaab defectors. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled two hand grenades at Xamar Weyne Police Station (Xamar Weyne/Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 10/10. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled two hand grenades at Somali forces at Dabka Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 10/10. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Armed men dressed in Somali government military uniforms opened fire at workers working at a construction site in the livestock market (Heliwa District) after the workers refused to pay extortion money to the armed men. Two workers were injured. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces at Saydinka Junction (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 10/10. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a AMISOM/KDF APC in Balacaad neighbourhood in Kismaayo in the morning of 10/10. No casualties were reported but the APC was damaged. Jubaland forces arrested a woman they suspected of being behind the attack. Unconfirmed reports indicate the perpetrators were waiting in a minibus, close to the scene and detonated the device after the APC slowed at the scene. The minibus then drove away.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Beytu Raas neighbourhood in the evening of 10/10. The deceased was a porter and reportedly used to talk about the insecurity incidents in public places. The perpetrators escaped.
Several explosion are reported at Dabka junction and Taalada Sayidka in Hamar Jabjab. No report of causality.

Armed men believed to be part of the anti-al Shabaab forces attacked and injured a local administration official and his body guards in Bulo-Xawo in the midday of 11/10. The motive is unknown. The victims were taken to Mandera Hospital (Kenya) for treatment.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali soldiers on foot patrol in Buulo-Ceelay neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 11/10. Reports indicate that the device missed it is target and landed in an empty place. The soldiers reacted by opening fire. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
A IED planted in a Restaurant frequented by Somali government forces in Wanla Weyne detonated in the evening of 11/10.  Two soldiers and two civilians were injured in the blast.

The Somali police exchanged gunfire with a gunman dressed in military uniform who had set up an illegal checkpoint and extorting money from motorists in Dabakayo Madow neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the morning of 12/10. Police attacked the gunman after motorists tipped them about his activities in the area. A female bystander was killed and three other people including the gunman were injured in the shoot-out. Police also arrested the suspect and took him to the CID headquarters.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed three civilian men sitting in a tea shop in Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 12/10. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.
A trader operating at Bakaaraha market is shot and killed along with three others. The reason for the attack is not known.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and wounded a civilian man hailing from Majeerten/ Siwaaqron sub-clan in the evening of 13/10. The victim was sitting in a tea shop near his home when he got shot. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based in the former perfume factory (Heliwa District) in the evening of 14/10. The soldiers responded by opening fire. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Pro-Somali soldiers (not identified) launched an attack against al Shabaab fighters based in Qaydar Cade (27km NW of Xudur) in the afternoon of 15/10. The clash lasted for about 25 minutes after which pro-Somali forces took over the control of the village. Three al Shabaab fighters and one pro-Somali soldier were injured in the clash. Reports indicate that the pro-Somali forces executed the injured al Shabaab fighters. They then headed to Ceel Barde.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a soldier in Ali Turaaye neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the evening of 15/10. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified assailants threw two grenades at the Galkayo offices of Radio Daljir, causing property damage but no injury.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the privately-owned Radio Daljir in Israac neighbourhood (Galkacyo North) in the evening of 15/10. The motive is unknown. The station's security guards opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in the vegetable market of Shalaambood Village (Marka District) in the evening of 15/10. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A dead body of a Somali soldier was found in Siinka-Dheer area (Dayniile District) in the evening of 16/10. Reports indicate that the victim left the base with his colleague who was not seen since then. It is unclear whether the dead soldier was killed by his colleague or not.

Unidentified perpetrators hurled a hand grenade at a private residence of a Somali forces' officer near the former military hospital in Trebunka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 16/10. The device hit a perimeter wall nearby causing no casualties. Soldiers opened fire after the blast. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Hodan District Commissioner's Office (Hodan District) in the evening of 16/10. The device reportedly landed in an empty place causing no casualty. Security forces arrived conducted a security operation in the area but made no arrest. The perpetrators escaped.
A lone gunman shot and killed three people and injured eight others at a wedding party in the Ceel Xadi area of northern Somalia's breakaway Somaliland region. The motive for the attack is not clear.

An identified man stabbed and killed a woman hailing from Madhiban clan in Gacan Libah District (Hargeisa) in the night of 16/10. The woman walked out of her house when a man rushed towards her. She tried to run back to the house but the perpetrator caught up with her and stabbed her twice. The motive is unknown. The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a municipal council tax collector in Sheikh Abrone neighbourhood (Marka) in the evening of 17/10. One soldier was injured by the blast and later succumbed to his injuries as he was being rushed to Mogadishu. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government forces in Siinka Dheer (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 18/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Reports indicate that one soldier was killed and two others were injured. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the residence of the deputy District Commissioner of Fanoole neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 18/10. One woman believed to be his wife and two children were injured in the blast. The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Shalaambood Village (Marka District) in the evening of 18/10. The motive behind the killing is currently unknown. Reports indicate that the victim used to sell khat to government soldiers. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw three hand grenades at a house near the former milk factory (Hodan District) in the evening of 19/10. Reports indicate that the targeted house was serves as a store for Turkish construction workers. Security guards at the store reportedly opened fire at the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified assailants shot and kill a civilian in Hodan district.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at police on foot patrol in Jamhuuriya neighbourhood (Karaan District) in night of 19/10. The soldiers responded by opening fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a government soldier in Fagax Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 19/10. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified assailants shot and kill a police officer in Yaaqshid district.

Unidentified perpetrators armed with pistols shot and killed three men dressed in military uniform in Tawakal neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 19/10. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the victims were involved in an armed robbery at the time of the attack. The attackers escaped.
Unidentified armed men shot and killed the former chairman of Absame IDP camp in Bosasso in the evening of 19/10. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Tensions ran high in Dhoobley town after an anti-al Shabaab soldier hailing from Mohamed Zubeyr/Reer Isaq-Ali sub-clan who earlier killed another anti-AS soldier (Mohamed Zubeyr/Reer/Isaq-Harun sab-clan was killed  on 19/10. Reports indicate that the two sub-clans were supposed to negotiate on blood compensation but the murderer was killed over night and his body dumped on the roadside, contrary to the agreement on public execution.

Tensions ran high in Dhoobley town after an anti-al Shabaab soldier hailing from Mohamed Zubeyr/Reer Isaq-Ali sub-clan who earlier killed another anti-AS soldier (Mohamed Zubeyr/Reer/Isaq-Harun sab-clan was killed  on 19/10. Reports indicate that the two sub-clans were supposed to negotiate on blood compensation but the murderer was killed over night and his body dumped on the roadside, contrary to the agreement on public execution.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based at Xero Agoon in Baar Ismail neighbourhood in the night of 19/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted government soldiers sitting in a teashop in Ceelasha Biyaha (Afgooye District) in the afternoon of 19/10. The RCIED was reportedly planted in the teashop which is frequented by soldiers. One soldier was reportedly killed while three others were injured. The attackers escape

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the residence of Marka District Commissioner in Beytu Raas neighbourhood in the evening of 19/10. The DC's guards opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Two unidentified men armed with AK-47 rifles riding in a Toyota Surf shot and injured a businessman in Laas Caanood on 19/10. The motive is unknown. The victim hails from Dhulbahante clan. Reports indicate that the perpetrators are believed to be Dhulbahante. The attackers escaped towards the direction of Taleex.
A government soldier is shot and killed by two unidentified armed men.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government police on foot patrol near Biyo Mallow Mosque (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 21/10. The police opened fire after the blast. A police officer and a woman bystander were injured in the blast. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Miir police station in Horumar neighbourhood (Galkacyo North) in the evening of 21/10. Police opened fire after the blast. A woman was killed in the shooting while a police officer was injured in the blast. The attackers managed to escape.

An unidentified man armed with a pistol shot at a MP from Justice and Welfare Party(UCID) in Jigjiga Yar neighbourhood (Hargeisa) in the evening of 21/10. The attacker, however, missed his target and fled. The motive is unclear. Reports indicate that the MP is strongly opposed to President Silanyo's administration and recently urged the president to go for a medical checkup to ascertain his health status on whether he can run the country. On 22/10, Justice and Welfare Party (UCID) strongly condemned the incident and urged the police to bring the person (s) behind the attack to justice.
Unknown gun men attacked and injured television reporter in Medina District. The man died of his injuries several days later.
A hit-and-run attack targets a AMISOM/Somali position on the east side of the city. Causalities not known.

Pro-government forces (not identified) based in Ceel Barde conducted a security operation in Ceel Garas Village (37km NE of Xudur) in the evening of 23/10. The soldiers reportedly killed one al Shabaab fighters during the operation and took his gun.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali soldiers based at the bridge that divides Buulo-Sheekh and Horseed neighbourhoods in Jowhar in the evening of 22/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government soldiers based at Baar-Ismail checkpoint (Afgooye) in the evening of 23/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Two soldiers were injured by the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali forces based in Dabakayo Madow neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 24/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Xeraryale neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the night of 24/10. Reports indicate that the victim had a close link with SNA. The perpetrators escaped.

Two groups of anti-al Shabaab forces (not identified) clashed in Luuq in the evening of 24/10 after one of the groups tried to set up an illegal checkpoint to extort money from motorists. One soldier was injured in the shoot-out.

Two groups of anti-al Shabaab forces (not identified) clashed in Luuq in the evening of 24/10 after one of the groups tried to set up an illegal checkpoint to extort money from motorists. One soldier was injured in the shoot-out.
Unidentified attackers throw a pair of hand grenades at a police checkpoint, four killed, fourteen injured. The target may have been a tax collector.

Unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at Jubaland forces based at the former meat factory in Gulwade neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 24/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. The soldiers also cordoned off the area for about one and half an hour and conducted a security a security operation. It remains unclear whether they made arrests or not.

A RCIED targeted Somali soldiers in a military pick-up on patrol in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the morning of 25/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Two soldiers were killed and three others were injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.

A RCIED targeted Somali forces at Dahablaha section of Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the morning of 25/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Unknown numbers of civilians were reportedly injured in the shooting. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified perpetrators threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based in Biyo-Deeganka area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 25/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Ahlu Sunna Wal Jama'a militia and Somali government soldiers clash. The SNG soldiers were apparently trying to secure a position in Ahmed Madobe's administration through force. Two combatants were killed.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM military convoy passing through the livestock market (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 26/10. An AMISOM water bowser was badly damaged by the explosion. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.
An armed man shot and killed a notable businessman for unknown reason.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Jubaland forces based along the airport road in Iskufilan neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 26/10. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED exploded pre-maturely in Yasin Market, close to the former meat factory (Kismaayo) in the morning of 26/10. People going to the mosque for dawn prayer saw it and placed stones near the device to warn others. The device went off later and caused no casualties.
The body a civilian man was found in Yaaq Biri Weyne in the night of 26/10. The deceased was reportedly a former al Shabaab defector. The body had gunshot wounds.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the residence of a local judge in Berdale neighbourhood in Baidoa in the evening of 27/10. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government soldiers based in Macmacanka neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 28/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED targeted a two- vehicle convoy from a local private company, which was carrying a third party UN contractor and in Caymiska area (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 28/10. A civilian woman bystander was injured in the attack.  The second vehicle was slightly damaged by the explosion.  Reports indicate that a Somali military pick-up, which was ahead of the convoy, was the target of the RCIED.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and seriously injured a military officer in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the evening of 28/10.  The victim had left a tea-shop when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted Somalia forces' convoy travelling along the road between Ceelasha Biyaha settlement and K13 (Afgooye District) in the afternoon of 28/10. The device hit one of the vehicles. Casualty figures could not be established. Perpetrators managed to escape. The convoy was heading to Mogadishu when the incident happened.

Pro-government forces on patrol clashed briefly with al Shabaab fighters in Gubadka village (48km SE of Rabdhuure) in the afternoon of 29/10. Reports indicate that two al Shabaab fighters were killed and another was wounded.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government soldiers based in Dabakayo Madow neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 29/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. A civilian bystander was reportedly injured in the explosion. The perpetrators managed to escape.

An RCIED targeted a Somali forces' vehicle along General Da'ud road in Wardhiigley District in the afternoon of 29/10. Two soldiers were injured in the blast. The vehicle was also damaged. The perpetrators escaped.

A vehicle carrying members of the security forces of the federal government was blown up in Arafat neighbourhood, Yaaqshiid District, Mogadishu. The vehicle, a pickup truck, was hit by a roadside bomb, killing most of the soldiers riding in it and wounding a few. No specific numbers provided.

Unidentified attackers hurled two hand grenades at Jubaland forces in Gulwade area of Shaqaalaha neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 29/10. A soldier was injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Four combatants have been killed after Al-Shabab and Ras Kambooni clashed near Kismaayo airport in southern Somalia. Reports say the fighting started after Al-Shabab attacked Ras Kambooni and a Kenyan army base positioned at the airport.

A RCIED targeted a Somali government forces' convoy in Siinka Dheer area (Afgooye District) in the evening of 29/10. The explosion missed its target. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against police officers manning a checkpoint close to Afar Irdood police station in Xamar Weyne District in the night of 31/10.  One policeman was reportedly wounded. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a policeman who was busy collecting tax in Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the morning of 31/10. The perpetrators escaped.

An Unidentified attacker threw a hand grenade at government soldiers manning a security check-point in Biyo Degaanka area (Heliwa District) in the night of 31/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. One soldier was wounded. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed an unarmed NSA officer in the livestock market in Heliwa District in the afternoon of 31/10. The motive of the killing is unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against police officers on foot patrol near KPP junction in Hodan district in the night of 31/10. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified gunmen armed with AK-47s shot and killed a NSA officer in Ceymiska neighbourhood in the evening of 31/10. The motive of the killing is unknown. The attackers escaped after taking the gun of the victim.

Six are dead in a clash between Puntalnd forces and Galmudug militia in the town of Godod. The clash began after Puntland officials accused Somali Federal Government of arming the militia "to destabilize Puntland."

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against the residence of the Luuq District Commissioner on 01/11/2013. The grenade landed in the compound but did not explode. The motivation of the attackers is unknown.

Unidentified gunmen ambushed a campaign vehicle belonging to one of the presidential candidates in Puntland near Burtinle on 01/11. The gunmen opened fire at vehicle. Two passengers were reportedly injured in the attack. The gunmen carjacked the vehicle and also abducted the driver. The presidential candidate whose team was attacked, Abdiweli Mohamed Gass, a former SNG prime minister, condemned the attack. In a press statement issued on 02/11, Mr. Gass accused President Abdirahman Mohamed Farole of being behind the incident. He described the attack as President's Farole's "scare tactic to create insecurity" aimed to derail the election process. Puntland MPs will go to poll to elect a new president on 08/01/2014.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier on his way home in Beytu Raas neighbourhood in Marka in the afternoon of 01/11. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy and destroyed a water tanker in Ruusiya neighbourhood in Marka on 01/11/2013. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Casualties could not be established. The attackers escaped from the scene.

NSA forces conducted a security operation targeting a specific house in Nasteexo neighbourhood (Wadajir District) in the evening of 02/11. Security forces exchanged fire with, and killed a gunman in the course of the operation. Five persons including a madrassa teacher were arrested.

Somalia's Criminal Investigation Department headquarters' guards shoot dead a luxury vehicle driver after he refused to stop. The car was suspected to be planning suicide explosion attack against the headquarters.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier close to the ex-Pasta factory (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 02/11. The motive of the killing is unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against AMISOM forces in Ruusiya neighbourhood in Marka District in the evening of 02/11/2013. The AMISOM soldiers were guarding a water tanker that had been destroyed by a RCIED on 01/11. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian woman near Al-Baraka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 03/11. The motive of the killing is unclear but reports indicate that the victim used to run a tea-shop frequented by SNG forces. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a government soldier in Juungaal neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 03/11. The motive of the killing is unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces on foot patrol in the eastern side of Beled Weyne in the night of 03/11. No casualties reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.
Unidentified attackers opened fire at two Jubaland soldiers in Guulwaade neighbourhood in Kismaayo in the morning of 03/10. One soldier was injured. The attackers escaped from the scene.

RCIED exploded in the main market in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 03/11. One civilian was killed and several others injured. The target of the attack is unclear. Phone networks were switched off for two hours after the blast and a number of road-blocks were erected. No arrests were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a residence of a member of Somali forces near Dabaqeynka Mosque (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 04/11. The device missed its target and landed in an empty area, causing no casualties. Soldiers in the house opened fire after the blast. The attackers managed to escape.
A man who was a staff of the Planning Ministry's census department was shot an killed by unidentified persons. It is not clear if the target of the attack was the government official.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed an employee of the Ministry of Health (and former UN and INGO casual staff) in Moalim Nuur cemetery area (Wadajir/Medina District) in the afternoon of 04/11. The man was reportedly involved in a community policing project implemented by the Banadir regional administration.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a traditional elder in Towfiiq neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 04/11. The motive is unknown. The attackers escaped.  Government forces in the neighbourhood conducted a security operation and arrested a number of people they suspected of being behind the murder.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a civilian man in the vicinity of Bar Aleen in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 04/11. The motive is currently unclear. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District)in the morning of 05/11. The attackers escaped.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two unarmed SNA officers near Olympic Telecommunication in Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 05/11. The assailants escaped.
Unidentified gunmen shot dead two Somali policemen in Bakara market in the afternoon of 05/11. A soldier had been killed in the market earlier in the day.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man near Hareed Mosque in Hawl-Wadaag District in the afternoon of 05/11. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

An IED targeted a vehicle belonging to a SNA officer in Arjatin neighbourhood (Kaaraan District) in the afternoon of 05/11. The officer is based in Kaaraan District. No one was in the vehicle by the time of the blast. The officer and his body guards were sitting in tea-shop when the device went off. It is believed that the device was attached to the vehicle.

A RCIED targeted Somali soldiers in a private car in Ceymiska neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 05/11. Three soldiers in the car were killed and the vehicle was badly damaged. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attacker threw a hand grenade at a hotel hosting a government delegation in Bulo-Xawo in the evening of 05/11. The device landed in near the hotel but did not cause any casualty. The perpetrator escaped. The delegation is on a fact-finding mission on the cause roots of conflicts between ASWJ and local administrations.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNA officer near Al-Baraka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 06/11. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed the chairman of Wardhiigley district court in Xararyaale neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 06/11. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM military convoy in Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 06/11. Reports indicate that the device hit one of the AMISOM vehicles. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped.

Youth gang stabbed and killed a boy in the livestock market in Mohamud Haybe District (Hargeisa) in the evening of 06/11. The motive is unknown. Police arrested three suspects in connection with the murder.

Attack/Shooting, Dabaqeynka Mosque area, Dharkeynley District, Mogadishu, 07/11/2013, 21:00. Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against government forces in Dabaqeynka mosque area (Dharkeyley District) in the night of 07/11. The forces opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian woman close to ex-Control Afgooye (Hodan District) in the evening of 07/11. The victim was the wife of a government soldier. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Pro-SNG soldiers shot and killed a man in Qasax Dhere in the midday of 07/11 after suspecting him of being an Amniyat (al Shabaab intelligence) infiltrator.
A lorry hit an UXO/Mine on the road betweenHananbuure and Mareer Guur (28km N of Dhusamareeb) in the afternoon o f07/11. Casualties could not be established.

An unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at the residence of Mr. Gabose, a senior Jubaland military officer, in Sinaay neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 07/11. The motive is believed to be related to internal disagreement within the Jubaland forces.  No casualties were reported. The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Beytu Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the morning of 07/11. The victim was the headmaster of Sheekh Ali Maye Primary School in Marka. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.
An unidentified gunman shot and killed a man in front of Janaay Hotel in Berdaale neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the morning of 08/11. The motive is unknown. The perpetrator was arrested.

A youth group attacked with sticks and injured one of the members of the Borama local council in Borama on 09/11. Reports indicate that the victim was attacked when coming out of his office. Four of the youths were later arrested by the police. The attack was motivated by a land dispute between relatives of the youths and the councillor.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Biyo Kulule police station in Bossaso in the night of 09/11. Two police officers were reportedly injured. This attack is unrelated to an attack on a nearby prison the same day.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the Mayor office in the centre of Bosasso in the night of 09/11. Casualties are unknown.
