A body of a government soldier showing multiple gunshot wounds was found in Baali village (10km W of Beled Weyne) in the morning of 09/11. The motive behind the killing is unclear. Reports indicate that the soldier had left his base the evening before to visit his father in the area.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the police headquarters in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 09/11. No casualties were reported. The perpetrator escaped from the scene.

An unidentified individual fully dressed in woman’s clothing shot and injured a civilian man in Marka main market in the afternoon of 09/11. The victim was transferred to Mogadishu for treatment but later died of his injuries. The motive of the killing is unknown. The perpetrator escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against government police officers on foot patrol in Xero Ruush compound area (Hodan District) in the evening of 10/11/2013. The officers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped from the scene.

Al Shabaab fighters attacked Raas Kaambooni forces in Koday village (52km E of Badhaadhe) in the morning of 11/11. Reports indicate that the clash was relatively intense but al Shabaab forces did not manage to re-enter the village. At least one Raas Kaambooni soldier was killed and another was injured. Al Shabaab casualties could not be established. Koday had been taken over by Raas Kaambooni forces the day before.
Raas Kaambooni forces took over Koday village (80km NE of Raas Kaambooni) on 10/11.
Al Shabaab leader Ahmad Godane survives an assassination attempt during the evening hours. Increasingly factitious, the attempt on his life may have come from within al Shabaab.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a former NSA officer in front of a teashop in Beytu-Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the night of 10/11. The motive of the killing is unascertained. Reports suggest that the killing may be linked with his former association with the NSA. The perpetrator escaped from the scene.

A fire outbreak destroyed IDP shelters in ex-State House compound in Shacabka neighbourhood (Hargeisa) in the afternoon of 10/11. Fire-fighters extinguished the fire after two hours. The cause of the fire is currently unknown, but may have been arson. One woman was reportedly killed and around 20 other persons injured.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a private residential house belonging to a Dayniile district official in Gubta neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the night of 11/11. Reports indicate that the security guards protecting the compound exchanged gunfire with the attackers. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified armed men shot and injured a SNA member in KKP neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 11/11. Reports indicate that the victim had been called by a friend to meet at the place where he was attacked. The motive of the attackers is unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government forces based in Miisanka Dhuhusha neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the night of 11/11. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified gunmen opened fire at a residential house belonging to a local doctor from the Majerteen/Issa Mohamud/Musse Isse sub-sub-clan in Garoowe in the night of 11/11. It is suspected that the attack was related to clan revenge. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED targeted government soldiers in a teashop in Shalaambood (Marka dst) in the afternoon of 11/11. One soldier was killed and another one injured. Reports indicate that a suspect was arrested at the scene.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a young civilian man in the livestock market area (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 12/11. Reports indicate that the victim was brother to a member of a NSA officer. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM/KDF convoy near Ceel Cadde (50km SW of Garbahareey) on 13/11.  Reports indicate that one KDF soldier was injured in the blast and one personal carrier was damaged. Further reports indicate that the attack followed a clash in the area.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the residence of the Jubaland deputy army commander (Ali Gardhub) in Siinay neighbourhood of Kismaayo in the evening of 14/11. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers shot and killed a civilian woman near Heliwa police station (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 15/11. The motive is unclear. The victim used to run a teashop frequented by government soldiers. The perpetrators escaped.

A group of pro-government soldiers attacked the police headquarters in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 15/11 and engaged in an exchange of gunfire with the police. The pro-government soldiers conducted the attack to free their detained colleague who arrested for carrying a gun in the city while on off duty. The attackers managed to release him. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified armed men shot and killed three government soldiers near the livestock market (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 16/11. The assailants also stole the guns of their victims and escaped.
Unidentified armed men shot and killed a civilian man in the livestock area (Heliwa District) in the morning of 16/11. The motive is unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers shot and killed a civilian man near Janaale Village (14km NW of Marka) in the afternoon of 17/11. The motive is unclear. The victim used to transport AMISOM soldiers from the camp to the market using his motor cycle. The perpetrators escaped.
A RCIED targeted a Jubaland military truck in Via Afmadow neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 11/11. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED reportedly planted on the roadside targeted AMISOM forces in Yaaq Biri Weyne (22km W of Wanla Weyne) in the afternoon of 17//11. Two AMISOM soldiers were injured and an AMISOM truck was damaged in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two soldiers in Banagala neighbourhood in the evening of 18/11. The soldiers were on foot and heading to their homes when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.

An RCIED targeted an AMISOM military convoy on the road between Ceymiska and ex-Control Balcad (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 18/11. Reports indicate that the device missed the target. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED targeted a Somali military truck passing in front of Ahmed Gurey Secondary School in Misaanka Dhuxusha neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 18/11. The soldiers in the vehicle opened fire after the blast. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified man shot and injured a government soldier in Korontada neighbourhood (Wadajir/Medina District) in the morning of 19/11. The soldier was walking home when the incident happened. The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified man armed with a pistol shot and killed another man near Danwadaagaha Junction (Wadajir/Medina District) in the morning of 19/11. The motive is unknown. The perpetrator reportedly jumped out a car and shot the victim and escaped in the car.

A pro-Somali soldier shot and seriously injured a business woman in Bulo-Xawo in the night of 19/11. The woman - a Khat seller had engaged an argument with the soldier over previous khat debt. Other pro-soldiers arrested the perpetrator. The woman succumbed to her injuries later.

A group of pro-government forces (not identified) clash with al Shabaab fighters in the outskirt of Tuulo Barwaqo (20 km NW of Garbahareey) in the morning of 19/11. Reports indicate that the pro-government group was after a deserter soldier who deserted the base but met al Shabaab fighters where the two sides engaged in exchange of gunfire, after which the pro-government soldiers withdrew to their base. No casualties were reported.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Via Afmadow neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 19/11. The motive behind the killing is currently unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM military truck in Xawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye District) in the afternoon of 20/11. AMISOM soldiers opened fire after the blast. One AMISOM soldier was reportedly killed in the explosion and the truck was damaged. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a Somali military truck carrying soldiers in Carbiska settlement (6km SE of Afgooye) in the afternoon of 20/11. Reports indicate that the device missed it is target and exploded after the vehicle had passed over. No casualties were reported.
An explosive targets a federal government militia vehicle travelling to KM50 village. The damage caused by the blast is unknown.

Suspected al Shabaab fighters killed a pro-government soldier (not identified) from Luweys sub-clan in Shiida Village (26 km E of Xudur) on 22/11. Reports indicate that the victim went to the village to see his sister and brother in-law and by entering the house, his brother in-law stabbed and killed him. Further reports indicate that al Shabaab elements brought the victim's body to Xudur and dumped it on the street until on 24/11.

Al Shabaab fighters conducted a hit-and- run attack against pro-government base in Qansax Dhere in the night of 22/11. The attack lasted briefly. Government forces did not respond. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at Jubaland forces in K2 section in Fiat neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 22/11. No casualties were reported. Reports indicate that the forces conducted a security operation after the blast but made no arrest.

An unidentified man armed with a pistol shot and killed a soldier near the main Market in Heliwa District in the morning of 23/11. The perpetrator escaped. Government forces launched a security operation after the incident but made no arrest.

A government soldier survived an assassination attempt after three men armed with pistols tried to kill him while riding his motorbike to work in the livestock market (Heliwa District) in the morning of 23/11. The targeted soldier reportedly exchanged gunfire with the attackers and managed to escape. A female bystander was killed in the cross fire. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a district judge and a female bystander near Heliwa main market (Heliwa District) in the morning of 23/11. Reports indicate that the judge was heading to his office at the time of the incident and the woman was reportedly shot screamed when the perpetrators shot the judge. The attackers escaped.

Two men exchanged gunfire following an escalated argument on al Shabaab issues in Carmo Village (205km S of Bosasso) on 23/11. One of the two, identified as a former al Shabaab militant, was injured in the shoot-out and later succumbed to his injuries. The perpetrator was arrested.

Two men exchanged gunfire following an escalated argument on al Shabaab issues in Carmo Village (205km S of Bosasso) on 23/11. One of the two, identified as a former al Shabaab militant, was injured in the shoot-out and later succumbed to his injuries. The perpetrator was arrested.
At least 21 camels are killed in a bomb blast intended for AMISOM forces. Conflicting report: local herders claim AMISOM forces intentionally killed the camels.

An unidentified perpetrator shot and killed a civilian man in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 23/11. The reason behind the killing is currently unclear but unconfirmed reports indicate that the incident might be linked to clan revenge though no clan was mentioned. The perpetrator escaped.

Three unidentified armed men shot and killed a government soldier in Barwaqo neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 24/11. The soldier was on foot heading to his home when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified armed men shot and killed a civilian man in his residence in Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 24/11. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Al Shabaab fighters ambushed a group of pro-Somali government forces (affiliation not provided) near Jana Cabdalle Village (57km SE of Afmadow) in the morning of 24/11. The two sides engaged in a brief exchange of gunfire. Reports indicate that one soldier was not accounted for. It is unclear whether he defected to the al Shabaab side or lost his way. The pro-government forces had left Afmadow and were heading to Kismaayo when the ambushed took place. Further reports indicate that the pro-government forces abducted an armed civilian in the ambush area and his body was found in the outskirts of Kismaayo on 26/11. It is not clear if he was killed because of being an al Shabaab suspect or because of his gun, which has a street value of 1200 USD. Casualties on al Shabaab side are unknown.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian in Janaale Village (14km NW of Marka) in the evening of 24/11. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified man armed with a pistol shot and injured an elder from Garre clan in the main Marka market in the evening of 24/11. The motive is unknown. The elder was taken to Mogadishu for treatment. The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw two hand grenades at a building occupied by an INGO in K6 area (Hodan District) in the evening of 25/11. The motive is unknown. Two bystanders were reportedly injured in the blast. The attackers escaped.

A RCIED targeted AMISOM forces passing in Hawindha Village (94km E of Afmadow) in the morning of 25/11. One AMISOM truck was damaged in the blast. The explosion was followed by heavy exchange of assorted firearms that could be heard in Dhoobley town. The convoy had left Tabta and was heading to Dhoobley when the ambush took place. Casualties could not be established.

An RCIED targeted a vehicle belonging to the spokesman of Jubaland forces which was passing in Via Afmadow neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 25/11. The spokesman was in the car by the time of the incident. One soldier was killed and six others were injured, three of them seriously in the blast. Following the attack Jubaland forces conducted a security operation in the area and made 25 arrests.

At least three civilians, including a well-known businessman, are killed by suspected Raskamboni forces during the evening hours. It was reported the assailants shot the civilians after detonating an explosive in the downtown area.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Police arrested four officials of Wadani (Somaliland National) Party in Hargeisa over the course of two days - 26-27/11. The motive of the arrest is currently unclear. In response the party's supporters staged a demonstration in protest against the arrest of the officials.

Two men armed with pistols shot and killed a woman in Macalin Nuur neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the morning of 27/11. The motive is unknown. The victim used to work in cash for work projects like cleaning the roads in Mogadishu. The perpetrators escaped.

An RCIED targeted a truck belonging to government security forces in front of Hormuud building located between SOS and ex-control Balcad (Heliwa District) in the evening of 27/11. Soldiers in the truck opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported.
Three men armed with pistols have shot dead a government soldier and injured another one in Mogadishu's Siinaay junction.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a government soldier and seriously injured another in Siinaay neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the afternoon of 27/11. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.  Somali forces later conducted a security operation in the area but made no arrest.

Two militia groups led by two governing leaders of Khatumo (Ahmed Karash and Mohamud Indho Sheel) clashed in the vicinity of God Qaboobe (53km E of Laas Caanood) in the morning of 27/11 following disagreements over who to lead the second phase of Khatumo  III conference. The two sides clashed after a militia group led by Indho Sheel reportedly heading to Taleex to organize the general assembly meeting of Khatumo, was blocked by another group led by Ahmed Karash. Indho Sheel group later proceeded to Taleex after the brief clash and the withdrawal of Karash group. The Khatumo's deputy minister of interior, who was part of Indho Sheel convoy, was injured in the clash. Indho Sheel reportedly accused Puntland of backing his rival.

Two militia groups led by two governing leaders of Khatumo (Ahmed Karash and Mohamud Indho Sheel) clashed in the vicinity of God Qaboobe (53km E of Laas Caanood) in the morning of 27/11 following disagreements over who to lead the second phase of Khatumo  III conference. The two sides clashed after a militia group led by Indho Sheel reportedly heading to Taleex to organize the general assembly meeting of Khatumo, was blocked by another group led by Ahmed Karash. Indho Sheel group later proceeded to Taleex after the brief clash and the withdrawal of Karash group. The Khatumo's deputy minister of interior, who was part of Indho Sheel convoy, was injured in the clash. Indho Sheel reportedly accused Puntland of backing his rival.

Al Shabaab fighters and pastoralists clashed in the remote villages near Maxaas (83 NE of Bulo Burte), on 28/11 after al Shabaab elements tried to forcefully take livestock from the herders in the name of Zakat (tax). Reports indicate that the pastoralists managed to recover livestock seized previously by al Shabaab fighters. Causalities not known.
A bomb explosion at the khat market targeting security forces in Jowhar town has caused death and injury of bystander civilians.

A hand grenade targeted government soldiers in Jowhar walking along the road but there has been no report of casualties among the soldiers. However, a female khat vendor who was injured died later in hospital.
A gunman in the government forces uniform has killed a civilian in Arjantiin neighbourhood of Mogadishu's Kaaraan District for unknown reason.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government soldiers based at ADC compound in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the evening of 29/11. The soldiers opened gunfire after the blast.  A woman bystander was killed and four others (civilians) were injured in the blast.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot a civilian man in Dahablaha Section of Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 30/11. The deceased was working for a private bank in located in Bakaara Market and was heading home when the incident happened. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the attackers wanted to kill a woman, who reported previous planted IEDS to the authorities, but missed her. The woman managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Kaaraan police Station (Kaaraan District) in the evening of 29/11. No casualties were reported. Police immediately conducted a security operation and arrested a number of people they suspected on being behind the attack.
Unknown gunmen shot and killed a Somali Government judge in Mogadishu's Yaqshiid District. Unconfirmed reports suggest that the judge was involved in a land dispute. The assailants escaped.

A RCIED targeted government soldiers in Baar Ismail neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the morning of 301/11. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. They then conducted a security operation in the area and arrested many people they suspected of being involved in the attack. Reports indicate that at least five soldiers were killed in the explosion and a number of others were injured in the blast.  A government forces' truck was also damaged in the attack.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Barwaaqo neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 01/12. The motive is unknown but reports indicate that the victim was a khat seller and most of his customers were government soldiers. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government forces at Hawl-Wadaag Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 02/12. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government soldiers walking in Ali Turcaaye neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the evening of 03/12. The device reportedly missed its target and landed in an empty place, causing no casualty. The soldiers opened fired after the blast. They also searched the area but made no arrest.
A RCIED was targeted an AMISOM water bowser in Aawdiinle Village in Baidoa District in the morning of 03/12. No casualties or damages were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A device suspected to be a RCIED targeted pro-government forces (not named) on patrol in Ceel Waaq in the afternoon of 03/12. One pro-government soldier and two civilians were killed and eight others, including civilians, were injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

A device suspected to be a RCIED targeted pro-government forces (not named) on patrol in Ceel Waaq in the afternoon of 03/12. One pro-government soldier and two civilians were killed and eight others, including civilians, were injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM water bowser in Ruusiya neighbourhood (Marka) in the morning of 03/12. The soldiers opened gunfire after the blast. One soldier was reportedly injured while the water bowser was completely destroyed by the explosion.
Armed men shot and killed a civilian man and injured another in Qiracbuul neighbourhood in Luuq over unknown dispute in the night of 04/12. The perpetrators escaped but later surrendered to the ENDF.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a government soldier in Dabakaayo Madow neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the night of 05/12. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in the livestock market area (Heliwa District) in the morning of 05/12. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

A unidentified man threw a hand grenade Janaale market (14km NW of Marka) in the afternoon of 05/12. The incident happened at a time when people were busy in the market. There were some soldiers in a nearby teashop by the time of the attack. One person was killed in the blast, five others injured. Police managed to arrest the perpetrator who was reportedly found with four other grenades.

A RCIED exploded in the area between Gulwade and Fanoole neighbourhoods (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 05/12. The device reportedly missed its target, which was an AMISOM convoy carrying the president of Jubaland towards the state house in Kismaayo. The president reportedly returned from the airport after meeting with an IGAD delegation.

A RCIED of unknown origin exploded in the area between Gulwade and Fanoole neighbourhoods (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 05/12. The device reportedly missed its target, which was an AMISOM convoy carrying the president of Jubaland towards the state house in Kismaayo. The president reportedly returned from the airport after meeting with an IGAD delegation.

Unidentified gunmen driving in a small car opened fire and seriously injured a woman (a foreigner, not identified) in Baar Ubax neighbourhood (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 06/12.  Reports indicate that the woman later succumbed to her injuries in a Mogadishu hospital. The incident happened after the victim left University of Somalia's campus in the K4 area where she used to work as a lecturer.  There is a conflicting report about her nationality; one version suggests that she was a Ugandan while the other reports indicate that she is from Zanzibar. The perpetrators escaped.
A member of parliament is killed and another injured in an explosion near Villa Somalia. It is not clear if the MP was specifically targeted in the blast.

Unidentified attackers fired about four mortar rounds in Xamar Jadiid neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the night of 06/12. Two rounds reportedly landed in Xamar Jadiid neighbourhood while the other two hit near Sheekh Aadan Dheere neighbourhood. The motive behind the mortar attack remains unknown but it is believed that the attackers were targeting the presidential palace. Two civilians were injured in the attack. An unspecified number of houses were reportedly damaged.
Puntland forces come under mortar fire outside of Bosasso. Causalities not known.

Unidentified gunman shot and killed a man hailing from Jeron clan in Boqoley market in Berdale neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 07/12. The motive is unknown. The victim was currently a driver of an INGO-rented vehicle but used to be a driver of an intelligence officer and pro-Somali government officials from Buur Hakaba.

An ASNG police officer shot and injured two civilians in K4 neighbourhood (Waberi District) in the morning of 08/12. The reason behind the shooting is not yet clear but reports indicate that the incident happened following an argument over unknown issue. Police arrested the perpetrator.

ASWJ forces attacked al Shabaab forces in Birta Dheer Village (11km SE of Garbarhaarey) in the morning of 8/12. Reports indicate that ASWJ forces were called back by ENDF before they took over the village since the offensive was not a coordinated military operation. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government soldiers walking on the bridge in 21st October neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the night of 08/12. The device missed its target and hit a nearby house, killing a woman and injuring four others, including a five year old boy who lost his leg. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a government soldier in Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 09/12. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and injured a tax collector and a civilian man in Xawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the night of 09/12. The two men were transferred to Mogadishu for treatment. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified armed men shot and killed a customs officer in Argada area (Kismaayo) in the evening of 10/12. The motive is currently unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM water bowser in Shalaambood Village (10km W of Marka) in the afternoon of 10/12. The water bowser was transporting water from Ceel-Jaale (8km NW of Marka) when the incident happened. AMISOM forces conducted a security operation in the area immediately after the blast and arrested an unspecified number of people. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified attackers ambushed a civilian vehicle near Yaaq Biri Weyne Village (22km W of Wanla Weyne) in the afternoon of 10/12. The vehicle managed to escape. Although the reason behind the attack is not clear, it is believed that the target was a Somali government official travelling in the vehicle. A female passenger was killed and another injured in the shooting.
Unidentified persons shot and killed two government soldiers who were collecting taxes in Dayniile district. It is not clear if the tax collecting was legitimate.

Unidentified perpetrators hurled a hand grenade at the residence of Horseed neighbourhood judge in Baidoa in the evening of 11/12. A civilian by-stander was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

An unidentified gunman shot and wounded a man hailing from a minority clan (Bantu) in Farjano neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 11/12. The motive apparently is related to a land dispute and the perpetrator escaped. The man is stable in hospital.

A group of unidentified armed men hurled a hand grenade at the residence of Dayniile District Commissioner in Isse Abdi neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 12/12. The incident was followed by exchange of gunfire between the attackers and the security guards at the residence. The motive remains unknown and the attackers escaped.

A RCIED targeted government soldiers sitting in teashop near Baar Ubax Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 12/12. The device was planted in the teashop which is frequented by Somali soldiers. One soldier and a female bystander were reportedly killed in the explosion while two other soldiers were injured.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a Jubaland forces' officer hailing from Ogaden clan in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 12/12. The victim was shot after leaving Express Mosque near Dahabshil office. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified body of a young man was found in Lafoole area (6km SE of Afgooye) in the morning of 12/12. The body had gunshot wounds. The motive and the identity of the perpetrators are currently unknown.

Unidentified perpetrators hurled a hand grenade at pro-Somali government forces (not identified) on patrol at Olympic Junction in Berdaale neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 13/12. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. A small boy was hit on the arm by the gunfire opened by the soldiers. The hand grenade caused no casualties.

Unidentified perpetrators hurled a hand grenade at pro-Somali government forces (not identified) on patrol at Olympic Junction in Berdaale neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 13/12. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. A small boy was hit on the arm by the gunfire opened by the soldiers. The hand grenade caused no casualties.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government soldiers in Xawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the evening of 13/12. The device missed its target and hit landed in a residential house nearby. Three children were injured. One of them later succumbed to his injuries. The perpetrators escaped.
A powerful explosion targets government soldiers at Seybiyano neighbourhood in Hodan District during the evening hours. Causalities and perpetrators not known.

Three men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man inside a mosque in Xamar Bile neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 15/12. The deceased used to make the call for the prayer in the mosque and was well-known in the neighbourhood. The motive is unknown. Security forces arrived in the area but made no arrests.
A notable elder is shot and killed in a town north of Galkacayo. The reason for the assassination is not clear. A woman who was near to the place was also killed in the attack.

A RCIED exploded as government police EOD team try to dismantle it in Xamar Jab Jab District in the morning of 20/12. It is believed that the device was detonated by a remote control. Reports indicate that the device was planted in a big dustbin distributed to Mogadishu districts by the Turkish government. One police officer was reportedly injured in the blast.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government soldiers based near Black Sea Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the night of 20/12. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

The body of a man dressed in a military uniform was found near Wanla Weyne town in the morning of 20/12. The body had gunshot wounds. The identity and the motive of the perpetrators are currently unclear.

An unidentified gunman shot and seriously injured the human resources manager of Hargeisa Electricity Company in Geed Goble neighbourhood in Hargeisa on 20/13. The motive of the attack is currently unclear. The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali government soldier in Zone K neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the night of 21/12. The victim was heading to his base after leaving a teashop nearby where he was chewing khat when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped. Security forces later came to the scene and took the body.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM military convoy near Jaale Siyad Military Academy (Hodan District) in the evening of 21/12. The convoy was heading to AMISOM base located in the military academy when the incident happened. Casualties could not be established. An unspecified number of AMISOM vehicles were damaged in the explosion.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police guarding customs office in Garsoor neighbourhood in Galkacyo (North) in the evening of 21/12. The police opened fire after the blast. One police officer was reportedly killed and an unspecified number of others were injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified armed men kill a member of the Presidential staff while he shopped in Bakaaraha Market.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Malin Taajir area of Bakaara Market (Hawl- Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 22/12. The motive remains unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at soldiers based at SOS Junction (Heliwa District) in the evening of 22/12. The soldiers opened fire after the blast but no casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Pro-government police militia (not identified) conducted a security operation in Cabuud Waaq in the afternoon of 22/12. The operation was reportedly aimed to confiscate unregistered arms in the town. The security forces shot and killed an armed man who refused to surrender his gun.

Pro-government police militia (not identified) conducted a security operation in Cabuud Waaq in the afternoon of 22/12. The operation was reportedly aimed to confiscate unregistered arms in the town. The security forces shot and killed an armed man who refused to surrender his gun.

Al Shabaab fighters launched a hit-and-run attack against pro-government forces (not identified) in Garbahaarey in the evening of 22/12. The two sides exchanged both light and heavy gunfire during the clash. No casualties were reported.

Seven are dead and others wounded during a clash between government forces and a unidentified militia. The militia had established an illegal checkpoint in the area. Days earlier Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud announced any soldiers found manning an illegal checkpoint would be shot.

Pro-Somali (not identified) forces attacked a home of an al Shabaab fighter in Qeydar Edi Village (28km NW of Xudur) in the night of 23/12. The al Shabaab fighters and the pro-government forces exchanged gunfire briefly. The wife and a child of the al Shabaab fighter were killed while the al Shabaab fighter himself was injured. The pro-Somali forces took his gun and left the village.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Village Restaurant in Zone K neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 23/12. The device hit the perimeter wall of the restaurant and caused no casualties. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in the livestock market area (Heliwa District) in the evening of 24/12. The motive is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Al Shabaab fighters attacked Garbarhaarey which is under the control of pro-Somali government forces (not identified) in the afternoon of 24/12. The al Shabaab fighters and pro-government forces exchanged heavy gunfire for about half an hour after which the attackers withdrew. Two pro-government soldiers were killed. The body of a fighter was left by the retreating al Shabaab fighter was later found in the town. In the next days two others were reported dead due to the clash, though it is not clear to which side.

ENDF and pro-Somali government soldiers (not identified) clashed briefly at an ENDF check-point in Ceel Gaal (13km NE of Beled Weyne) in the morning of 24/12. The incident happened after a pro-government vehicle failed to stop at the ENDF check-point. Reports indicate that a pro-government soldier fell from the vehicle and got injured during the shoot-out. No other casualty was reported. It is not clear if this clash is related to a similar one near Kalabayr junction.

Unidentified warplanes attacked Jadecaley Village (19km NW of Badhaadhe District) in the afternoon of 24/12. Reports indicate that the planes took off from Kismaayo airport. No civilian casualties were reported. Al Shabaab casualties are unknown.

Militiamen hailing from Marehan attacked pro-Somali government police (not identified) on foot patrol in Cabuud Waaq in the evening of 25/12. The two sides exchanged gun fire for about 20 minutes. One police officer was killed and three others injured. The motive of the attack is believed to in revenge for the killing of one of their clan member during a disarmament operation two days earlier.

About 12 militias loyal to Barre Hiraale attacked the residence the Jubaland minister of commerce and a neighbouring building occupied by Jubaland forces in Farjano neighbourhood in the evening of 26/12. The attackers and the Jubaland forces exchanged small arms fire for about 20 minutes after which the Hiraale's militia withdrew. One injured Hiraale's militiaman was captured by the Jubaland forces and later died of torture. Two other attackers were injured in the clash but were taken by their colleagues as they withdrew.

A RCIED targeted a civilian vehicle along the airport road in Kismaayo in the afternoon of 26/12. A woman was injured in the blast. It is nor clear if the intended target was indeed the civilian vehicle.

About 12 militias loyal to Barre Hiraale attacked the residence the Jubaland minister of commerce and a neighbouring building occupied by Jubaland forces in Farjano neighbourhood in the evening of 26/12. The attackers and the Jubaland forces exchanged small arms fire for about 20 minutes after which the Hiraale's militia withdrew. One injured Hiraale's militiaman was captured by the Jubaland forces and later died of torture. Two other attackers were injured in the clash but were taken by their colleagues as they withdrew.

A RCIED targeted Somali forces queuing to receive salaries in Radarka neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the afternoon of 27/12. Seven soldiers and a bystander were killed in the blast while five other civilians were injured. Soldiers conducted a security operation after the blast and arrested two people they suspected of being behind the attack. In the following days several other suspected perpetrators were arrested.
A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy along the industrial road at ex-Control Balcad (Heliwa District) in the morning of 27/12. No casualties were reported but one AMISOM vehicle was slightly damaged.

Unidentified armed men attacked the residence of Heliwa District Commissioner close to the district police station in the evening of 27/12. Guards at the residence exchanged gunfire with the attackers. The attackers withdrew after a brief shoot-out. The motive is unknown. Police conducted a security operation in the area and arrested two people they suspected of being behind the attack.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a civilian man in Arjantiin neighbourhood (Kaaraan District) in the evening of 27/12. The motive is unknown. The assailants escaped.

Unidentified gunmen attack the home of  the water minister in the interim Jubba administration. Witnesses confirmed that the minister's bodyguards and the gunmen briefly exchanged gunfire. Causalities not known.

An unidentified man shot and killed an elder in Afgooye in the evening of 27/12. Security forces conducted an operation and arrested a number of people in connection with the murder. Reports further indicate that the perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at an AMISOM military convoy in Rusiya neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 27/12. AMISOM soldiers opened fire after the blast. Three bystanders were injured in the explosion. The AMISOM forces conducted a security operation after the blast but made no arrest.
A RCIED targeting an AMISOM military convoy in Marka on 27/12. Unconfirmed reports indicate that four Burundian soldiers were killed in the blast and a number of others were injured.

An armed man dressed in a military uniform shot and killed a man near Shelare Junction (Xamar Jab Jab District) in the morning of 28/12. The motive is unknown. The perpetrator escaped. It is not clear if the perpetrator was affiliated with the military.

An unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at Sahafi Hotel in Wadajir District in the night of 28/12. No casualties were reported.  The hotel's guards and police managed to arrest three people they suspected of being behind the attack.

A small number of militias from Guri Ceel launched a hit-and-run attack against Guri Ceel airstrip in the morning of 28/12. The airstrip guards (believed to private security) and the attackers exchanged gunfire for about five minutes after which the attackers withdrew. No casualties were reported. ASWJ forces later arrested all the attackers.

The deputy commissioner of Daynile district is attacked by unknown assailants in his home late in the evening. The assailants were armed with hand grenades. Local residents confirmed that the hand grenade attack resulted causalities including death and injury on guards of the house.
Unidentified attackers launch an attack on AMISOM forces located at Beled Weyne airfield.

Unidentified gunmen kidnapped five staff members of two local non-government organizations (not identified) in an area between Tabta and Bilis Qooqaani villages (75km SW and 48km NW of Afmadow) in the afternoon of 29/12. Reports indicate that the gunmen stopped the LNGO vehicle, which was moving without escorts and took the five employees to an unknown location. The motive of the kidnap is currently unknown.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM military convoy at Dalcada in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 29/12. Casualties could not be established since AMISOM forces sealed off the area after the blast.

Unidentified attackers threw two hand grenades simultaneously at Somali government forces manning a check-point in Ceel Cali Geedi neighbourhood (Kaaraan District) in the evening of 30/12. Somali soldiers opened fire after the blast.  Two soldiers were injured in the blast. The perpetrators managed to escape.

A RCIED targeted Somali forces near Janaale market in the afternoon of 30/12.  The device was planted in the area typically frequented by the  soldiers. Two soldiers were killed and four others were injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.
A landmine targeted an anti-mine vehicle of Kenyan AMISOM forces in the Afmadow neighbourhood of Kismayo. Causalities reported, though specific numbers were not provided.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the vehicle of the deputy mayor of Galkacyo (North) in the morning of 30/12. The security guards of the deputy mayor opened fire after the blast. The deputy mayor was injured in the explosion and admitted to a hospital in Galkacyo North. He reportedly said that he had suffered light injuries. The perpetrators escaped, though five suspects were arrested in the following days.

A RCIED targeted a military vehicle in Xawo Tako neighbourhood in Afgooye in the afternoon of 30/12. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Three soldiers and two civilians in the truck were injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

At least two people have been killed and four others sustained various injuries after local resident clashed with Al-Shabab fighters in Goobaale locality. According to a local residents, the fighting between the two sides started after al Shabaab tried to forcibly collect Zakat from the local people. The fighting between the two sides lasted for hours.
Six soldiers are killed after an IED targeted a checkpoint in Hiliwaa District .
Two soldiers are killed after an IED targeted their convoy travelling in Yaaqshid District.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a police outpost at Dabka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 01/01. Police opened fire after the blast. Two civilian bystanders were injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Mubarak Hotel along Maka Al-Makarama Road (Hodan District) in the evening of 01/10. The target of the attackers is not known. One security guard was injured in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a government military forces manning a patrol post in Miisaanka Dhuhusha neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 01/10.  Casualties are unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled hand grenade at government forces in the vicinity of the local police station in Baytu Ras neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 01/01. Causalities not articulated. The local District Commissioner denied the hand grenade incident.
A group of Rahanweyn traders clash with local residents after the residents accused to the traders of causing their business premises rent to spike due to higher demand. Causalities not known.

An RCIED planted in a teashop in Goof Gaduud village (28km NW of Baidoa) exploded on 02/01, killing the deputy chairman of the village and injuring three soldiers and three civilians. The perpetrators escaped. It is not clear if the intended target was the deputy chairman or the soldiers.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Issa Abdi neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the evening of 03/01. The motive of his killing is currently unknown. Reports indicate that the victim reportedly had business deal with the local administration in the district.

Unidentified men armed with AK-47 dressed in government military uniform (actual military affiliation not known) shot and killed a civilian man in Ceel-dheere (Dharkenley District) in the evening of 03/01. Reports indicate that the perpetrators were involved in an armed robbery activities and the victim reportedly refused to surrender his mobile phone. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man and injured another one in Bakara market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 01/01.  The reason behind the killing is currently unknown. SNG soldiers arrived at the scene, conducted security operation and arrested unspecified number of suspected people. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted two Somali government soldiers on board of Toyota Carib in Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 04/01. Reports indicate that the device exploded after the vehicle passed over the location. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

A group of Galgala insurgents were spotted close to Karin and Yalho villages (37km and40km S of Bossaso) in the night of 04/01. Puntland forces after receiving the information arrived in the villages but the insurgent group move back to Galgala Mountains. Unconfirmed reports indicate that there was clash between the Galgala group and Puntland forces, though the location was not conveyed. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at the residence of the Deputy Chairman of Social Affairs for Dayniile District Administration in the evening of 5/1. Soldiers in the area opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators manage to escape.
An IED targeted Yaaqshid District Commissioner during the early morning hours of 05/01. Military forces conducted a security operation following the explosion. No causalities reported.
Al Shabaab forces kidnap a LNGO staff member near Jilib.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at government forces manning check-point at the outskirt of Janaale village (14km NW of Marka) in the afternoon of 05/01. Reports indicate that soldiers open fire after the blast. No casualties were reported.
Unidentified men, armed with AK-47s attack a group of Puntland soldiers at Lad position, 30km south of Garoowe. Five reported soldier deaths, plus injuries.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali soldiers on foot in the Khat market of Hanti-Wadag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the evening of 05/01. The device landed near a group of civilians injuring small boy. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a government soldier in Daryeel market (Heliwa District) in the evening of 06/01. Other soldiers in the area arrived at the scene and conducted operation but made no arrest. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali government soldier in Siinay neighbourhood (Boondheere District) in the afternoon of 07/01. The reason behind his killing is not clear. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a woman in her house near Bar Ubah (Hawl-Wadaag) in the evening of 07/01. Reports indicate that the victim used to work at Mogadishu port. The motive behind the killing could not be established. The perpetrators escaped.
A car bomb killed a former local district official at Tarabuunka junction. It is not clear if the former official was the target of the blast.
A RCIED targeted Somali forces in Toyota car in Caymiska neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the night of 07/01. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified two men armed with pistols shot and killed the chairman of Towfiiq neighbourhood near Hormud Telecom building (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 07/01. The reason behind the killing is currently unclear. The attackers escaped.

An RCIED targeted at SNA officer riding in a vehicle in Trebuunka Junction (Hodan District) in the morning of 08/01. It is not clear whether the device has been attached to the vehicle or planted in it. Reports indicate that former Lafoole chairman and a civilian bystander were killed in the blast while two SNA officers were injured. One of the injured officers has been reportedly nominated recently as head of security in Galgaduud region. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistol shot and killed a Jubaland soldier hailing from Ogaden in Iskufilan neighbourhood in the night of 08/01. Reports indicate that the victim was walking alone at the time of the incident. The perpetrators escaped and took the victim's gun. It is not known if the attack was motivated by ethnicity. Later Jubaland forces arrested 100 men suspected of the attack.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Somali government forces sitting in a teashop in Bar Ubah junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the night of 09/01.  The forces responded by firing after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified gunmen shoot and kill a Turkish embassy employee in Bakara market. The motive for the shooting is not known.

A RCIED reportedly planted in a teashop detonated in Iidaale neighbourhood (Luuq District) in the morning of 09/01. Reports indicate that four civilians were killed in the blast. Further reports suggest that the targeted teashop was frequented by military forces, though it is not entirely clear they were the targets of the blast. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers simultaneously hurled two hand grenades at Somali military forces guarding at former labour relation centre building in Hanti-Wadag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the evening of 09/01. Reports indicate that the devices hit at the perimeter wall of the building causing no casualties. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified perpetrators threw a hand grenade at a residential house for a government soldier in Jamacaha neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 10/01. The forces guarding the house open fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and injured a LNGO staff in African village neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the night of 10/01. Reports indicate that the victim was coming back from late evening prayers in a nearby mosque when the incident happens. The attackers thought that the man was dead and escaped from the scene. The victim was taken to Medina hospital for treatment.
Unidentified persons attacked the home of an NSA officer with a hand grenade on 10/01. No causality reported.

During the early morning hours unidentified gunmen attack a government base located in the Omar Beerey section of the town. The residents confirmed to media outlets that heavy losses including "death and injury casualties" were sustained from the Government sides, adding a motor cycle belonging to the troops was looted by the armed men during the confrontations. Later reports confirm twelve soldier deaths.
Unidentified gunmen shot and wounded a Somali staff member of DBJ, a non-government humanitarian agency, while he was leading a prayer in Ali Sufi Mosque. The reason for the attack is not known.

Unidentified perpetrators threw a hand grenade at a house where local singers were chewing Khat in Baar Hal-Dhaafin, (Waaberi District) in the night of 11/01. The motive behind the attack is currently unclear, though groups such as al Shabaab are adverse to the consumption of the narcotic. No casualties were reported. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Yaaqshiid Police station (Yaaqshiid District) in the night of 11/01. Reports indicate that the device missed the target. The soldiers open fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Al Shabaab fighters conducted hit and run attack against Somali government allied forces (not identified) based in Qansax-Dheere in the night of 11/01. Reports indicate that the two sides briefly exchanged small fire and RPGs rounds during the clash. Al Shabaab fighters withdrew after they have been overpowered. No casualties were reported.
Unidentified man armed with AK-47 shot and killed a civilian man in Yarowe neighbourhood (Cabudwaaq) in the morning of 11/01. The motive behind the killing is currently unknown.

A body of a young man hailing from Dhulbahante/Barkad sub-clan was found in Madaremin neighbourhood (Laas Caanood) on 11/01. The exact date of death is not known. The motive behind the killing and the perpetrators are unknown.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian woman in KPP Junction (Hodan District) in the morning of 12/01. The reason behind the killing is currently unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified three men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Bundada neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the night of 12/01. Reports indicate that the attackers stole the victim's gun. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy passing between Lafoole and Carbiska (Afgooye District) in the afternoon of 12/01. Reports indicate that one AMISOM soldier was injured, two civilians' bystanders were reportedly killed and four others were injured in the blast. The convoy was heading to Afgooye when the indecent happened. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified armed men dressed in Somali military uniform have kidnapped two Kenyan nationals (engineers) in KPP neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the morning of 13/01. The identity, the motive of the abductors and whereabouts of kidnapped men cannot be established.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Yaaqshiid district comissioner's vehicle in Suuq Bacaad market (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 14/01. Four civilians' bystanders were injured in the blast. Reports indicate that the DC was not in the vehicle at the time of the incident. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at police forces on foot patrol in Fish Market area (Marka) in the night of 14/01.  Reports indicate that a civilian bystander was injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Ex-control Afgooye (Dharkenley District) in the night of 15/01. Reports indicate that the perpetrators escaped stealing the victim's gun. The motive behind the killing remains unknown.

Three unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man driving a Toyota Carib near Garguurte Hotel (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 15/01. The motive behind the killing cannot be established. The perpetrators escaped. Security forces arrived at the scene but made no arrest.
Unidentified armed men shot and killed a civilian man in Al-Baraka junction area (Hodan District) in the evening of 16/01. The motive behind the killing is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a Somali army commander (no rank or name provided) in Buurhakaba.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a former al Shabaab member who defected to Somali military forces in Ceel Gaab junction area (Xamar jajab district) in the afternoon of 17/01. The reason behind the killing is linked with victims' collaboration with NIS. The perpetrators escaped.

An unidentified man stabbed a popular religious preacher (Sheikh Mohamed Haibe) in Hargeisa in the afternoon of 17/01. Reports indicate that the perpetrator was previously arrested several times for abuse of religion which is a punishable crime in Somaliland. The victim was taken to hospital for treatment. The perpetrator escaped.
Unidentified armed men shot and killed two civilians in Quracle (26km S of Yeed) in the night of 18/01. The motive behind the killing is currently unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted Somali soldiers' vehicle passing in Jungal area (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 18/01. Reports indicate that the vehicle was partially damaged. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified armed men dressed in Government forces uniform opened fire at a Toyota "Surf" vehicle in Ali Kamin Junction (Wardhiigley District) in the evening of 18/01. Reports indicate that the gunmen ordered the vehicle to stop to which the driver refused. The vehicle's occupants escaped safely. It is not clear if the armed men were legitimate soldiers.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at Government soldiers in Hanti-Wadag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the night of 18/01. A six year old girl was killed and three other civilians were injured. The soldiers conducted a security operation and arrested an unspecified numbers of people suspected of being linked with the incident. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a Somali government police officer in Wanla Weyne in the night of 18/01. Reports indicate that the device didn't explode. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a well-known businessman in Heliwa district. The reason for the assassination is not known.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali police based in Furayaasha neighbourhood (Wardhiigley District) in the night of 19/01. Reports indicate the police responded by firing after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

A RCIED targeted a government police vehicle at Bar Ismail area in Afgooye in the morning of 19/01. Reports indicate that one officer was injured in the blast and the vehicle was damaged. The perpetrators escaped.
Two government soldiers are killed and three wounded in a landmine explosion, which may have been a roadside bomb, along a road connecting Mogadishu and Afgooye.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based at the former Defence Ministry compound (Dayniile District) in the evening of 20/01. Security forces responded by firing after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at ASWJ officer hailing from Hawaadle sub-clan. The reason behind the attack remained unclear. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at ASWJ officer hailing from Hawaadle sub-clan. The reason behind the attack remained unclear. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at government soldiers positioned in Hanti-Wadag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the night of 20/01. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

An unidentified man armed with a pistol shot and killed a young civilian man in Basra (25km NE of Afgooye) in the morning of 20/01. Reports indicate that the victim was coming from the mosque when the incident happened. The reason behind the killing is unknown.  The perpetrator escaped.

Unidentified armed men ambushed a public mini-bus near former University of Agriculture in Lafoole (6km SE of Afgooye District) in the evening of 20/01. Reports indicate that the driver was killed in the ambush and also that the bus overturned killing three of the passengers. The bus was from Afgooye heading to Mogadishu when the incident happened.

Twin bombings kill three and injure ten. Some reports claim four fatalities. The second explosion hit people who gathered at the site of the first blast, increasing the casualty figures. All fatalities occurred with the second bombing. There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the explosions. It is believed the targets of the blast were members of the PIS (Puntland Intelligence Service).

Al Shabaab attacked a base manned by Raskamboni forces during the evening hours. Preliminary reports indicate that the attacks caused the death of several soldiers belonging to Ras Kambooni and suffered several other injuries, though no specific number have been provided. Meanwhile, Al-Shabab fighters attacked a residential house belonging to one of the newly appointed ministers of the interim administration of Jubba.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a private residential house in Suuq Bocle area (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 24/01. Reports indicate that the soldiers were in the targeted house chewing Khat. The grenade exploded by the main gate causing no casualties. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Seven mortars or B10 rounds landed in some parts of Wadajir District in the night of 24/01. The identity of the attackers is currently unclear. Reports indicate that the rounds landed near Villa Baidoa, Bulo Hubey Market and near Radio Shabelle areas. Four people including two children were injured in the attack.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the central police station in Bossaso in the night of 24/01. Reports indicate that a civilian bystander was injured. Police forces arrested an unspecified number of youths suspected of been behind the incident. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified masked men armed with pistols shot and killed two former al Shabaab defectors in Bulo Xawo in the night of 24/01. Reports indicate that the victims were former al Shabaab fighters who had defected to ASWJ/Somali military forces in Gedo Region. The two men were coming out of a restaurant when they were shot. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Two civilians are killed in the Kenyan border town of Beled Hawo during the evening hours by unknown men armed with AK 47 rifles.

Unidentified attackers hurled two hand grenades against government forces in the former Milk factory building (Hodan District) in the night of 25/01. Security forces opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the private residence of a NSA officer in Berdale neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 25/01. Reports indicate that the officer was not in the house at the time of the incident. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed the head of a LNGO in Garsoor Village (Galkacyo North) in the evening of 25/01. Reports indicate that the victim had received threats through private call before the attack. The LNGO is an implementing partner for several INGOs. The perpetrators escaped from the scene. A pro-Somali website reported that the  victim was part of a western organization.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two militiamen near Busley Da'ud (25km NE of Qoryooley) in the afternoon of 25/01. The motive behind the killing is not clear. Two conflicting stories emerged, the first suggesting that the attackers were al Shabaab militiamen who acted against armed robbers in the area, the second that that the attackers were Habr-Gedir militiamen who killed the victims for clan revenge.  Reports indicate that the victims hailed from the Biimaal clan and that one of them was a brother of the District Commissioner of Marka.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a civilian man in Jamhuuriya neighbourhood (Kaqraan District) in the night of 26/01. The motive behind the killing is unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy passing in Biyo Deegaanka neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the morning of 27/01. Reports indicate that the device missed its target which was a water tanker. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy passing on Industrial Road through Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 27/01. Casualties could not be established. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

An unidentified attacker dressed in military uniform shot and killed an elderly man hailing from the Leelkase clan in Waberi neighbourhood in Garowe in the evening of 27/01. Reports indicate that the victim was attacked while coming back home from evening prayers. Unconfirmed initial reports suggest that the killing is a case of clan revenge related to a previous killing in Garowe a year ago. However, Puntland authorities blamed the killing on Al-Shabab despite no group claiming responsibility for the slaying of the clan elder. The perpetrator escaped from the scene.

Two rival youth groups started fighting using sticks and stones in Lixle neighbourhood (Burao) in the evening of 27/01. Reports indicate that the clash was triggered by a dispute over territory control. Police arrived at the scene and arrested a number of them.

Two rival youth groups started fighting using sticks and stones in Lixle neighbourhood (Burao) in the evening of 27/01. Reports indicate that the clash was triggered by a dispute over territory control. Police arrived at the scene and arrested a number of them.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy passing inside Wanla Weyne town in the afternoon of 28/01. Reports indicate that the device went off after the convoy had passed it. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A device suspected to be a RCIED exploded in a market (Yaaq Biri Weyne) in the afternoon of 28/01. Reports indicate that two people were reportedly killed in the blast while 14 others including two soldiers were injured. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A man armed with an AK-47 shot and killed a Koranic teacher in Gadoon village (40km E of Dhusamareeb) in the morning of 30/01. The killing is reportedly part of a cycle of revenge killings that opposes two sub-sub-sub clans of Ayr/Cabsiye. The perpetrator escaped from the scene. No arrest was reported.

Unidentified gunmen shot and seriously injured an unarmed Jubaland soldier in Dalcada neighbourhood in Kismaayo in the evening of 30/01. The victim was taken to hospital for treatment. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

An unidentified man armed with a pistol shot and killed a civilian man from the Ayr sub-clan near Topaz hotel in the market area in Galkacyo South in the evening of 30/01. The mobile phone of the victim was stolen by the killer. The victim was reportedly found with an Ethiopian ID card. The motivation of the killer is unascertained.

Unidentified attackers dressed in Puntland military uniform opened fire at a Toyota Mark 2 vehicle belonging to a member of the Dashishe clan on the outskirt of Garowe on 01/02. The vehicle was reportedly destroyed in the attack. Puntland security forces conducted a search operation in the area after the incident. The motivation of the perpetrators is unknown. It is not clear if the perpetrators were legitimate state soldiers.

Unidentified armed men in a civilian vehicle attacked Somali security forces onboard another vehicle in Dabakaayo Madow neighbourhood in the night of 02/02. The clash lasted for a few minutes. Casualties are unknown.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a section chief for Dharkeynley District close to the Dharkeynley district office in the morning of 02/02. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against a Somali government position in Hawl-Wadaag Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 02/02. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Armed men dressed in military uniform shot and killed a civilian man from whom they were trying to extort money in Abdalla Shideeye section of Bakaara market in the afternoon of 02/02. The perpetrators escaped from the scene. It is not clear if the perpetrators were legitimate government soldiers.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against Somali forces based in ex-Control Balcad in the early morning of 02/02. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against a police position in Dabka Junction (Hodan District) in the evening of 02/02. The police officers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against the security guards of Ambassador Hotel (Hodan District) in the evening of 02/02. Unconfirmed reports indicate that some civilians may have been injured or killed by the blast, though this has not been not confirmed. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a military position in Suuq Weyne neighbourhood (Wadajir/Medina District) in the evening of 02/02. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unknown men hurled hand grenades to the district commissioner's residence in Wadajir/Medina district. No injuries reported.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against military forces manning a check-point in Suuq Beerta Junction (Waaberi District) in the evening of 02/02/2014. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against police forces manning a check-point on 21st October road in Waaberi district in the evening of 02/02. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a military position in Afarta Jardiino Junction (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 02/02. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A group of Galgala armed militia were spotted close to Karin and Yalho villages (37km and 40km S of Bossaso) on 03/02. Reports indicate that Puntland forces clashed with the Galgala group. Details regarding casualties could not be established.

Unidentified armed men killed a woman in Boqoleyda section of Berdale neighbourhood in Baidoa town in the morning of 03/02/2014. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the victim was killed by some men with whom she was chewing khat just before the incident.

A RCIED targeted the vehicle of the deputy District Commissioner of Dayniile in Cise Abdi neighbourhood (Dayniile District) in the afternoon of 06/02. Reports show that the deputy DC was unhurt. A civilian vehicle was damaged in the blast but no human casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Masked men armed with revolvers shot and killed a Somali Government soldier at the back of Digfeer Hospital in Mogadishu's Hodan district.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Digfeer Hospital area (Hodan District) in the evening of 06/02. Reports indicate that the victim was unarmed when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified gunmen have shot dead a prominent Somali religious scholar in Mogadishu's Wadajir district. The man was kin to the former defence minister.
An unidentified gunman shot and killed a shopkeeper and his customer in Via Afmadow neighbourhood (Kismaayo) on 06/02. The motive is unknown. The perpetrator escaped.

A convoy carrying government soldiers numbering 40 vehicles arrived in Marka in the morning of 06/01. An unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at the convoy at Marka police station. Shooting, whose motive remains unclear, was also heard in Rusiya neighbourhood. One soldier was reportedly wounded in the hand grenade attack. The destination of the convoy is currently unclear.
Unidentified gunmen in a vehicle shot and injured two Jubaland soldiers in Calanley neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 07/02.The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified armed men shot and killed a Jubaland soldier in Haji Jama neighbourhood in Kismaayo in the evening of 07/02. Jubaland forces immediately launched a security operation to hunt the perpetrators.

Unidentified men assaulted and seriously injured a freelance journalist Dayaxa neighbourhood in Ceerigaabo on 07/02. The motive of the attack remains unknown but unconfirmed reports indicate that the attack was related to a report against the mayor. The perpetrators escaped.

Two groups of ASWJ forces clashed in Bulo Xawo in the mid-day of 08/02. The fighting broke out when ASWJ forces tried to arrest seven ASWJ fighters for disciplinary action and disarm them. The group refused to surrender and fighting broke out. Three ASWJ fighters were injured in the clash.

A RCIED targeted Somali forces in Shalaambood Village (10km W of Marka) in the morning of 08/02. One soldier was killed in the blast. The vehicle was also damaged in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

An IED targeted the car of Lower Shabelle deputy governor in front of Hormuud Trepiano building in Hodan District in the afternoon of 10/01. It is believed that the device was attached in the car. The deputy governor was seriously injured in the blast. Witnesses said that the official lost his legs.

A VBIED targeted the main gate of Oriental Hotel in Beyhani neighbourhood (Shibis District) in the afternoon of 10/02. Reports show that the VBIED car was parked in front of the hotel. It is believed that a remote control was used to detonate the VBIED. Two security guards were killed and four other people were injured. Latest reports indicate that the VBIED was targeted at a security meeting which was attended by the mayor of Mogadishu, regional police commander and District Commissioners from Mogadishu. No official was hurt in the blast.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces based at the former Central Bank in Horseed neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 10/02. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Somali forces near Samafone building in Adaada neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 10/02. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a Somali soldier in Bundoweyn neighbourhood (Beled Weyne) in the evening of 10/02. The victim was sitting alone near Bundoweyn bridge when the incident happened. Somali forces conducted a security operation after the incident but no arrests were made. The perpetrators escaped.

Somali forces attacked local militias manning a checkpoint in Mareerey Village (7km W of Afgooye) in the morning of 10/02. The soldiers attacked them after receiving reports that a new illegal checkpoint had been set up in the area. The soldiers managed to drive away the militias and destroy the checkpoint. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against Somali forces patrolling Dhama Yasin neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the evening of 11/02. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with pistols reportedly shot and killed a Heliwa district official in the evening of 11/02. The victim had left a mosque and was heading home when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in Lafoole neighbourhood (6km SE of Afgooye) in the afternoon of 11/02. The explosion missed the target and exploded just after the convoy had passed the spot. A civilian bystander was killed in the blast. The perpetrators escaped.

A few projectiles also landed close to the Pasta Factory in Yaaqshiid District. At least one woman was killed and two other civilians injured.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against soldiers near the Pasta Factory (Yaaqshiid District) in the night of 12/2. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A RCIED exploded close to the residence of a Somali MP in the Pasta Factory neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the night of 12/02. The blast damaged one side of the building. No casualties were reported.

Gunmen from the Marehan/Wagardhac sub-clan reportedly ambushed an ASWJ officer (Marehan/Eli)  in a two vehicles convoy between Dhabad and Galinsoor in the morning of 12/02. The driver of one of the vehicles was killed and another passenger injured. One vehicle was stolen and seen in the afternoon in Galkacyo South.
A RCIED exploded prematurely in Janaale in the morning of 12/02. Four civilians were reportedly injured by the blast.

Unknown assailants picked a Marehan man from his house and shot him in front of the house in Gulwade neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the night of 12/02. The motive is unknown and the perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy near Baar Ismail neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the morning of 12/02 with a RCIED attack. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. Casualties could not be established. The convoy was heading to Mogadishu when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a NISA (intelligence service) convoy in Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 13/02. The NISA Commander was reportedly in one of the vehicles. No damage or casualties were reported.

Suspected al Shabaab fighters fired several mortar rounds against AMISOM positions in Baidoa airport in the night of 13/02. Two rounds landed in the airport and four others in open areas. No damage or casualties were reported. The rounds were reportedly fired from a position NW of the airport.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in Ruusiya neighbourhood in Marka in the afternoon of 13/02. The RCIED missed its target. AMISOM soldiers opened fire after the blast and until being a few hundred meters away from the blast site. Two female bystanders were killed and three other civilians injured by the shooting.
