Unidentified men armed with Pistols shot and injured a SNG soldier in Zona K neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 04/09. The motive behind the attack is currently unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified two armed men dressed in SNG police uniform shot and killed a SNG military officer dressed in civilian attire driving a car in Haji Basto section of Taleex neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the morning of 06/09. The motive behind the killing is currently unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers shot and killed a SNG soldier in Xawo Tako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the night of 06/09. Reports indicate that the victim was manning an illegal checkpoint when the incident happened. The attackers also took the victim's gun. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED/Landmine targeted AMISOM convoy near Gol-Weyn village (21km SW of Marka) in the morning of 06/09. The device which was reportedly a landmine was planted on the road side and exploded before the AMISOM convoy reached the place. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified attackers fired three mortar rounds or B10 at Ceel Gaabta neighbourhood (Xamar Jajab District) in the evening of 07/09. Reports indicate that one of the rounds landed on a residential house and killed a child while both his parents were injured.

Unidentified men armed with Pistols shot and killed a NISA Soldier near Makah Al-Mukaram Hotel (Hodan District) in the night of 07/09. Reports indicate that the victim was a former al Shabaab defector who joined NISA forces in Mogadishu. The motive behind the killing remained unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted SNG forces convoy in Jimbiley village (10km W of Jalalaqsi) in the afternoon of 08/09. The convoy came from Buulo Burte and was heading to Jalalaqsi when the incident happened. A clan elder was killed in the explosion.
An IED targeted a vehicle belongs to Jubaland forces passing in Farjano neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 08/09. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers ambushed a vehicle transporting Khat near K50 (21km SW of Afgooye) in the afternoon of 08/09. Reports indicate that the vehicle was from Mogadishu and was heading to Buulo Mareer when the ambush happened. The driver managed to drive off without stopping. Three passengers were injured.

A RCIED targeted SNG forces' vehicle near Banaadir Junction (Wadajir-Medina District) in the afternoon of 09/09. The device exploded after the vehicle passed the area. SNG forces based at Banaadir Junction opened fire after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.

Militias loyal to Haji Bakin (the former governor of Bari Region) shot and injured a civilian man in the morning of 10/09. The reason behind the shooting is currently unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a Molotov cocktail at an AMISOM convoy near Livestock Market (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 13/09. Reports indicate that the AMISOM convoy reacted with gunfire after the blast. A civilian bystander was injured in the subsequent shooting.
Unidentified attackers shot and injured a NISA Officer in Nasteexo neighbourhood (Wadajir-Medina District) in the evening of 13/09. The Perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Beytu-Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the evening of 13/09. Reports indicate that victim used to sell sim-cards to AMISOM troops based in the outskirts of Marka and it's believed that killing is related to his relationship with the forces. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy near Buulo Mareer (29km SW of Marka) in the afternoon of 14/09. Reports indicate that the AMISOM forces opened fire in response to the blast. The convoy was coming back from Kurtunwaarey when the incident happened. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

A RCIED targeted AMISOM convoy inside Buulo Mareer town (29km SW of Marka) in the morning of 15/09.  Reports indicate that the blast reportedly damaged an AMISOM Casper carrier. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against a crowd of people in a market in Buulo Mareer (29km SW of Marka) who were by then busy buying and selling Khat in the afternoon of 15/09. Two people were killed while three others were reportedly injured. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle carrying SNG forces near former Milk Factory (Hodan District) in the morning of 16/09.  Reports indicate that the blast destroyed the vehicle. Two soldiers were killed while a dozen of others were injured. SNG forces in the area arrived at the scene and arrested unspecified numbers of people suspected of having link with the incident.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian woman near Mogadishu Stadium (Wardhiigley District) in the morning of 16/09. The motive behind the killing is currently unclear but unconfirmed reports indicate that the victim reportedly had business relations with AMISOM based at the Stadium. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against an AMISOM convoy passing at Sarta Minashiibiyo area (Marka) in the afternoon of 16/09. Reports indicate that the convoy stopped following the blast and the attackers open fire at the forces before escaping. The AMISOM forces responded by firing towards to the attackers. Casualties are unknown.

Two men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier near Sarta Minashiibiyo (Marka) in the morning of 18/09. The victim had left a local teashop and was heading to his base when the incident happened.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at SNG forces on foot patrol near Mukayga area in Afgooye in the evening of 19/09. No casualties were reported.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy near Via Afmadow Market  in Shaqaalaha neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 20/09. AMISOM forces opened fire after the blast. Jubaland forces arrived and checked the area for other RCIEDs.
At least five civilians are killed after a road-side blast targeting AMISOM-Burundi forces in the Dalcadda area of Calanley neighbourhood.

Pro-SNG forces in Luuq attacked al Shabaab fighters in Maganey Village (10km S of Luuq) in the afternoon of 22/09. The soldiers launched the attack after a tip off that a group of al Shabaab fighters arrived in the village to collect zakat from the locals. The two sides exchanged gunfire briefly after which the al Shabaab fighters withdrew. A pro-SNG soldier and a number of al Shabaab fighters were  injured in the clash.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in Buulo Jaan neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 23/09. AMISOM forces opened fire after the blast. The convoy was heading towards Ceel-Jaale (7km SW of Marka) when the incident happened. Two AMISOM soldiers were reportedly killed in the blast while a civilian was injured in the shooting. The perpetrator escaped.
A RCIED targeted Jubaland forces' patrol vehicle in Shaqalaha area in Via Afmadow in the evening of 24/09. No casualties were reported and the perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against SNG police manning a check-point in Zoobe Junction (Wadajir District) in the evening of 25/09. Reports indicate that the police responded by firing after the blast. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Tensions reportedly ran high after militiamen (Habar-Gidir/Sa'ad reer Jalaf sub-clan) blocked the security guards of Gen. Abdi Qaybdid on the road between Galkacyo and Cadaado in the afternoon of 25/09. Reports indicate that the two sides briefly clashed after which the security guards over powered the militiamen and forcefully passed the road block with three battle wagons while other soldiers with seven battle wagons remained at the road block scene. The security guards were heading to Cadaado to escort president Qaybdid back to Galkacyo.  Both sides are reportedly calling for more reinforcement. Two reer Jalaf militiamen and a local sheikh who was trying to mediate between the two sides were injured.

Pro-Somaliland militias (Warsangeli/Dubeys sub-clan) attacked pro-Puntland militias of the same sub-clan based in Dhahar (170km S Laas-Qoray) in the afternoon of 25/09. Reports indicate that the clash followed after Puntland delegations led by the minister of livestock and the deputy minister of justice (both Warsangeli) visited Dhahar on a mission to mobilize the local residents to nominate members of the local councilors and to open a local government office.  Local traditional elders intervened and managed to stop the brief clash between the two sides. A pro-Puntland militia was reportedly killed while a pro-Somaliland militia was also injured. Latest reports on 26/09 indicate that Somaliland deployed five battle wagons in Dhahar following the clash.

Pro-Somaliland militias (Warsangeli/Dubeys sub-clan) attacked pro-Puntland militias of the same sub-clan based in Dhahar (170km S Laas-Qoray) in the afternoon of 25/09. Reports indicate that the clash followed after Puntland delegations led by the minister of livestock and the deputy minister of justice (both Warsangeli) visited Dhahar on a mission to mobilize the local residents to nominate members of the local councilors and to open a local government office.  Local traditional elders intervened and managed to stop the brief clash between the two sides. A pro-Puntland militia was reportedly killed while a pro-Somaliland militia was also injured. Latest reports on 26/09 indicate that Somaliland deployed five battle wagons in Dhahar following the clash.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a vehicle carrying the deputy District Commissioner of Afgooye near the DC's office in Afgooye in the morning of 25/09. One of the guards of the deputy DC was injured by the explosion. SNG forces conducted a security operation immediately after the blast and arrested unspecified number of suspects. The perpetrators reportedly managed to escape.
Gunmen armed with pistols have shot dead a Somali army commander of Hiiraan region in central town of Beled Weyne.

Puntland security forces in Xarfo conducted a security operation on the road between Xarfo (70km N of Galkacyo) and Burtinle in the evening of 27/09. Reports indicate that the forces were targeting unidentified armed group who erected an illegal road block to rob public passengers using the road. The forces seized Puntland Darawish uniforms, an AK-47 rifle and a Toyota Land Cruiser used by the perpetrators. A Puntland soldier was injured during the operation. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Beytu-Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the night of 27/09. The motive behind the killing is currently unclear but reports indicate that the victim used to sell alcoholic substances inside his residence.

A RCIED apparently targeting a teashop frequented by SNG soldiers in Kabooley market (Baled Xaawo) in the afternoon of 28/09. Two civilians were reportedly killed while a SNG police man and a civilian were injured.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a prominent Sheikh inside a mosque in Hawl-Wadaag neighbourhood (Beled-weyne) in the night of 29/09. Reports indicate that the victim was an imam for the mosque. The motive behind the killing is currently unclear. The perpetrators escape.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man inside his house in Beytu-Raas neighbourhood (Marka) in the night of 29/09. The motive behind the killing is currently unknown. The victim hails from Rahanweyn and he use to work in the police station during Indho Cade's administration. The Perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade giants SNG forces based at Buunda Weyne Bridge (Beled Weyne) in the evening of 30/09. Reports indicate that the device landed in an empty place causing no casualties.

A RCIED targeted AMISOM convoy in Ruusiya neighbourhood (Marka) in the afternoon of 30/09. Reports indicate that the forces open fire in response to the blast. The convoy was coming back from AMISOM base in Ceel-Haji when the incident happened. One civilian was killed, three others were injured and two shops were caught up by fire in the subsequent shooting while an AMISOM vehicle was damaged.

A RCIED targeted Jubaland forces riding on vehicle conducting a security patrol in Farjano neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the morning of 01/10. Two soldiers and two civilian's bystanders were injured while the vehicle was partially destroyed.

A RCIED targeted AMISOM convoy near Gol-Weyn (21km SW of Marka) in the afternoon of 01/10. The convoy was heading to Buulo Mareer when the incident happened. One AMISOM carrier was damaged by the blast.
A RCIED targeted SNG military vehicle on the road near Yaaq Biri Weyne in the morning of 01/10. A SNG soldier was reportedly injured.

A man shot and seriously injured a SNG soldier in an IDP camp in Luuq in the evening of 02/10. The motive is unknown. The soldier is based in Yurkud (40km SE of Luuq) and was visiting his sick father in the camp when the incident happened - it is not clear if the soldier was in uniform. The perpetrator, a former al Shabaab fighter who current affiliation is not known, was immediately arrested by pro-SNG forces and handed over to AMISOM (ENDF).

Pro-SNG forces from Wajiid conducting security operation clashed with al Shabaab fighters in Aleemow Village (19km NE of Waajid) in the morning of 03/10. Seven al Shabaab fighters were killed in the clash. The pro-SNG forces also seized four guns during the clash. Their bodies were brought to Waajid and displayed to the public.
A RCIED targeted SNG forces in the livestock market neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 03/10. Two soldiers were injured in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a SNG forces' convoy near Ceelesha settlement (Afgooye District) in the afternoon of 03/10. The soldiers opened fire after the blast. One soldier was killed and two others injured in the blast.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at SNG police on foot patrol at Sanca Junction (Kaaraan District) in the morning of 04/10. The police officers opened fire after the blast. Two civilians were injured in the shooting. The perpetrators managed to escape.

ASWJ forces and the body guards of the Guri Ceel District Commissioner exchanged fire in the town in the morning of 04/10. The shootout started after ASWJ forces tried to arrest the DC of Guri Ceel, who had been holding a meeting with a youth group, whose top agenda was supporting the SNG's efforts of establishing the central Somali state. The two sides exchanged gunfire briefly after which the ASWJ forces withdrew. The meeting resumed after the shootout.

ASWJ forces attacked a residence in Guri Ceel where two ASWJ militiamen who deserted the force were chewing khat in the afternoon of 04/10. The two sides exchanged gunfire for about 10 minutes after which the ASWJ forces withdrew. One ASWJ soldier was killed and another wounded. The two defectors (target men) escaped from the scene unhurt. The ASWJ forces involved in the attack were later arrested.

ASWJ forces attacked a residence in Guri Ceel where two ASWJ militiamen who deserted the force were chewing khat in the afternoon of 04/10. The two sides exchanged gunfire for about 10 minutes after which the ASWJ forces withdrew. One ASWJ soldier was killed and another wounded. The two defectors (target men) escaped from the scene unhurt. The ASWJ forces involved in the attack were later arrested.

Two men armed with pistols shot and injured a SNG police officer in the vicinity of Bakaara Junction (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 06/10. A bus conductor was killed in the same incident. It is not known if both victims were targeted or if the conductor was a bystander. The perpetrators escaped.
A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in the vicinity of Goobweyne (14km NE of Kismaayo) in the morning of 06/10. A KDF armoured vehicle was damaged in the explosion. Casualties are unknown.
A RCIED targeted Jubaland forces' vehicle in Lugloow Village (19km NE of Kismaayo) in the morning of 06/10.  Three soldiers were killed and eight others were injured in the blast.
RCIED targeted SNG forces on foot patrol in Afgooye's livestock market in the afternoon of 06/10. The device was reportedly planted in a garbage container. Three soldiers were injured.

An IED believed to be magnetic detonated in a car at Cinema Super area (Xamar Weyne District) in the evening of 10/10. The device was attached to the vehicle. SNG police arrived at the scene and arrested the driver of the car for further questioning. No casualties were reported. Causalities/injuries not reported. It was later learned the car belonged to the former Mogadishu mayor.

A unidentified man stabbed four people in 26 June District (Hargeisa) in the afternoon of 10/10. The attacker was willing to be nominated as a candidate for the coming parliamentary election in 2015, whereby the victims opposed his candidature according to clan elder's preferences. The local people managed to apprehend the perpetrator and handed over to the police.

Unidentified men armed with Pistols shot and killed a SNG Soldier in Trebuunka area (Hodan District) in the evening of 11/10. SNG soldiers in the area arrived at the scene but made no arrest. The perpetrators escaped.

A vehicle loaded with explosives detonated in front of Aroma Restaurant at Makah Al-Mukaram Road (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 12/10. The vehicle was at the parking yard when the incident happened. Reports indicate that Hawl-Wadaag District Commissioner and other government officials were present in the hotel at the time of the incident but none of them were hurt. The restaurant was hosting an event to mark 60th anniversary when Somalia flag was found.  Thirteen (13) people were killed while 18 others were injured.
Unidentified gunmen shoot and severely injure a local journalist during an attack in Hawl Wadaag District.
Unidentified attackers shot and injured a local journalist in Black Sea neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 12/10. Reports indicate that the victim was the head of Somali Channel TV.

Unidentified armed men dressed in SNG uniform open fire at public transport vehicle at Fagax Junction (Yaaqshiid District). It is not clear if the attackers were legitimate soldiers.  The reason behind the shooting is currently unknown.  A woman was killed. The perpetrators escaped.

Pro-SNG (not identified) forces based in Xudur conducted a security operation in Qeedi area (25kms N of Xudur) in the afternoon of 13/10. The security forces reportedly killed an al Shabaab fighter in the area and returned to their base in Xudur.

A VBIED exploded in a garage in Black Sea neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the morning of 13/10. A NISA vehicle was being repaired in the garage when the incident happened. It remains unclear whether it was an accidental explosion or detonated intentionally. The VBIED driver was killed and a mechanic repairing the NISA vehicle was injured.
An unidentified assailants attacks and beheads a men as he left a mosque following evening prayers. The reason for the attack is not known.

A device believed to be an IED was discovered near Ramadan Hotel (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 13/10. The device went off before the EOD team, who had arrived in the area, began to disable it.

Militiamen loyal to Bare Hiiraale attacked Jubaland forces fetching water from River Juba in Goob Weyn (14km NE of Kismaayo) in the morning of 13/10. The attackers are part of Bare Hiraale's militias who didn't surrender themselves to Jubaland authorities. Two Jubaland soldiers were injured.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a businessman and injured another person near the District Commissioner's office in Dayniile District in the morning of 14/10. The motive is unknown but reports indicate that the victim was an engineer working for Dayniile District administration on road reconstruction projects. The perpetrators took away his car but later abandoned it in the vicinity of the incident scene.
A Somali man who recently returned from Canada has beheaded a worshipper at a mosque. The location of the mosque within Mogadishu is not known.

Jubaland forces fired mortar rounds to the positions of Bare Hiraale's militias in Goob Weyn (14km NE of Kismaayo) in the morning of 14/10 in retaliation to an earlier attack by the militias. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified attackers armed with pistols shot and killed a civilian man in Qoryooley in the evening of 14/10. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the victim defected from al Shabaab and used to run a restaurant in the town frequented by SNG soldiers. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers fired four mortar or B10 rounds in Wardhiigley, Boondheere and Shibis districts in the evening of 15/10. All the mortars landed in open areas and caused no casualties.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in Bakaara Market (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the morning of 15/10. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers fired four mortar or B10 rounds in Wardhiigley, Boondheere and Shibis districts in the evening of 15/10. All the mortars landed in open areas and caused no casualties.
Unidentified attackers fired four mortar or B10 rounds in Wardhiigley, Boondheere and Shibis districts in the evening of 15/10. All the mortars landed in open areas and caused no casualties.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle belonging to NISA in the vicinity of Afarta Jardiino neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the afternoon of 15/10. The device is believed to have been planted in the vehicle. Two NISA soldiers were killed and at least six civilians injured.

Ahmad Madobe's militiamen (those loyal to southern Somalia regional administration) and al Shabaab clash in the village of Khaam Khaam, near Yoontoy Yarey. Casualties reported, though numbers were not provided. Later reports indicate the causality totals could be as high as 60 - Radio Al-Furqaan, which is pro-al Shabaab.

Unidentified gunmen ambushed a vehicle transporting khat near Ceel-Wareegow Village (17km SW of Marka) in the afternoon of 17/10. The khat traders were also armed and exchanged gunfire with the gunmen. Two Khat traders were reportedly injured in the shoot-out. The vehicle came from Mogadishu and was heading to Shalaambood and Buulo Mareer villages when the incident happened.

Unidentified gunmen ambushed a vehicle transporting khat near Ceel-Wareegow Village (17km SW of Marka) in the afternoon of 17/10. The khat traders were also armed and exchanged gunfire with the gunmen. Two Khat traders were reportedly injured in the shoot-out. The vehicle came from Mogadishu and was heading to Shalaambood and Buulo Mareer villages when the incident happened.

Pro-SNG (not named) forces attacked al Shabaab fighters in Baana Village (16km SE of Xudur) in the morning of 18/10. The two sides exchanged gunfire briefly after which the pro-SNG forces withdrew. Two pro-SNG solders and three al Shabaab fighters were reportedly killed a pro-SNG soldier was also injured in the clash.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two men near Carwo Limoni (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 19/10. The motive is currently unclear but unconfirmed reports indicate that the victims used to sell khat to SNG soldiers in the area.
A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy in the vicinity of SOS Junction (Heliwa District) in the afternoon of 19/10. Casualties are unknown. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in Black sea neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the night of 20/10. The motive behind the killing is currently unclear. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified gunmen armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in Arwo Itka Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the afternoon of 21/10. The motive behind the killing is currently unclear.

A RCIED targeted AMISOM convoy passing near Beerta Liinta in the vicinity of Mooda-Mooda village (25km SE of Baidoa) in the morning of 21/10. The device reportedly hit a fuel tanker burning it completely. Local farmers in the area run away immediately from the incident scene but AMISOM forces chased them and managed to arrest one of the farmers. It's currently unclear if the farmers had connection with attack.

Unidentified attackers ambushed SNG soldiers escorting a lorry carrying food stuffs in Kali-Caafimaad area (20km NE of Marka) in the afternoon of 21/10. The ambush followed extensive fighting where SNG soldiers called for reinforcement from Shalaambood forcing the attackers to withdraw. At least five combatants from both sides and a civilian were killed while around 10 others were injured.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against at a NISA checkpoint in Ceymiska neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 22/10. The hand grenade was followed by exchange of gunfire between the attackers and the NISA forces which lasted for about ten minutes after which the attackers withdrew. Casualties are unknown.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and injured a local elder in Xaawo Taako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the night of 22/10. The victim was coming out of a mosque when the incident happened. The motive behind the attack is not known. The perpetrators escaped.

An AMISOM convoy comes under grenade attack in Marka's Ruusiya and Bayturaas neighbourhoods. Following the attacks angered AMISOM forces committed atrocities against civilians in the town, including killing three elders.
A Somali soldier is shot and killed in the Suuqa Xoolaha neighbourhood. Perpetrators not known.

A RCIED targeted a vehicle carrying the District Commissioner of Yaaqshiid near Lafweyn Hotel (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 23/10. The device detonated after the DC's vehicle passed over the area. The security guards of the DC opened fire in response to the blast. A female bystander was injured in the subsequent shooting.

Unidentified men hurled a hand grenade at a police post near Afar-irdoodka in Horseed neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the evening of 23/10. SNG police open fire and managed to apprehend the perpetrator. A young boy and a woman selling tea in the area were injured by the blast.
Puntland forces launch an attack on a Galmudug held area. Galmudug forces reportedly "repulsed the attackers." Causalities not known .
A senior Raskamboni official is killed and his bodyguard injured in a blast outside his mosque following Friday prayers. Perpetrators not known.
A senior Raskamboni official is killed and his bodyguard injured in a blast outside his mosque following Friday prayers. Perpetrators not known.

A vehicle laden with explosive devices detonated in front of Golden Hotel near Shaqalaha junction along Makah Al-Mukaram road (Waberi District) in the morning of 25/10. Reports indicate that the vehicle belongs to a SNG official which could not be independently verified. Two people were killed while four others, mostly civilians were injured.

Unidentified gunman driving in a vehicle opens fire against a vehicle belonging to an MP (Dhulbahante) along Taleex road (Hodan District) in the morning of 26/10. The MP survived from the attack. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the NISA soldiers are reportedly after the attacker's vehicle but no arrests were reported.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against a private house in Argada neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 26/10. The targeted house was hosting an elders meeting (Ogaden/Absame) when the incident happened.  Four people including an elder were injured. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade against SNG forces based in Xawo Taako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the evening of 26/10. SNG forces open in respond to the blast. Two SNG soldiers were killed and three others were injured.

Unidentified men armed with pistols abducted a SNG soldier (armed) in the vicinity of former Milk Factory (Hodan District) in the evening of 27/10. It's not clear whether the abductors were NISA agents or al Shabaab operatives. The whereabouts of the soldier is currently unknown.

ASWJ security forces conducted security operation in Guri-Ceel in the morning of 27/10 in order to arrest a Khat dealer. The ASWJ forces clashed with security guards of the business man for about 10 minutes. The targeted man escaped while the situation in the town is tense.

Unidentified armed men shot and killed a taxi driver from Habar-Gidir near Norway Hospital in Galkacyo (North) in the morning of 27/10. The gunmen drove off the car in to unknown destination. The motive is reportedly related to an earlier carjacking incident by Sa'ad gunman.

A RCIED targeted a tea shop frequented by SNG soldiers in Daynuunay village (18kms SE of Baidoa) in the morning of 28/10. One person was killed and five others, including two children, the owner of the teashop (female) and a SNG soldier were injured.

Al Shabaab fighters and local farmers engaged an armed clash near Mahadaay (20km N of Jowhar) in the afternoon of 29/10. The fighting started after the al Shabaab fighters called the farmers in the area to pay Zakat, a call denied by the farmers which turned into armed confrontations. Three al Shabaab fighters were reportedly killed in the clashes.

On 30 October, a powerful explosion occurred at the junction of Ex-Control Balcad in Mogadishu's Hiliwaa district and caused death and injuries, which were not numbered. The explosion targeted one of the district commissioners of Banaadir region according to our sources and eyewitnesses.
The SNG commissioner of police is discovered dead under mysterious circumstances on 30/10. Date of death not known.
Suspected al Shabaab target a group of "apostate militiamen" with an explosive, killing three.  Radio Andalus is pro-al Shabaab.

RCIED targeted AMISOM troops on foot patrol in Sheekh Abroone neighbourhood in Marka in the morning of 30/10. The soldiers started shelling Ruusiya and Sheekh Abroone neighbourhoods after the blast. Two civilians were killed and more than eight others injured.

RCIED targeted a group of SNG soldiers in a teashop in Baraawe in the morning of 31/10. The RCIED was probably planted in the teashop and detonated by use of a remote-control. Two SNG soldiers were killed and another injured in the explosion. SNG forces conducted a security operation after blast and arrested a number of suspects.

A vehicle laden with explosive devices detonated near Trebuunka Junction (Hodan District) in the morning of 01/11. The driver (owner) was killed in the blast and a civilian passer-by injured. The motive of the attack is currently unknown. The driver/owner owned a local travel agency owner.
A RCIED targeted a SNG forces' vehicle in Jiiro Garoob neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 01/11. Two SNG soldiers were reportedly wounded in the explosion. The perpetrators escaped.
Pro-SNG forces (not identified) on security operation clashed with al Shabaab in Moro Gabey (28km NW of Xudur) on 02/11. One al Shabaab fighter was killed. Pro-SNG forces return to Xudur.

Three RCIEDs were targeted at AMISOM military convoy in Biyo Degaanka neighbourhood (Heliwa District) in the morning of 02/11. Unspecific numbers of AMISOM vehicles were damaged in the explosion. Casualties could not be established.

Unidentified armed men in car shot and killed a man reportedly working for the Somali Ministry of Foreign Affairs and injured two others in Bulo Hubey neighbourhood (Wadajir District) in the morning of 02/11. The gunmen used their car to block the victim's car and opened fire before speeding off.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two girls in Suuq Boocle neighbourhood (Wadajir-Medina District) in the morning of 02/11. The reason is unknown and the perpetrators escaped.

ACTOR1: ASWJ-Sufa: Ahlu Sunna Wal Jamaa (Sufa Faction)
NOTES: ASWJ (Sufa) militia and SNG police forces exchanged gunfire for about 5 minutes in Dhusamareeb on 2/10 after the two sides suspected each other. One ASWJ soldier was injured.

Unidentified men armed with knives killed a civilian woman in Jamacaddaha neighbourhood of Hodan District in the evening of 03/11. The reason for the killing of the woman is unknown and the perpetrators managed to escape from the scene, the woman was reportedly stabbed several times by the attackers.

ACTOR1: ASWJ-Sufa: Ahlu Sunna Wal Jamaa (Sufa Faction)
NOTES: Pro-SNG militia and Sufa militia exchanged gunfire for about 10 minutes in Dhusamareeb in the morning of 4/11 following a heated dispute between the two sides. The situation in Dhusamareeb remains a bit tense. No casualties were reported.

Pro-SNG militia and Sufa militia exchanged gunfire for about 10 minutes in Dhusamareeb in the morning of 4/11 following a heated dispute between the two sides. The situation in Dhusamareeb remains a bit tense. No casualties were reported.
A gunman shot at a INGO vehicle at Garsaal (45km NE of Ceel- Waaq) on 07/11. No casualties.

Unidentified armed militia in a vehicle apparently attempted to assassinate a Turkish construction engineer in Banadir neighbourhood of Hodan District on 08/11. The driver (Somali) of the Turkish engineer was injured in a gunfire opened by the militia. The engineer was in a nearby shop when they opened fire on his vehicle parked in front of the shop. The exact reason behind the attack is not clear.

Galgala insurgents fired mortar rounds to the position of Puntland government in Galgala vicinity, 35km SW of Bossaso in the evening of 07/11 in retaliation to an earlier attack by Puntland forces. No casualties were reported.
Unknown men armed with pistols shot and killed the chief of custodial corps of Marka District in Beytu-raas neighbourhood in Marka in the evening of 08/11. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.

A magnetic IED explosion targeted a local journalist at Km-4 Junction of Hodan District in the night of 09/11. The journalist was reportedly injured and lost one leg in the explosion. The reason behind the attack remains unknown. No other casualties were reported.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in Via Liberia road in Waaberi District in the evening of 09/11. The perpetrators reportedly managed to escape.
A RCIED explosion occurred in Guulwade neighbourhood of Kismayo in the evening of 09/11. The blast caused no causalities. The target remains unknown.

Unidentified armed men in a luxury car shot dead a civilian man (translator for Turkish) in Korontada Junction area in Wadajir (Medina) District in the afternoon of 10/11. The reason behind the killing of the man is unknown. The perpetrators escaped.
An explosion believed to be RCIED was heard from Xaaji Jamac Mosque neighbourhood of Kismayo town in the morning of 10/11. The target and the casualties are so far unknown.

A RCIED targeted a police officer from Puntland police forces as he was passing next to a police checkpoint near Cagaarweyne hotel in Garsoor neighbourhood Galkacyo (North) in the morning of 10/11. Reports indicate that the soldiers opened fire after the blast.

Unidentified armed men opened fire on a car transporting a Somali MP in SIMAD University Campus area of Xamar Jabjab District in the morning of 11/11. The MP apparently survived while his driver and a bodyguard were injured in the attack. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at Jubaland forces position at Argada neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the evening of 11/11. The Jubaland soldiers open fire in response to the blast. Two civilian bystanders were injured. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at the compound of Kismaayo District Office in the morning of 11/11. At least 15 people were injured. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy passing near Rage-Ceele (45km NE of Warsheikh) in the morning of 11/11. The device reportedly hit and damaged one of the convoy vehicles. Rage-Ceele chief said one of AMISOM soldier was injured in the attack but no neutral sources could confirm the exact figure of AMISOM casualties.

Unidentified armed men in a vehicle killed the Deputy District Commissioner of Hawl-wadaag District and three of his bodyguards after opening fire on his car in Suuq Weyne Area in Wadajir (Medina) District in the morning of 12/11. The perpetrators escaped from the scene shortly after the incident.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier and his son in Sebiano neighbourhood (Hodan District) in the evening of 13/11. The perpetrators escaped.
An RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy near Danow village (16km W of Marka) in the morning of 13/11. The device reportedly exploded after the convoy passed the place. No casualties were reported.

Al Shabaab fighters and local herders engaged an armed clash near Caad settlement (45km N of Xarardheere) in the afternoon of 15/11. The fighting broke out after the pastoralists refused to pay Zakat demanded by the al Shabaab fighters. One al Shabaab fighter was reportedly killed and other injured in the clash.

A RCIED targeted an AMISOM convoy near Lafoole (6km SE of Afgooye) in the morning of 15/11. The convoy stopped and blocked the road after the explosion. One AMISOM vehicle was badly damaged in the explosion. Casualties could not be established.
A device believed to be a magnetic IED attached to a private car exploded along Maka al-Mukarama road (Waberi District) in the afternoon of 16/11. The driver was injured in the blast.

A large number of people took to the streets of Baidoa in the morning of 17/11 in protest against the planned election of SW3 president. The protesters, mostly supporters of SW6, burnt tires in front of the main police station, the general hospital and Afar Irdoodka Junction. The demonstration comes at a time delegates attending the SW3 conference are preparing to elect the president of Southwest Somali state. A teenage boy was killed and two others injured after SW3 militia reportedly opened fire at the demonstrators.
A London-based, Somali-born journalist is killed in Galkacyo North by unknown assailants.

A local police man (civilian police) shot and killed a civilian man (Rahanweyn/Elaay sub-clan) in food market in Bulo Nuriye section of Isha neighbourhood (Baidoa) in the afternoon of 21/11. Reports indicate that the victim refused to pay extortion money demanded by the perpetrator and subsequent killing.

A RCIED targeted AMISOM convoy transporting logistics to Baidoa in Burjeedka (8km E of Baidoa) in the evening of 21/11. The convoy stayed overnight at the scene, following damaged inflicted by the blast in to one of their carrier and reached Baidoa safely in the following morning.  The communication network was suspended from morning up to 14:00, to avoid further targeted explosions.

Unidentified armed men driving in a car shot and killed a SNG soldier on a security patrol in the vicinity of KM-4 junction (Hodan District) in the night of 22/11. Reports indicate that the officer stopped the car for checking when the incident happened. The perpetrators escaped.

SNG forces clashed with local militias in Xawaadley village (27km NE of Balcad) in the afternoon of 22/11. Unconfirmed reports indicate that the local militias initiated the fighting following after SNG forces destroyed marijuana plantations. Two combatants were killed while three others were injured.

Unidentified armed men with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in the Livestock Market neighbourhood of Heliwa District in the afternoon of 24/11. The perpetrators managed to escape with the victim's gun.

Unidentified attackers targeted a SNG vehicle with a RCIED in Taleex neighbourhood in Hodan District in the afternoon of 24/11. The SNG forces in the vehicle opened fire after the explosion. No casualties were reported and the perpetrators managed to escape from the scene.

A RCIED targeted a SNG military vehicle at Siinka Dheer (Dharkenley District) in the morning of 26/11. The device missed its target and SNG forces open fire following the blast. Two civilians were killed in the subsequent shooting. The perpetrator(s) managed to escape.

Two unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG police officer near Khat market in Sei Piano (Hodan District) in the night of 26/11. The motive is unknown, though al Shabaab has a history of targeting kehat sellers, buyers and users. The perpetrators escaped.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Three artillery or B10 rounds fired from an unknown location landed in Cabbicasiis, Xamar Weyne and Shibis Districts in the afternoon of 27/11. One of the rounds landed in the vicinity of Lido Beach (Cabbicasiis), one in the area of Village restaurant (Xamar Weyne) and the third one in an unknown location in Shibis. No casualties or injuries reported.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Three artillery or B10 rounds fired from an unknown location landed in Cabbicasiis, Xamar Weyne and Shibis Districts in the afternoon of 27/11. One of the rounds landed in the vicinity of Lido Beach (Cabbicasiis), one in the area of Village restaurant (Xamar Weyne) and the third one in an unknown location in Shibis. No casualties or injuries reported.

An engineer working for a Turkish company is killed in a bomb blast at an unknown location in Mogadishu. There was no immediate claim of responsibility. It is not clear if the victim was Turkish, or simply working for a Turkish corporation.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Three artillery or B10 rounds fired from an unknown location landed in Cabbicasiis, Xamar Weyne and Shibis Districts in the afternoon of 27/11. One of the rounds landed in the vicinity of Lido Beach (Cabbicasiis), one in the area of Village restaurant (Xamar Weyne) and the third one in an unknown location in Shibis. No casualties or injuries reported.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a local municipal staff in Xawo Taako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the morning of 29/11. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a man in Xawo Taako neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the evening of 29/11. The motive behind the killing is currently unknown. The victim used to run money exchange business but other reports indicate that he was a local traditional elder. The perpetrators escaped.
Reports coming out of Hodan District say that a powerful explosion was heard there this evening. The target of the attack remains unknown.

A blast targeted a combat vehicle carrying federal government soldiers in Yaaqshiid District, northeast Mogadishu. Witnesses said eight people, six of them federal government soldiers, were killed in the attack. The targeted vehicle is reported to have sustained extensive damage. Though the Somali Memo is pro-al Shabaab, any information as to the identities of the perpetrators is not known.

Unidentified men armed with Pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in Embagathi neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the night of 30/11. The reason behind his killing is currently unknown. The perpetrators escaped from the scene.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in Dhagaxtur neighbourhood (Afgooye) in the night of 30/11. The reason behind the attack is unclear and the perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified men armed with Pistols shot and killed a businessman in Buunda Yaris area (Afgooye) in the evening of 30/11. Reports indicate that the victim had reportedly business link with SNG forces. The perpetrators escape from the scene.
A RCIED attack targeted SNG military vehicle Arafat neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 01/12 but it missed the target, causing no casualties. The perpetrators escaped.

Two pro-SNG forces (not identified) exchanged gunfire in Ceelwaq in the afternoon of 01/12. The shoot-out broke out after local authorities attempted to arrest a group of pro-SNG soldiers who shot in the air over unknown reason in the night of 30/11 but the soldiers defended themselves. The soldiers were later arrested. No casualties reported.

Two pro-SNG forces (not identified) exchanged gunfire in Ceelwaq in the afternoon of 01/12. The shoot-out broke out after local authorities attempted to arrest a group of pro-SNG soldiers who shot in the air over unknown reason in the night of 30/11 but the soldiers defended themselves. The soldiers were later arrested. No casualties reported.
A local journalist is believed to have been kidnapped and take to a location near the Ethiopian border.

A VBIED targeted a UN convoy near the civilian gate of Mogadishu airport located between Jazeera Hotel and a checkpoint manned by NISA officers (Wadajir District) in the morning of 03/12. Four people-the purported bomber, two NISA soldiers and a civilian bystander-were killed in the explosion, while 12 others, including seven UN escort guards,  were injured but no UN staff suffered casualties. Two UN vehicles were also damaged. SNG police and NISA were deployed in the area after the blast to search all public vehicles and pedestrians using the road.
A RCIED targeted an AMISOM supply convoy in Lafoole settlement (Afgooye District) in the morning of 03/12. A fuel tanker was damaged in the explosion. No casualties reported.

Unidentified gunmen killed a former SNG MP and seriously injured a sitting MP in a drive by shooting near Dahabshiil office in Xamar Weyne District in the morning of 04/12. The driver of the MP was also killed. NISA officers arrived at the scene and immediately pursued the perpetrator.

A RCIED targeted a residence where Jubaland intelligence officers stay in Farjano neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the night of 04/12. The device was reportedly planted on the window of the house. No casualties were reported. The perpetrators escaped.
Two unidentified gunmen shot and killed a tax collector in Xawo Tako neighbourhood in Afgoye in the evening of 04/12. The motive is unclear and the perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified gunmen picked three men hailing from Biyomaal clan from their houses in Shalanbood settlement of Marka District and killed them in the village in the night of 04/12. The reason for the killing remains unclear and the perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at a residential house of a local staff (Darod/Ogaden) of Golis Telecommunication company in Raf iyo Raaxo neighbourhood (Bosasso) in the evening of 05/12. The perpetrator escaped. Causalities, damage not known.

A magnetic IED was attached to a car belonging to SNG official near Yaaqshiid District Headquarter (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 06/12. The driver noticed that the IED and asked colleague not to approach the car but the device was detonated causing the death of a civilian person and injury of two others.

The bodies of three people-two male and a female-were found in bush near Kismaayo University in the evening of 06/12. The identity and the motive of the perpetrators are unknown. Unconfirmed reports indicate that they were Bare Hirale defectors who escaped from AMISOM.

An IED exploded near Hotel Weheliye area on Maka Al-Mukarama Road in Hawl Wadaag District in the night of 07/12. The device was apparently placed on the roadside and prematurely detonated causing no casualties. The target could not be established and the perpetrators escaped from the scene.

Two hand grenades were thrown at SNG police on patrol in Dabka Junction in Hawl Wadaag District on 09/12. One hand grenade exploded while the second one failed. SNGF forces started shooting in all directions after the explosion. Police EOD team recovered the unexploded device.  The perpetrators escaped. Causalities not known.

A hand grenade was hurled at SNG police outpost in Bar Ubax Junction in Wardhigley District on the 09/10. SNG police started shooting in all directions following the explosion. Unconfirmed reports indicate that a suspect was arrested. No casualties were reported.
Galgala insurgents fired mortar rounds at positions of Puntland forces in Galgala Hills (35km NW of Bosasso) in the afternoon of 09/12. No casualties were reported.

Two amputated bodies were found in Buur Hakaba town in the early morning of 09/12. The dead bodies were identified as members from Eyle sub clan of Rahanweyn while the motive and the identity of those behind the killings remain unknown.

Militias loyal to Barre Hiiraale reportedly opened fire at a warship believed to be a Kenyan that came close to Sabca Asharaf village near Goobweyn Village (14km, NE, Kismaayo) on 09/12. No casualties reported.

An unidentified gunman shot and killed a Puntland policeman manning a security checkpoint in Israac neighbourhood  (Galkacyo North) in the evening of 09/12. The perpetrator took the gun of the victim and escaped.

The head of the Academic Department of SIMAD University was shot and killed in a drive-by shooting in the morning of 10/12 in KPP neighbourhood in Hodan District. The attackers managed to escape and the motive is so far unknown. Investigations are underway to determine the motive and the identity of the attackers.
A businessman was shot and killed in a drive-by shooting in Ali Kamiin neighbourhood in Wardhigley District on 10/12. The perpetrators managed to escape and the motive is unknown.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: Gunmen opened fire at a municipal council bulldozer demolishing a land reportedly claimed ownership by the municipality of Berbera on 10/12. No casualty was reportedly but the gunmen deflated the tires of the bulldozer forcing it to stop the demolition. The gunmen managed to escape.

An RCIED planted during the overnight hours accidentally exploded in the centre of Qansax Dhere in the morning of 11/12. The device exploded at a time when AMISOM/EOD team was dismantling it. One AMISOM soldier was killed and two others were wounded. Perpetrators not known.
Three Puntland soldiers stationed in Golis mountains were killed and four others were wounded in a bomb blast near the village of Galgala on the afternoon of 12/12.
Fifteen people were killed in Dhusamareb when ASWJ attempted to seize control of nearby Guriel from SNG forces. The extent of violence in Guriel, if any at all, is not known.

ASWJ fighters attacked pro-SNG forces based at district administration office in Guri Ceel in the afternoon of 12/12. The two sides exchanged gunfire that lasted for about an hour. Six combatants were wounded during the clash. The ASWJ fighters took over control of the district administration office.

ASWJ fighters attacked pro-SNG forces based at district administration office in Guri Ceel in the afternoon of 12/12. The two sides exchanged gunfire that lasted for about an hour. Six combatants were wounded during the clash. The ASWJ fighters took over control of the district administration office.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed the chairman of Dharkeynley sports committee in Suuq Yaraha neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the afternoon of 13/12.  The motive is unknown. The victim was an employee of the Justice Ministry and used to visit the presidential palace frequently and maintained good relationship with some ministers.  The perpetrators escaped.
Fighting between SNG forces and ASWJ reported in Dhuusamarreeb. The death of three people and injury of two others has been ascertained. The two actors clashed in the area the previous day.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade against SNG forces' vehicle near khat market in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood (Jowhar) in the evening 13/12. No casualties reported. The attackers managed to escape.

Unidentified attackers fired six projectiles at Mogadishu Airport from Adan Kukay neighbourhood (Wadajir-Medina District) in the night of 14/12. The rounds landed in the AMISOM protected area of MIA. Local residents reportedly said several young men in a Toyota spotted in the area are believed to have been behind the attack. No casualties or damages were reported. The attackers escaped.

Two groups of pro-SNG forces (not named or identified) clashed in Ceel Waq in the morning of 15/12. The fighting broke out after pro-SNG forces allied to a replaced deputy District Commissioner attacked those of the new deputy DC who was appointed by the local authority. Both the former and the new deputy DCs hail from Marehan/Uur-midig sub-clan. One soldier was killed and another injured.

Two groups of pro-SNG forces (not named or identified) clashed in Ceel Waq in the morning of 15/12. The fighting broke out after pro-SNG forces allied to a replaced deputy District Commissioner attacked those of the new deputy DC who was appointed by the local authority. Both the former and the new deputy DCs hail from Marehan/Uur-midig sub-clan. One soldier was killed and another injured.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at an AMISOM military convoy at Bundo Bilan in Ruusiya neighbourhood of Marka in the afternoon of 15/12. Casualties could not be established. The attackers escaped.

Unidentified attackers threw a hand grenade at SNG police on foot near Marka police station in the afternoon of 15/12. One policeman was killed and four civilians were injured. The perpetrators escaped.

A RCIED targeted a SNG vehicle in Baraawe in the morning of 16/12. The vehicle was reportedly carrying a SNG military officer when the incident happened. The commander was unhurt but his two body guards were injured.
Amisom [African Union Mission in Somalia] troops killed one civilian and wounded three others in the town of Marka [southern Somalia] after being attacked by unidentified persons with a hand grenade.

Unidentified gunmen picked two men hailing from Biyomaal clan from their houses in Ceel Hindi neighbourhood of Marka  in the night of 16/12. The perpetrators killed one of the abductees and dumped his body in the same neighbourhood but whereabouts of the other man is unknown.

Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at a SNG police vehicle escorting the deputy divisional police commander of Lower Shabelle Region in Xawa Taako neighbourhood (Afgooye in the afternoon of 17/12.  Two police officers and a by-sander (civilian) were injured by the explosion.
A shootout is reported between police and unidentified gunmen at a former cement factory in Berbera. Causalities not known.
AMISOM/KDF convoy was targeted with a RCIED in Buusaar Village (37km SE of Ceel Waaq) in the morning of 18/12. One truck was slightly damaged. No casualties were reported.

A roadside bomb targeted AMISOM forces in Marka. It is still unknown how many people were killed or injured in the blast. Security forces carried out an operation and arrested several people in connection with the explosion, though the identities of the perpetrators remained unreported.

Pro-SNG (not identified) forces in Waajid conducted a security operation in Eel Tuumad Village (7km NE of Waajid) in the morning of 19/12. The soldiers captured an al Shabaab fighter and later killed him outside the village before returning to Waajid.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed two SNG policemen and injured a civilian passerby near Black Sea Junction (Hodan District) in the afternoon of 20/12. The perpetrators escaped.

Armed men this evening attacked Kaxda [Kahda] District governor's residence in Mogadishu, the Somali capital. The attacked residence is located near Kaxda District headquarters. A gun battle ensued between soldiers guarding the governor's home and the attackers. Two people - a soldier guarding the home and a female passerby - are known to have been killed in the exchange of gunfire. One soldier was also wounded in the attack. It was unclear if the attackers suffered any casualties.

A RCIED targeted the vehicle of Puntland's deputy governor of Mudug Region, Farhan Ali Hirsi, near Galkacyo North police station in the morning of 21/12. The governor suffered minor injuries and is being treated in Galkacyo General Hospital. Puntland security forces launched a security operation in the area after the blast. It remains unclear whether they have made any arrest.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: SNG forces conducted a security operation in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood in Jowhar in the evening of 21/12 following a hand grenade attack. Eight people were reportedly arrested in the operation.
A hand grenade attack in Hanti-Wadaag neighbourhood in Jowhar in the evening of 21/12 against SNG forces. It is not know if there were any causalities resulting from the blast.
A pro-al Shabaab source claims several explosions occurred in Afgooye, killing at least five soldiers. The attack has not been confirmed by the military.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier in Lafoole (Afgooye District) in the evening of 21/12. The reason behind the killing of the soldier remains unknown. The perpetrators managed to escape.

Armed men dressed in SNG military uniforms (unclear if perpetrators were legitimate soldiers) opened gunfire at a SNG forces' vehicle in the vicinity of Daljirka Dahsoon Junction (Bondheere District) in the afternoon of 23/12. The reason behind the shooting is unclear. One soldier was killed in the attack. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a SNG soldier near Karaan Police station (Karaan District) in the night of 23/12 and immediately escaped.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor
NOTES: AMISOM/EOD team safely disabled several IEDs in the vicinity of Mayafulka (Baidoa) in the morning of 23/12. The devices were initially collected from various Baidoa neighbourhoods. No casualties were reported during the detonation exercise.

An IED targeted a mini-bus transporting supplies to Jubaland soldiers manning a check-point in Buulo Gaduud village (32km NE of Kismaayo) in the afternoon of 23/12. The bus was slightly damaged by the blast. No casualties were reported.

Unidentified gunmen shot and seriously injured an official from Jubaland administration called Yassin Radeel (Marehan) and two of his body guards in Tawakal Hotel in Fanoole neighbourhood (Kismaayo) in the night of 23/12. The reason behind the attack is currently unknown. The same official was attacked in June 2013 where he was airlifted to Nairobi for treatment. The perpetrators escaped.

Pro-SNG forces (organization not identified) on a security operation killed an al Shabaab fighter in the outskirts of Teyeeglow in the morning of 24/12 and brought his body to the town. The operation came after a tip-off that al Shabaab fighters had been planning an attack pro-SNG forces in revenge of women related to al Shabaab fighters killed by pro-SNG forces.

A Jubaland forces' convoy heading to Kismaayo along the Jilib-Kismaayo highway hit an IED in Bula Gudud Village (32km NE of Kismaayo) in the morning of 25/12. Two soldiers were killed and three others injured.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a civilian in Juungal neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the evening of 26/12. The motive behind the killing is currently unclear. The perpetrators escaped.

Pro-SNG forces (organization not identified) manning a checkpoint in Dina Village (18km SE of Xudur) opened fire at a mini-bus after the driver reportedly ignored instructions to stop. Six passengers were killed and 11 others injured. The pro-SNG forces claimed that they had suspected the mini-bus as an al Shabaab vehicle. The vehicle had left Puntland and was heading to Bay Region when the incident happened.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a man in Dabagalo Village (36km SW of Xarar-dheere) on 27/12. The motive of the killing is unclear and the perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified attackers hurled a hand grenade at SNG police based at Hawl-Wadaag Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the night of 28/11. The soldiers reacted by opening fire. No casualties reported.
Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a man near Bakaara Junction (Hawl-Wadaag District) in the evening of 28/11. The motive of the killing is unknown.

An unidentified attacker hurled a hand grenade at SNG forces' vehicle in Ceelasha settlement (12km SE of Afgooye) in the evening of 28/12. SNG soldiers in the vehicle opened fire after the blast. The soldiers were heading to Afgooye when the incident happened. No casualties reported.

Unidentified men armed with pistols shot and killed a woman in Dabakayo Madow neighbourhood (Dharkeynley District) in the morning of 30/12. Reports indicate that the victim (lady) was working with the Central Bank. The reason behind the killing is currently unknown. The perpetrators escaped.
Unknown assailants attack and kill a woman in western Mogadishu, reasons unknown.
Unidentified men armed pistols shot and killed an official of Yaaqshiid District administration in Suuq Bacaad neighbourhood (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 30/12. The perpetrators escaped.

Unidentified gunmen shot and killed two men installing solar-powered street lights along the industrial road near Miisaanka Dhuxusha (Yaaqshiid District) in the morning of 31/12. The motive is unclear. The victims were working for a private contractor. The perpetrators escaped.
Unidentified persons attacked the Radio Galkayo building with a pair of hand grenades. Two journalists reported injuries.
The Boere Attack Troop, a far right group, detonates three explosives near a Mosque, post office, and a local shop. Extensive property damage, three children and an adult killed.

EVENT_TYPE: Non-violent activity by a conflict actor

5 armed Janjaweed wearing military uniforms stormed farmlands around Kaja on camelback, seized 2 women and raped them.

A Spanish diplomat was found stabbed to death in his home in Khartoum.

2 women on their way to Faluja village in East Jebel Marra were robbed, assaulted and raped by Janjaweed on camels, armed and wearing military uniforms.
Gunmen driving a land cruiser attacked policemen guarding a convict from Kassala prison on his way to a hospital in Kassala. They then fled with the prisoner.
2 women from Erli, near Kas, were assaulted and raped by armed Janjaweed who arrived on camel/horeseback. They were later taken to hospital in serious condition.
2 Rizeigat were killed outside the Labado camp for the displaced, leading to deployment of police to catch the killers and prevent revenge attacks.

Unidentified gunmen stormed the office of the medical director of the Bindisi camp hospital and demanded medicines. They then locked the director in a hospital room and started shooting into the air, causing staff to evacuate the hospital.
1 man was stabbed to death and another seriously wounded in a fight with Sudanese armed forces.

Militias stopped and searched a train which was rumoured to be transporting large quantities of arms and ammunition for Maaliya tribesmen in Ed Daein. While it was stooped the militiamen beat the commander of the second garrison of El Daein and his bodyguards when they tried to stop them from boarding the train. The armed men also looted several shops in the area.
In the area of Kalajo, a local rescue team clashed with a group of gunmen that stole a herd of camels. 2 people were killed and 7 others injured.
Pro-government militia elements stabbed a policeman with a knife before shooting and killing him. They then robbed him.
Militiamen riding on motorcycles kidnapped a person in El Safa neighbourhood, and then fired into the air as they drove away, panicking residents.

Unidentified gunmen killed 4 Sudanese soldiers and wounded 7 others. A Lt. Col. was among those killed.

3 Janjaweed on camels assaulted and raped a young woman from Kalma camp in Nyala locality, seriously injuring her.
About 13 pro-government militia in a land cruiser attacked Hassahissa camp resident and leader Saeed Yagoub Abdelshafi, seized him at gunpoint, and took him in the direction of Jebel Bum.
7 government-backed militia shot a farmer while he was working. They then took his money and belongings and left.

Heavily armed military and security forces surrounding the Border Guards paramilitary group in El Ziyadiya district of Al Fasher. Residents were terrified, but a committee of Ziyadiya tribal leaders intervened to defuse the situation. As the Border Guards were leaving, they were attacked by government forces. Both sides used heavy artillery during the fighting. Casualties were not reported.

More than 22 women of the Garsila camp sustained various injuries, some serious, when a group of Janjaweed on camels, horses and motorcycles attacked them. They used whips and rifle butts to beat them.
2 young women were assaulted and raped by gunmen in the area of Bala near Nierteti.
A Sudanese oil engineer was killed and his driver wounded near Zarda Hadid oil field when unidentified armed men shot at them and stole their car.

A displaced man was shot dead and 2 others injured in an attack by pro-government militia on their farmlands close to Gireida.
Unidentified gunmen killed 1 and seriously injured another on an attack on a nomadic settlement in the are of Dalwa in East Jebbel Marra. The inhabitants fled and the gunmen stole 18 cows.
Security forces have freed the Chinese oil worker taken hostage last week. In the same operations, they also captured the alleged killers of a Sudanese engineer killed last week near Balila.
Militiamen attacked the police station to try and spring their comrades but were repelled by the police and the gunmen fled. No casualties were reported.

"Government-backed militiamen on camels ambushed a vehicle belonging to the National Electoral Commission that was on its way from Nyala to Buram." The Janjaweed killed 3 people, two employed by the electoral commission and one soldier. Other passengers were wounded.
A displaced man from Ronga Tas camp for IDPs was abducted by 12 gumen on motorcycles. They later demanded a ransom.
3 militiamen attacked and raped a girl while she was tending to her farmland in the area of Boruru, east of Nierteti.
Unidentified gunmen opened fire on two Kalma camp residents, injuring both seriously. A young woman was also beaten.

2 young women from Nierteti were seized by a group of 4 militiamen and raped.

"Pro-government militiamen shot dead two people in Nierteti locality, Central Darfur" and 7 people were abducted. One woman was released after militiamen raped her.

A pro-government militiamen shot dead an IDP in the Kass locality after a dispute over payment of fees.
A young student was abducted and 2 displaced women severely beaten by militiamen near Kutum.

3 militiamen assaulted and raped a displaced woman in the area of Kubri Wahid, south of Nierteti.
2 women were raped and 20 people sustained injuries (8 seriously) after an attack by around 50 RSF fighters on displaced people living on the outskirts of Omdurman.

2 IDPs were seriously injured in an attack by government-backed militiamen as they were looking for firewood.

A group of 5 government-backed militiamen murdered a farmer in his farmland.

NOTES: ZNU-PF youths attack the president and supporters of the fledgling Transform Zimbabwe party.
Zanu-PF district chairperson is found dead. The death follows a campaign of death threats and the killing is suspected to be politically motivated. The chairperson was allied with Mujuru.
Unknown assailants leave poisoned aerosols in the offices of ZANU-PF Justice Minister Emmerson Mnangagwa. Mnangagwa's secretary is hospitalised by the substance.
